fdroid:be.moraine.yapl.name: YAPL — Yet Another Pilot Log
fdroid:be.moraine.yapl.summary: Private, offline flight logbook with EASA/BCAA paper-logbook PDF export.
fdroid:be.moraine.yapl.description:
YAPL (Yet Another Pilot Log) is a flight logbook for professional and general-aviation pilots who want to keep their hours on their own device — no account, no cloud, no tracking, no network access at all.
It records flights in a clean EASA/BCAA-style structure and can print a paper-logbook-ready PDF to keep an official book up to date.
Features:
* Flight logging — route, block times, aircraft, crew role, day/night landings, IFR and night time. Night time is computed automatically from sunrise/sunset (NOAA solar algorithm) for each leg.
* Logbook view — flights grouped by month with running totals and a fast scrollbar for thousands of entries.
* Statistics — all-time and rolling 90-day totals (time, night, IFR, landings), seeded by your pre-digital "previous totals".
* Hangar — your aircraft types and registrations, kept tidy and reusable.
* BCAA / EASA PDF export — generates the official two-page-per-sheet logbook layout with per-page and carried-forward totals. Mark page breaks in the app so the PDF pages line up exactly with your paper book, and export from any date.
* Backup and restore — full flights CSV, plus a JSON reference backup of airports, aircraft, settings and previous totals. Import from the legacy Flight Logbook app's JSON export.
* Bundled airport database — thousands of airports from OurAirports for offline lookup.
Privacy:
YAPL declares no Android permissions, has no network code, and bundles no analytics, ads or tracking libraries. Your flight data never leaves your device unless you export it yourself through the system file picker.

fdroid:de.bgg_home.texslate.name: TeXslate
fdroid:de.bgg_home.texslate.summary: On-device LaTeX/XeTeX editor: compile & PDF preview offline, no cloud
fdroid:de.bgg_home.texslate.description:
TeXslate is a native LaTeX/XeTeX editor for Android tablets (and phones) that compiles your documents right on the device — no cloud service, no account, no companion PC. Editor, LaTeX compiler and PDF preview live together in one screen.
It is powered by the Tectonic engine (XeTeX), so modern Unicode and fontspec/\setmainfont just work.
Features:
* Full LaTeX/XeTeX compilation on-device, offline
* Live PDF preview — split view on tablets, tabbed layout on phones
* LaTeX syntax highlighting, auto-compile on pause, jump-to-error
* Multi-file projects: \input / \include and bibliography
* Curated fonts bundled (Latin Modern, TeX Gyre) usable by name via \setmainfont; Android system fonts and your own font folder also work
* Search & replace, go-to-line, comment toggle, document outline, custom templates
* Optional AI assistant (Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini) — off by default, used only if you add your own API key
Good to know:
* The first compile downloads the TeX packages it needs (internet needed that one time). Afterwards compiling works offline; when a connection is available, the app checks the bundle server and fetches packages a document uses for the first time.
* The optional AI assistant contacts third-party services only when you enable it with your own key.
Free software, licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Built for tablets first: split view, external keyboard and stylus.

fdroid:de.j4velin.wifiAutoOff.description:
This simple Android app can help you increase the standby time of your device;
it automatically disables your WiFi radio when you don't need it and thereby
lowers the battery consumption. It is designed to be used with WiFi-only tablets
- these devices normally don't require a constant internet connection if you're
not using them and turning WiFi off can save a lot of battery power.
You can also specify to automatically turn on WiFi again, if you turn on your
device. This way, you are always connected to your WiFi network when using the
the tablet.
This app has a similiar effect like setting the "WiFi sleep policy" in Android
to "always", except that you can now exactly define the timeout between turning
the screen off and actually turning off WiFi.
If your device has a cell radio, it might switch to 2G/3G which may consume more
power than staying on WiFi.

fdroid:io.github.hathibelagal.eidetic.name: Eidetic
fdroid:io.github.hathibelagal.eidetic.summary: A simple Android app that helps you improve your working memory
fdroid:io.github.hathibelagal.eidetic.description:
Eidetic is an app for improving and testing your working memory. All you need to do is press the buttons in the right order. It's harder than it looks.
 Background 
 The chimp test, also known as the Ayumu memory test, is a test designed to assess working memory.
 It was popularized by a study conducted at the Primate Research Institute of Kyoto University in Japan, where chimpanzees demonstrated remarkable short-term memory abilities.
 Chimps seem to, effectively, have a photographic memory (eidetic memory).
 Untrained humans generally perform significantly worse than chimpanzees on the chimp test. So, this app trains you. The hope is that we can eventually match or beat chimp records.
 Gameplay 
 Numbers from 1 to 9 are displayed randomly
 You must memorize the positions of the numbers
 Once you press 1 , all buttons display a ? 
 You need to then use your memory to press 2 , 3 ,..., 9 
 It's game over if you press the wrong button thrice.

fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.liftmath.name: liftmath
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.liftmath.summary: Gym calculator: 1RM, plates, warm-ups, strength scores, records, rest timer
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.liftmath.description:
liftmath is the calculator you want between sets. It does a few things and does them properly.
One-rep max: enter any set you just did and it runs six published formulas and shows their median. Add the RPE or reps in reserve and it accounts for the reps you left in the tank. A percentage chart underneath gives you loads from 100% down to 50%, rounded to what your plates can actually make. Tap a row to load it.
Plates: type a target and it tells you what goes on each side and draws the bar. It works with a standard bar, a women's 15 kg bar, metric plates, or the exact plates you own at home. Turn on the warm-up ramp and it plans your warm-up sets on the way up.
Strength scores: Wilks, DOTS and IPF GL from your total and bodyweight, plus how your DOTS compares with every raw or equipped lifter in the OpenPowerlifting database.
Records: world records for powerlifting, strongman, grip and track and field, with your own lift shown as a percentage of the record.
Rest timer: pick 1:00 to 5:00 or your own time. It keeps the screen on while it runs and buzzes when you are done.
Everything works in lb or kg, and Share sends a link to the exact numbers on screen.
The app has no internet permission, so it never makes a network request. There are no ads and no account, and it does not track you. Your plate setup and settings stay on your phone.
liftmath is free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later. It also runs in any browser at liftmath.munzzyy.dev and as a Python library and command-line tool.

fdroid:io.pcontacts.app.name: pcontacts
fdroid:io.pcontacts.app.summary: Sync Proton Mail contacts into the Android system address book.
fdroid:io.pcontacts.app.description:
pcontacts signs in to your Proton Mail account, decrypts your contacts client-side using OpenPGP, and exposes them to the system Contacts app so they appear alongside your local contacts — the same way WhatsApp or Telegram surface their own contact directories.
This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
It uses the same HTTP API as the Proton Mail web client, which is not officially documented or supported for third-party use.
The API may change at any time without notice.
Once contacts land in ContactsContract, the OS owns them.
Stock Android ships with pre-installed applications — Google Play Services, Google Contacts, Gmail, the OEM dialer, the OEM messaging app, vendor "assistant" services — that are granted READ_CONTACTS by default or are very difficult to revoke.
Decrypting Proton contacts onto a device with those apps still installed effectively shares them with Google and the OEM.
For a meaningful privacy posture, run pcontacts on a de-Googled ROM: GrapheneOS is preferred (sandboxed Google Play, per-app contacts scopes), or LineageOS for microG, or vanilla LineageOS without GApps.
pcontacts cannot fix this for you on stock Android; it is a property of the platform's permission model, not of this app.
Features:
* SRP login with TOTP two-factor authentication.
* Client-side-only decryption — your contacts are never sent anywhere except the system address book on your device.
* Full vCard field support: name, email, phone, address, organization, notes, instant messaging, photos, and group membership.
* Bidirectional sync: edits made in the system Contacts app are pushed back to Proton with end-to-end encryption.
* Soft-delete with a 1-hour grace period so accidental deletions can be cancelled before they reach the server.
* Per-field conflict detection when both the phone and Proton have changes to the same contact.
* Periodic background sync via SyncAdapter and WorkManager.
* No Google Play Services, no telemetry, no analytics, no tracking.
Source code: https://github.com/andreabenetton/pcontacts
License: GPL-3.0-only

fdroid:org.y20k.escapepod.description:
Escapepod is a straightforward and lightweight app that takes a minimalistic approach to podcast listening, which may not appeal to everyone. The app consists of only two screens: a list of all podcasts and a list of episodes for a single podcast. Escapepod lacks a podcast discovery feature, offering only a simple search option. Additionally, it opens RSS podcast links when tapped in a web browser.
VERIFY APK
----------
APKs published on Codeberg Releases are signed with the following certificate.
SHA-256: 61:05:14:5F:84:E5:CB:D6:97:F0:F6:E1:2C:97:77:04:2E:9B:2D:B6:67:A7:FF:0D:A4:12:F6:74:35:31:6D:D8
FREQUENT QUESTIONS
------------------
DOES ESCAPEPOD HAVE PLAYBACK QUEUE?
Escapepod has a simple up-next feature. Tap play on an episode while listening to another one. You will be be given the opportunity add it to the up-next slot.
WHAT ARE THE DEFAULT SETTINGS?
- Auto-update does not download files over cellular network
- Escapepod by default only keeps two episodes
CAN ESCAPEPOD KEEPS MORE THAN TWO EPISODES?
Escapepod tries to reduce the number of episodes it keeps. Here are the rules for that:
- Escapepod keeps the latest two episodes
- Episodes, that have been started, or that have been downloaded manually, are kept, too
- Episodes that have not been listened to in more than two weeks are removed.
DOES ESCAPEPOD SUPPORT OPML?
You can import a podcast list using the OPML exchange format using the respective option in the app's Settings. The current podcast collection can be exported via Settings, too. Additionally Escapepod keeps an up-to-date OPML file in the folder /Android/data/org.y20k.escapepod/files/collection/.
WHERE DO THE PODCAST SEARCH RESULTS COME FROM?
Escapepod searches by default the Podcastindex.org (https://podcastindex.org/) online database - or if you toggle the respective setting the gpodder.net (https://gpodder.net/directory/) online database.

flathub:at.ssh_mitm.server.name: SSH-MITM
flathub:at.ssh_mitm.server.description:
SSH-MITM is a man in the middle SSH Server for security audits and malware analysis.
 Password and publickey authentication are supported and SSH-MITM is able to detect, if a user is able to login with publickey authentication on the remote server. This allows SSH-MITM to accept the same key as the destination server. If publickey authentication is not possible, the authentication will fall back to password-authentication.
 When publickey authentication is possible, a forwarded agent is needed to login to the remote server. In cases, when no agent was forwarded, SSH-MITM can rediredt the session to a honeypot.
 Features
 publickey and password authentication
 Phishing FIDO Tokens (Information from OpenSSH)
 hijacking and logging of terminal sessions
 store and replace files during SCP/SFTP file transferes
 port porwarding with SOCKS 4/5 support
 intercept MOSH connections
 audit clients against known vulnerabilities
 plugin support

flathub:io.github.pd_l2ork.Pd_L2Ork.name: Pd-L2Ork
flathub:io.github.pd_l2ork.Pd_L2Ork.description:
This package contains Pd-L2Ork, which is a fork of Pure Data that
 bundles a lot of useful extensions, brings a modern HTML5-based
 user interface, and provides a set of unique features, including
 K12 beginner mode, and L2Ork-Tweeter. While Pd-L2Ork is backwards
 compatible with Pure Data and other variants, the same is not true
 the other way around. Hence, some of the most advanced content
 created in Pd-L2Ork may not run well, or at all on other Pure Data
 variants. Pd-L2Ork is a brainchild of the Linux
 International Ensemble.
 Pure Data is an open source visual programming environment that runs on
 anything from personal computers to embedded devices (ie Raspberry Pi)
 and smartphones (via libpd, DroidParty (Android), and PdParty (iOS).
 It is a major branch of the family of patcher programming languages
 known as Max (Max/FTS, ISPW Max, Max/MSP, etc), originally developed
 by Miller Puckette at IRCAM.
 Pd enables musicians, visual artists, performers, researchers, and
 developers to create software graphically without writing lines of
 code. Pd can be used to process and generate sound, video, 2D/3D
 graphics, and interface sensors, input devices, and MIDI. Pd can
 easily work over local and remote networks to integrate wearable
 technology, motor systems, lighting rigs, and other equipment. It
 is suitable for learning basic multimedia processing and visual
 programming methods as well as for realizing complex systems for
 large-scale projects.

flathub:io.jor.nanosaur2.summary: Fly a pterodactyl who’s loaded with hi-tech weaponry
flathub:io.jor.nanosaur2.description:
In the year 4122, a solo Nanosaur was sent 65,000,000 years into the past. His mission was to find the unhatched eggs of ancient dinosaur species and return them to the future. The mission was a success, but before the eggs could be hatched, they were stolen by a group of rebel Nanosaurs. The rebels took the eggs to offworld bases where they planned on breeding the dinosaurs. Their goal was to create warriors for fighting their battle against Earth.
 But the rebels left one egg behind. . . when it hatched, a new Nanosaur was born. This hatchling was sent on a mission to recover the stolen eggs and defeat the rebel forces.
 Nanosaur II: Hatchling is a continuation of the original Nanosaur storyline, only this time you get to fly a pterodactyl who’s loaded with hi-tech weaponry. In addition to the three level adventure mode where you blast enemy dinos and save eggs, there are also six two-player levels including racing, capture-the-flag, and battle.
 About this port: Nanosaur 2 was released in 2004 by Pangea Software. It was a pack-in game on Macs that came out around that time. This port aims to provide the best way to experience the game today. This port was made and re-released under permission from Pangea Software, Inc.

flathub:org.winehq.Wine.name: Wine

Wine (originally an acronym for "Wine Is Not an Emulator") is a compatibility layer capable
 of running Windows applications on several POSIX-compliant operating systems, such as Linux, Mac
 OSX, and BSD. Instead of simulating internal Windows logic like a virtual machine or emulator,
 Wine translates Windows API calls into POSIX calls on-the-fly, eliminating the performance and
 memory penalties of other methods and allowing you to cleanly integrate Windows applications into
 your desktop.

firefox-addons:2985520.name: YouTube Adblocker
firefox-addons:2985520.summary: Instantly block all YouTube™ ads for faster, cleaner, ad‑free videos.
firefox-addons:2985520.description:
YouTube Adblocker — Block All YouTube Ads Instantly
Tired of ads interrupting your YouTube experience? YouTube Adblocker removes every type of YouTube advertisement automatically — no configuration needed.
What it blocks:
- Pre-roll and mid-roll video ads (skippable and non-skippable)
- In-feed promoted videos and sponsored results
- Overlay and banner ads on the video player
- Sponsored cards and shopping sidebars
- Ads inside embedded YouTube players on any website
How it works:
The extension uses Chrome's built-in network blocking (Declarative Net Request) to stop ad requests before they load, combined with CSS-level hiding to remove any remaining ad elements from the page. Ads are blocked at the source — no data is collected, no requests are redirected.
Features:
- Works on youtube.com and on YouTube embeds across the entire web
- Toggle video ads, feed ads, and overlay ads independently
- Tracks how many ads have been blocked for you
- Lightweight — no impact on browser performance
- 100% private — zero data collection
Clean, fast, ad-free YouTube. Install once, works instantly.

Salesforce Inspector Reloaded is designed specifically for Salesforce developers, administrators, and users to help them navigate and debug Salesforce applications. It provides a suite of tools and functionalities that enable users to analyse and manipulate Salesforce data in real-time.

 DIGITAL WALLET

Thanks to your master password only you and you alone have access to them – not even Avira can access your data.
 WHAT'S NEW? 
Now save all your credit cards in your secure digital wallet, where the magnetic stripe will never wear off.

bluejetty:00100746:ios.description:
Apocrypha / Deuterocanonical: Bible’s Lost Books:
The Apocrypha is a collection of ancient biblical books that were included in the original 1611 King James Bible (KJV) but were later removed in 1885. These texts were originally positioned between the Old Testament and the New Testament, alongside maps and genealogies. Some of these books are also known as Deuterocanonical books, a term used by the Catholic Church and other Christian traditions.
The 70 missing verses of 2 Esdras, which are not included in the King James Version Apocrypha, can be found in the Cambridge Annotated Study Apocrypha, edited by Howard C. Kee, and in the NRSV Holy Bible with Apocrypha, published by Oxford University Press.
Features:
・ Audio Bible (TTS – Text-to-Speech): Listen to the Apocrypha, Deuterocanonical books, and the KJV Bible with professional narration.
・ Offline Access: Read and listen to the Bible and Apocrypha without an internet connection.
・ Auto-Scrolling Mode: Continuous reading without flipping pages manually.
・ Full-Screen Reading Mode for distraction-free Bible study.
・ Bookmark & Notepad: Save your favorite verses, add notes, and copy passages with a single tap.
・ Custom Highlights: Choose from 4 different colors.
・ Large & Bold Fonts: Easy-to-read text with adjustable font sizes, word spacing, and line height.
・ Powerful search engine that lets you quickly find verses across all books of the Bible.
・ Three Verse Layout Modes for personalized reading preferences.
・ Resume Reading: Easily pick up where you left off.
・ Portrait & Landscape Modes for flexible reading.
・ Additional Free Bible Apps Available: Download the King James Version (KJV 1611), World English Bible (WEB), and more.
Books Included for Free:
Apocrypha / Deuterocanonical Books:
1 Esdras
2 Esdras (with missing 70 verses)
Tobit
Judith
Additions to Esther
Wisdom of Solomon
Sirach (Ecclesiasticus)
Baruch
Letter of Jeremiah
Prayer of Azariah
Susanna
Bel and the Dragon
Prayer of Manasseh
1 Maccabees
2 Maccabees
Laodiceans
Should the Apocrypha Be in the Bible?
The Apocrypha has been a subject of debate for centuries. Some argue these books were never part of the inspired Word of God, citing verses such as Tobit 6:5-8, which mentions magic, as inconsistent with the rest of the Bible. Others believe the Apocrypha was wrongly removed, pointing out that these books were included in the Bible for nearly 2,000 years before being taken out just over a century ago. Some claim that they were excluded due to their absence from the original Hebrew manuscripts, while others argue that publishers removed them to reduce printing costs.
Interestingly, fragments of the Dead Sea Scrolls, dating back to before 70 A.D., contain portions of Apocryphal books in Hebrew, including Sirach and Tobit, suggesting that these texts were valued in early Jewish communities.
These Bible book apps are also available from the same developer:
King James Version (KJV) & World English Bible (WEB)
The King James Bible (KJV) remains one of the most widely recognized and influential Bible translations. Commissioned by King James I of England in 1604 and completed in 1611, it has shaped English-speaking Christianity for centuries.
For those seeking a more modern translation, the World English Bible (WEB) provides a complete Holy Bible in contemporary English, maintaining accuracy and readability.
Download Now – The Ultimate Free Apocrypha Bible App!
Explore the Apocrypha, Deuterocanonical books. Whether for Bible study, historical research, or devotional reading, this app provides an authentic biblical experience with powerful features—all for free!
Thank you for using Apocrypha / Deuterocanonical: Bible’s Lost Books.

No Wifi Games is the ultimate app for offline gaming. It offers you a bundle of offline games that you can play without any internet connection. No Wifi Games does not have any ads or in-app purchases, so you can enjoy the games without any interruptions. No Wifi Games is suitable for all ages and skill levels. - Classic Solitaire: The classic card game that never gets old. Play the most popular version of solitaire, Klondike, and try to clear the board by moving all the cards to the foundations. Self-Service Knights: Idle RPG - Embark on an exhilarating adventure in this action-packed idle RPG where your dedication shapes the battlefield! Cast aside reliance on mere luck; your time and strategic effort forge the mightiest equipment. Farm epic loot through thrilling battles, crafting legendary weapons and armor as you engage with dynamic combat powered by 20 unique stats.

[Craft Your Epic Destiny]
Time over luck! Discover rare materials and master recipes to create unparalleled equipment. Your dedication crafts your success.

[Mastery Without the Price Tag]
Here, your commitment is your currency. Dive into the fray, farm for your gear, and build an arsenal without spending a dime.

[Prove Your Fighting Prowess]
With your crafted gear, face off against formidable foes in electrifying battles. Test the strength of your creations and your strategic skills.

[Continuous Growth]
Your knight's journey doesn't pause; training and battling go on, even when you're away. Return to a stronger warrior, ready for more challenges.

[Embark on Quests and Conquests]
Explore quests for valuable items and coins across 8 stats. Accept the challenge to test your equipment and skills in the face of adversity.

[Attractive Allies for Battle]
Not just for show, your charismatic companions are both a visual treat and a tactical boon in battles. Choose your allies wisely to gain the upper hand.

Self-Service Knights: Idle RPG invites you into a world where your strategic choices and dedication define your path. Forge your legend and assemble a team of charismatic companions for strategic advantage. Are you ready to embark on a journey where every decision, every battle, and every piece of gear tells the story of your unique knight? Your adventure awaits!

bluejetty:00148126:ios.description:
Қазақстандағы тұңғыш байланыс операторының қосымшасы.
- Тарифіңізді оңай қолданыңыз: оны құрастырғышта өзіңізге ыңғайлы етіп реттеп алып, қажет қызметтер мен ресурстарды қосыңыз
- Бала кезде беріліп ойнайтын Asyq ойынының жаңа нұсқасын ойнап, гигабайт алып отырыңыз
- Қазақ тілінде жаңа сөздер үйреніңіз
- Qazyna бөліміне кіріп тұрып, бонус пен жеңілдік алып отырыңыз
- Теңгеріміз бен ресуртарыңызды қосымшаның басты бетінде қадағалаңыз
- Теңгерімнен төлем жасап, қаржыңызды басқарыңыз
- Тиімді роуминг пакеттерімен өзіңізді барлық жерде еркін сезініңіз
- Жаяу жүргеніңіз үшін «Алға» қызметінде айына 30 ГБ дейін алып отырыңыз. Қадамыңызды санау үшін «Денсаулық» қосымшасын пайдалануға рұқсатыңыз керек болады
Роутерлер
- 4G/5G роутерлерін бөліп төлеу мүмкіндігімен үйге жеткізіп алуға тапсырыс беріңіз
- Ресурстарыңыз бен тарифіңізді қадағалаңыз
- Роутер ресурстарын бөлісіңіз: жақындарыңыз гигабайт пен минут пакеттерін оп-оңай ала алады
—
Приложение первого казахстанского оператора связи.
- Легко управляйте своим тарифом: настраивайте его под себя на конструкторе, подключайте нужные услуги, добавляйте ресурсы
- Играйте в Asyq — любимую игру детства — и зарабатывайте гигабайты
- Изучайте новые слова на казахском
- Заглядывайте в раздел Qazyna и находите бонусы и скидки
- Следите за балансом и ресурсами прямо на главной странице приложения
- Управляйте финансами и оплачивайте услуги с баланса
- Будьте везде как дома с выгодными роуминг-пакетами
- Получайте до 30 ГБ в месяц за ходьбу с услугой «Алға». Для подсчёта шагов мы запросим доступ к приложению «Здоровье»
Роутеры
- Заказывайте роутеры 4G/5G в рассрочку и с доставкой до двери
- Следите за ресурсами и тарифом
- Делитесь ресурсами роутера: ваши близкие могут получить пакет гигабайт и минут просто так

bluejetty:00183394:ios.description:
Dinnerly is America's most affordable meal kit! It's also fast, convenient, and delicious. Dinnerly replaces tedious meal planning and grocery shopping with tasty, easy-to-make recipes and pre-portioned ingredients delivered direct to your door. There are 16 unique recipe options every week, so even your pickiest eaters will be happy! Use our meal delivery app to choose your recipes, schedule delivery days, and save a whole lot of time. 
Here's more of what you can do with the app: 
- Pick your meal plan: decide what, when, and how much you want to cook.
- Choose recipes and delivery days up to 4 weeks in advance. 
- Cook with easy-to-follow digital recipes.
- Rate your dinners and give our chefs feedback.
- Send free cooking boxes to your friends.
Like a magical food fairy, Dinnerly makes weeknight cooking—and life, in general—a whole lot easier. Our home cooking kit's weekly collection of 16 unique recipes has something for everyone. Healthy? Vegetarian? Family-friendly? We've got you covered. Download the app to start cooking with Dinnerly tonight!
Need more meal it info? Visit our website: https://dinnerly.com/how 
Like us on Facebook and get smart cooking hacks: facebook.com/dinnerly
See what's cooking on our Instagram page: instagram.com/dinnerly

bluejetty:00064176:ios.description:
Sudoku game is known as great way to challenge your basic puzzle solving skills, develop your logical thinking and patterns, keep your brain active and of course have lots of fun. The rules are simple: fill the 9x9 table with digits from 1 to 9 without repeating the digits in each column, row and the small 3x3 boxes. In other words, each column, row and the boxes must be filled with all of the nine digits (from 1 to 9).
Features:
-Clean and neat design with fresh and user-friendly interface
-Easy to learn, but hard to master and addictive gameplay
-Different difficulty levels: From easy to medium and hard
-Optimized for both Portrait and Landscape views
-Your personal game scores and stats for each difficulty level
Stay tuned and let us know about any bugs, questions, feature requests or any other suggestions. Your feedback is valuable to us and we are constantly improving the experience to make sure we are delivering the best Sudoku game ever.

bluejetty:00120728:ios.description:
Wonderland has a new magical location where kids can create and role-play their own beauty and the beast fairy tale story! In an enchanting palace, ballroom and stables the beast awaits true love, will he find it? it is all up to you! Fun and adventure awaits, find the hidden room, discover all hideouts and check out all the new characters and clothing. Wonderland is a game where kids make up the story as they play. Role-play and imagination are all that is needed to create a new adventure!
FEATURES:
- Exciting new locations, with lots of places to discover and explore!
-The prince has a dark secret in his room, can you find out what it is?
- Lots of new character including the Beauty and the Beast of course
- There are lots of hidden treasures to be found around the palace, some are hard to find!
- This game will connect to any other Wonderland game we shall release… yes, More games coming!
- Multi touch-enabled so you can play with friends or family on the same device.
- A stress-free environment for kids to play at. No winning or losing. Just creative gameplay and hours of it!
WE MAKE GAMES KIDS WANT TO PLAY
If you have ever written to us then you probably know that we are reading all your comments, Fan emails and Facebook message. Let us know what theme you would love to see next and if there are enough requests you will probably have a nice surprise a few months ahead. So don’t be shy, if you have an idea, a bug, a complaint or you just want to say hello, make sure to connect with us. 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
This game is perfect for Kids 4 -12, the game promotes creative thinking, imaginative gameplay and endless role-playing game time. Wonderland games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. We have No Ads, No 3rd Party Ads, and no IAP. 
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES STUDIO
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

Chromecast Integration:

Stream from Top Services:
Explore a universe of entertainment with support for streaming from YouTube, Twitch, and other leading platforms. Discover, enjoy, and easily share your favorite content.
Effortless File Management:
Seamlessly manage your media library with support for iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and more. Access your files from anywhere, anytime, with the utmost convenience.
Universal Playback:

- Universal Media Playback: Supports 3GP, AVI, MP4, MKV, FLAC, MP3, and more.

bluejetty:00027429:ios.description:
Dive into Tranquility: Unwind and Ascend with Zen Koi 2 (Free-to-Play)
Embark on a captivating journey of serenity and wonder with Zen Koi 2, the enchanting sequel to the beloved Zen Koi game. Immerse yourself in the soothing flow of the Koi's motion. Tranquil gameplay and calming music complete the serene experience. Breed and nurture vibrant koi and witness their transformation into majestic dragons, all within the comfort of your mobile device. 
A Legacy of Relaxation Evolves: 
Zen Koi 2 builds upon the core gameplay that captivated players in the original, offering a soothing and relaxing experience suitable for all ages. While retaining the essence of the classic collection mechanic, Zen Koi 2 introduces exciting new features that enrich your gameplay journey: 
Ascend to the Dragon Realm: Witness the culmination of your carp's journey as they transcend the koi pond and ascend to a celestial plane. Explore the vast expanse of the Dragon Realm, a breathtaking astral space adorned with shimmering constellations. 
Unleash Your Creativity: Gather essence as your dragon soars through the Dragon Realm. Use this essence to craft unique and shareable constellations, expressing your artistic vision and leaving your mark on the celestial canvas. 
Cultivate Your Personal Aquarium: Descend from the ethereal heights and return to your cherished koi pond. In 'My Pond', you can create a personalized underwater zen garden. Decorations range from plants and rocks, to seasonal effects, sand ripples, flowers, and glowing stones. Arrange and customize your underwater haven to reflect your individual style and preferences. 
Witness the Beauty of Transformation: As you breed and nurture your koi through their lifecycle, marvel at their stunning visual transformations. Observe the vibrant patterns and colors displayed by your koi, culminating in the awe-inspiring metamorphosis into majestic dragons. 
Connect with Family and Friends: Share your love for Zen Koi 2 with loved ones. Compete in friendly leaderboards, showcasing your koi fish collection and dragon constellations with your family and friends. 
Beyond Relaxation: A Journey of Discovery and Expression: 
Zen Koi 2 transcends the boundaries of a mere relaxation tool by offering players a platform for creativity and self-expression. The ability to craft and share constellations in the Dragon Realm allows players to explore their artistic side, while the customizable My Pond fosters a sense of ownership and individuality. Additionally, the family-friendly nature of the game encourages social engagement and fosters a sense of community among players of all ages.
Unveiling the Art of Zen Koi 2: 
The developers at LandShark Games have poured their passion and dedication into crafting a visually captivating and emotionally engaging experience with Zen Koi 2. The game's breathtaking visuals transport players to a world of serenity, while the calming soundtrack soothes the mind and promotes relaxation. 
More than just a game, Zen Koi 2 offers a refuge from the daily grind, a space to unwind, connect with yourself, and unleash your inner artist. Whether you seek a moment of peace amidst a busy schedule, a creative outlet to express yourself, or a fun and engaging experience to share with friends and family, Zen Koi 2 welcomes you to embark on a journey of tranquility and discovery.
Download Zen Koi 2 today and begin your ascent!

bluejetty:00086515:ios.description:
قلبنا الفكرة! وغيرنا الأسلوب القديم والمرهق في عملية البحث عن العقارات!
في تطبيق ديل لا تبحث عن العروض العقارية لكن اطلب عقارك بنفسك وين ما كنت في المملكة العربية السعودية، من خلال واجهة سهلة الاستخدام وواضحة التفاصيل. الآن آلاف الوسطاء العقاريين المهتمين بطلباتك ينتظرونك ومستعدين لتقديم عروض عقارية تناسبك حسب مواصفات طلباتك الخاصة عبر التواصل الفوري (المحادثة المباشرة داخل التطبيق أو الاتصال الهاتفي أو الواتساب). 
مميزات التطبيق لمقدم الطلب: 
- لا يوجد أي عملية بحث أو عروض عقارية مُجهدة.
- سهولة الحصول على الوحدة العقارية من خلال رفع الطلب الشخصي مباشرة مع كتابة المواصفات المرغوبة. 
- إمكانية الحصول على العديد من العروض العقارية القريبة لمواصفاتك واختيار ما يناسبك.
- الربط المباشر بينك وبين الوسيط أو العقاري المناسب والأقرب لك عن طريق (دردشة مباشرة - اتصال هاتفي - واتساب).
- المحافظة على الوقت والجهد المبذول في عمليات البحث العقارية المطلوبة.
مميزات التطبيق للعقاري:
- وجود قناة فاعلة لتسويق عقاراتك مباشرة على مقدمي الطلبات.
- ميزة توسيع قاعدة العملاء عبر إيصال طلبات عقارية تتقاطع مع اهتمامك.
- سهولة البحث في الطلبات العقارية (حسب المنطقة ونوع العقار).
- الربط المباشر بينك وبين مقدم الطلب عن طريق (دردشة مباشرة - اتصال هاتفي - واتساب).
- إمكانية تفعيل التنبيهات عند توفر طلب متوافق مع اهتماماتك العقارية.
-
نسعى في تطبيق ديل إلى زيادة فاعلية التواصل في القطاع العقاري عبر جمع كل الطلبات العقارية في مكان واحد يسهل على (الوسطاء والمطورون العقاريين) تقديم خدماتهم بشكل مميز وسهل (لمقدمي الطلبات العقارية) في جميع أنحاء المملكة. كما نختصر الجهد والوقت على طالب العقار الذي يجد تحدي كبير في الوصول إلى العروض العقارية المناسبة والمتوافقة مع طلبه ورغباته.

bluejetty:00117644:ios.description:
Stunning fashions. Unlimited creativity.
Express yourself and become a style maven in the #1 dressup boutique simulation game!
Designed for style savvy women of all ages, it’s free to play and you can play Fashion Empire while offline. The game is constantly updated and full of fabulous gameplay-
- CHIC FASHIONS to sell, mix and match and grow your fortune
- DECORATE your boutiques with thousands of gorgeous decorations
- DESIGN thousands of unique items ranging from elegant to edgy
- DRESS UP yourself and your trendy staff any way you choose
- MAKEOVERS with all the latest makeup and cosmetics trends
- COLLECT and covet special designer, elite and signature items
- SHOP furniture - racks, tables, registers, displays and much more 
- STORY mode with fashion shows, fascinating characters and freedom
- ADVENTURE to the top with hundreds of quests across many cities
- WIN big and show off in online challenges - it’s fashion week every day!
- JOIN a vibrant fashion loving community
The game is free to play and in-app purchases are available for additional content and premium currency.
Game background and how to play:
1/ You start in San Francisco, an aspiring designer just opened your first shop. You've always been creative, from playing dress up with barbie dolls as a kid, hours on the sims, learning to sketch and creating an amazing portfolio at a top design academy. Together with your investor Eva you'll begin by designing your very first item - a gorgeous pink dress which is sure to bring in initial shoppers
2/ After making your first sales you'll want to expand capacity for racks, registers, dressing rooms - and don't forget decorations to attract the style minded clients.
3/ As your boutique grows you'll learn more and unlock more outfit categories of items - shoes, heels, bags, purses, rompers, jumpsuits, makeup, cosmetics, accessories and more.
4/ After a while you'll probably find yourself busy as the sole worker in your boutique - it will be time to find the perfect staff to join you on your journey. But first you'll need to find a way to persuade them to join - and each have their own story to tell and personality to work with.
5/ San Francisco is just the beginning, soon you'll be expanding to Las Vegas, Miami, Los Angeles and even New York. There you'll get to know celebs and stars who will warm to your unique style and, in time, crave and covet your latest collections. And who knows what glamorous occasions you'll be designing for...
6/ Your reputation is starting to grow and it's time to prove yourself on the world stage amongst a global player base. This is your chance to show your interior designs and outfits in challenging online themed contests, whether it's celebrity style or coffee casual, from red carpet to haute couture runway...
The biggest dress-up and boutique game ever, it's time to write YOUR stylish story.
--Support, Questions or Requests--
Email-us from settings in-game or at fashionempire@frenzoo.com
--- FOLLOW US ---
Official Instagram - https://instagram.com/fashion.empire.official/
Official Facebook Page - https://www.facebook.com/FashionEmpireOfficial/
--JOIN OUR COMMUNITY--
https://m.facebook.com/groups/fashionempireplayercouncil/

The game is free to play and in-app purchases are available for additional content and premium currency.

Game background and how to play:

1/ You start in San Francisco, an aspiring designer just opened your first shop. You've always been creative, from playing dress up with barbie dolls as a kid, hours on the sims, learning to sketch and creating an amazing portfolio at a top design academy. Together with your investor Eva you'll begin by designing your very first item - a gorgeous pink dress which is sure to bring in initial shoppers

2/ After making your first sales you'll want to expand capacity for racks, registers, dressing rooms - and don't forget decorations to attract the style minded clients.

3/ As your boutique grows you'll learn more and unlock more outfit categories of items - shoes, heels, bags, purses, rompers, jumpsuits, makeup, cosmetics, accessories and more.

4/ After a while you'll probably find yourself busy as the sole worker in your boutique - it will be time to find the perfect staff to join you on your journey. But first you'll need to find a way to persuade them to join - and each have their own story to tell and personality to work with.

5/ San Francisco is just the beginning, soon you'll be expanding to Las Vegas, Miami, Los Angeles and even New York. There you'll get to know celebs and stars who will warm to your unique style and, in time, crave and covet your latest collections. And who knows what glamorous occasions you'll be designing for...

6/ Your reputation is starting to grow and it's time to prove yourself on the world stage amongst a global player base. This is your chance to show your interior designs and outfits in challenging online themed contests, whether it's celebrity style or coffee casual, from red carpet to haute couture runway...

bluejetty:00147249:ios.summary: The ultimate Interval Timer for your HIIT Workouts and Tabata training! Our app is the perfect Workout Timer, offering customizable work/rest periods for High Intensity Interval Training, Tabata, Running, Boxing and circuit training. Achiev
bluejetty:00147249:ios.description:
The ultimate Interval Timer for your HIIT Workouts and Tabata training! Our app is the perfect Workout Timer, offering customizable work/rest periods for High Intensity Interval Training, Tabata, Running, Boxing and circuit training. Achieve peak interval performance with our EXCLUSIVE AI Voice Cues (feat. Arnold, Snoop & The Rock) that keep you motivated without interrupting your music!
Why this timer?
We added voice cues from AI versions of Arnold Schwarzenegger, Snoop Dogg, and The Rock.
Because honestly, who wouldn't want Arnold yelling "PUMP UP THOSE MUSCLES" between sets when you're still wondering "WTF was I thinking doing this workout"?
- TURN INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK WORKOUTS INTO FOLLOW-ALONGS. Share any workout post or reel to Peak Interval and it becomes a timed follow-along - exercise clips, reps, rounds and rest all set up for you. Finally, a use for all those workouts you saved "for later".
- CUSTOMIZABLE WORKOUTS: Tailor your interval timer for any HIIT, Tabata, or circuit training session.
- MUSIC INTEGRATION. Your music keeps playing while the cues run during your interval timer training - no interruptions. Who are we to judge what you listen to?
- AI VOICE QUEUES. Get motivated by AI Arnold, Snoop Dogg, & The Rock for a truly fun workout timer experience.
- LOCKED SCREEN MODE. Cues still play even when your phone is locked—because you shouldn't have to keep your screen on. You need to save that battery % for all that social media scrolling.
- APPLE HEALTH & APPLE WATCH. Your workouts automatically sync to Apple Health with live heart rate monitoring and heart rate zones right on screen. Start a workout on your iPhone and your Watch joins in automatically. Your calories, duration, and heart rate — all tracked, all saved, zero effort.
- SAVE AND ORGANIZE INTERVAL TIMER WORKOUTS. color-coded, named, and ready for quick access. Easiest thing about your workout is going to be starting the timer - the workout itself - not so much.
- BIG CLEAR NUMBERS WITH COLOR CODED SCREENS - so you can see your time from a distance. Like across the gym.
- REAL TIME EXERCISE ON-SCREEN CUES—enter your exercise names, and they'll show up on-screen during interval timer workouts and announce what's coming next during rest. At that point you may regret adding one extra round.
- SHARE WORKOUTS WITH OTHERS – perfect for coaches with clients. Or that friend that needs to lay off donuts and do some serious sweating.
 Perfect for:
 - Interval timer training
 - High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT timer training)

Ready to crush your enemies, Archer Heroes?
Archer Hunter is an addictive, action-packed adventure game where you slay hordes of enemies with an amazing set of skills and weapons. Begin as a newbie archer, then build your skills and abilities to become the Master.
Enemies come in many forms and sizes, from skeletons, golems, to slimes, goblins, ogres or werewolves with different attack patterns. Just kill them all with your projectiles and tactics. 
Crawl through thousands of dungeons, fighting for treasures, items and valuable gears to upgrade your strength and become more powerful. Enjoy countless combinations of unique abilities to keep your archer alive.
Download I Am Archer now, and start your journey!
DEFEAT WAVES OF EVIL
The world is at stake. Evil forces are dominating and you are the only hope, a legendary archer with skills so great that it becomes a myth. 
Now the destiny of the world is in your hand, can you destroy them all with your bow and arrow, or succumb to permanent failure? It’s up to you. 
Fight through each stage, destroy enemies, collect experience points to level up and learn new skills. Ready to face brand new monsters with different strategies and attack patterns.
UPGRADE YOUR HEROES
The monsters become stronger, faster and more powerful, so are you. Raid the dungeon, collect weapons, armors, amulets and more gears. Equip yourself with the best items, upgrade to make them even stronger. 
Master the art of moving, dodging, and shooting. Grab your bow and destroy everything that dares to stay on your way. Shooting has never been so fun.
UNLOCK MORE HEROES
You are not alone on this deadly journey. There’re more heroes with various fighting styles and skills are ready to join your forces. Recruit them, discover new abilities and save the world together.
KEY FEATURES
• Addictive, action-packed gameplay 
• Tight and responsive control with just one finger 
• AFK Rewards: earn coins and items in your free time.
• Stunning graphics, beautiful worlds and characters. 
• The endless combination of skills and gears.

With all the goodies, what are you waiting for? Join forces with other players, raid dungeons, destroy monsters, defeat bosses and claim valuable prize. 
The war starts now.

bluejetty:00040982:ios.summary: Are your children often grappling with the challenge of remembering spellings, especially those with silent letters or longer words? The truth is, over 80% of English words contain multiple syllables. Highlighting the pronunciation and the
bluejetty:00040982:ios.description:
Are your children often grappling with the challenge of remembering spellings, especially those with silent letters or longer words? The truth is, over 80% of English words contain multiple syllables. Highlighting the pronunciation and the syllabic breakdown of words can significantly ease the memorization of correct spellings. Take 'Wednesday', for example; we pronounce it 'wens-day', yet spell it as 'Wed/nes/day'. Teaching kids to break down long words into syllabic chunks, rather than trying to memorize each letter, is a pivotal skill for those facing hurdles in reading and spelling.
Puzzle Meets Syllable: A Fun Fusion
Puzzles have always been a beloved activity among children. Now, we blend this enjoyment with the world of syllables! In our game, each word's syllables are presented in the form of puzzles, making the learning process not just fun but also providing crucial visual cues through the puzzle's outlines. This approach makes decomposing words more intuitive and strengthens children's understanding of word structures, easing the mastery of phonics.
Designed for All Levels, Perfect for Beginners
Our game offers two engaging learning modes: "Learn" and "Battle". Beginners can start with the learning mode, progressively mastering word phonics, picture matching, and quiz challenges. For children with a budding vocabulary, the battle mode awaits, offering them a chance to test their skills.
Embark on a Word Adventure with Cool Mechs
Oh no! Villains are on the attack; it's time to pilot your mech and defeat them! Engaging in activities like object recognition, word selection, spelling, and listening, children must accumulate enough energy to vanquish these foes. This thrilling game doubles as an educational journey, allowing kids to learn words while experiencing excitement and a sense of achievement.
Hundreds of Animated Word Cards for Daily Vocabulary
Dive into themes that span animals, food, people, and nature, essential for everyday life. We focus on teaching words through lively, creative animations, sparking interest and understanding. This interactive learning method not only expands vocabulary but also enhances language skills in a fun, enjoyable setting.
Product Highlights
Syllable-based Puzzle Learning: Overcoming challenges with ease.
Gradual Learning System: Suitable for children at all levels, from toddlers and kindergarteners to preschool-aged kids.
Fun Learning Modes: "Learn" and "Battle" modes offer education with enjoyment.
Pilot 36 Unique Mechs: Utilize special abilities to defeat enemies.
6 Themes, 196 Essential Words: A comprehensive learning journey.
Hundreds of Exquisite Word Card Animations: Facilitate understanding and retention.
Play Anywhere, Anytime: No internet required.
No Third-Party Ads: Focus on learning without distractions.
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00044079:ios.description:
Start Your Journey
Create a unique character profile with customizable attributes and skills. Design your adventure by setting milestones and quests to guide your progress. Collect coins and gems as you achieve milestones and quests, and use them to unlock personalized rewards that keep you motivated.
Features
Journey, Milestone, and Quest System
- Journey: Define a long-term direction you want to work toward.
- Milestone: Journeys can feel too far away to keep you engaged. Setting milestones helps you recognize your progress and shorten the positive feedback loop. Earn gems when you achieve a milestone—fully customizable based on its significance.
- Quest: Focus on meaningful habits that drive your journey forward. Each quest represents an action or habit you commit to for growth.
Attribute System
- Attributes represent intangible qualities like health, creativity, or leadership.
- Set attributes that matter to you and link them to quests.
- Completing quests will increase linked attributes based on their difficulty. For instance, quests tied to "vitality" or "charisma" help you see progress in those areas.
Focus Timer & Skill System
- Link the built-in focus timer to your skills. Each minute spent focusing is converted into XP.
- The rule says mastering a skill requires approximately 10,000 hours. In Dual, reaching Level 100 reflects this milestone.
- As your level increases, the difficulty to level up grows, mirroring the real-life challenge of skill mastery.
- Categorize your skills and build a unique skill tree to visualize your growth.
100% Personalized Reward Shop
- Design rewards that excite and motivate you in real life, like a movie night, boba, or a new gadget.
- Unlock special rewards tied to milestones, such as earning a new pair of running shoes after breaking a personal record.
Upcoming Features
- Customizable loot boxes for added excitement
- Advanced stats to track quest completion and focus time
Is Dual for You?
Dual is perfect for those who value both the journey and the destination. It’s ideal if you enjoy building a highly customizable reward system that motivates you in the long term. Note: The app requires some initial setup to tailor the experience to your needs, but the payoff is worth it!

bluejetty:00164033:ios.description:
MediBuddy is an app that simplifies healthcare by offering a wide range of medical services at your fingertips. From booking doctor appointments to ordering medicines and scheduling lab tests ensuring that your healthcare needs are met quickly and conveniently.
Why Choose MediBuddy?
We’re revolutionizing healthcare in India by providing comprehensive medical care facilities via our mobile app. Whether you're seeking doctor appointments, medicine delivery, lab tests, or even surgical care, we have you covered. Our platform connects you to over 1,80,000 qualified doctors across 26+ specialties, enabling you to access healthcare whenever and wherever you need it.
MediBddy Key Features:
1. Talk to a doctor online
Book doctor appointments online in minutes for both routine and specialized consultations. You can also book an in-clinic appointment.
Instantly connect with expert doctors via video call, voice call, or chat.
Access consultations in 16 Indian languages for over 26 specialties, including gynecology, dermatology, cardiology, mental health, pediatrics, sexology, and more.
Consult specialists for conditions like hernias, piles, anal fissures, and more.
2. Online Medicine Delivery:
Order medicines online with delivery to your doorstep in over 96% of pin codes nationwide.
Save up to 40% through our online pharmacy.
Access more than 2,50,000 medications and health products, with real-time order tracking and easy refills.
3. Lab Test Booking & Home Sample Collection:
Schedule lab tests from home with home sample collection by trained phlebotomists within 6 hours, and reports delivered digitally in less than 24 hours.
Choose from over 2,000 tests, including blood tests, X-rays, ECGs, and health checks.
Easily pay online and track your test results through the app.
4. Surgery and Specialized Care:
Elective surgeries and specialized treatments can be scheduled directly through MediBuddy.
Receive complete surgical care, from pre-op consultations to post-op follow-ups, all managed seamlessly through our app.
5. ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) Integration:
MediBuddy seamlessly integrates with ABHA for easier access to government-sponsored health schemes.
Keep track of all your health records digitally and share them securely with your healthcare providers.
6. Digital Health Records Management:
Store and share your medical records with doctors, ensuring seamless healthcare experiences.
Access your medical history, prescriptions, and test reports anytime, anywhere.
7. Health Tracking & Integration:
Integrate with Apple Health to track steps, calories burned, water intake, weight, and more.
Log your daily health data for comprehensive monitoring of your well-being.
Our Expertise:
MediBuddy's network includes doctors from across specialties.
-Gynecology
-Mental Health (Therapists and Psychiatrists)
-Dermatology
-Cardiology
-Sexology
-Hair & Scalp Care
-General Practice
-Pediatrics
-Gastroenterology
-Orthopaedics
-Neurology
-Cancer Care
How MediBuddy Works:
Book a Doctor Appointment: Book online doctor appointments in just a few clicks.
Order Medicine Online: Choose from 250,000+ medicines and get Medicine home delivery.
Schedule Lab Tests: Book tests with home sample collection for more than 2,000 different tests.
Receive Surgical Care: Schedule consultations and surgeries with our network of expert surgeons.
Our Milestones:
-Over 50,000 users are served daily.
-More than 1,80,000 doctors provide over 25,000 consultations each day.
-20,000+ clinics & hospitals are part of our network, ensuring quality care across India.
-Over 10 lakh corporate health checks and over 15 lakh pharmacy orders are processed annually.
-Over 15,000 surgeries were successfully facilitated.
Experience hassle-free healthcare Whether you need to book a doctor's appointment, order medicines online, or book lab tests, MediBuddy is your go-to health companion.
Download the MediBuddy app today and simplify your healthcare journey!

With over 2.8 million users across Southeast Asia, Doctor Anywhere (DA) is one of the region's fastest-growing healthcare companies, dedicated to providing quality care to you and your family.  Get the DA app now for trusted healthcare at your fingertips: 

SEE A DOCTOR 
> Consult a licensed doctor on-demand, via video call 
> Medicine delivery to your door
> Access your referrals, MCs and reports in-app

Suitable conditions for virtual consultation include:
- Cough, cold and flu/ influenza
- Stomach upset, digestive issues
- Diarrhea / constipation
- Allergies
- Headaches and migraines
- Eye infections
- Ear pain and infections
- UTI, vaginitis, yeast infections
- Eczema, psoriasis, rashes
- Depression, anxiety
- Birth control

CONNECT TO A SPECIALIST
Easily schedule an appointment and video-call a specialist directly through our app. Our team of experts includes dermatologists, psychologists, urologists, OB-GYNs, pediatricians, ENT specialists, and many more, ready to provide you with expert advice and care whenever you need it.

SHOP FOR EVERYDAY HEALTH ON DA MARKETPACE*
Discover a wide range of health and wellness products and services from leading brands, from healthy snacks and supplements, to health and wellness services. Enjoy free islandwide delivery on your purchases.

CORPORATE HEALTH BENEFITS
Make the most of your healthcare benefits! For those enrolled in a health insurance or plan, easily access your coverage, locate panel clinics, and explore member perks. 

SAFEGUARD YOUR HEALTH
Take a proactive approach to your well-being by scheduling regular health screenings and vaccinations. Choose from convenient in-clinic or home-based appointments to ensure you stay ahead of potential health issues.

PAYMENT METHODS
You can use PayNow (Singapore users) and credit or debit cards from local and international banks for video consultations, medication orders, health plan subscriptions, and topping up your DA Wallet for transactions at panel clinics and other app services. 
---

Note: Delivery areas and times for medicines may vary by country. This general overview of our app may not fully capture the user experience in all regions. Availability of healthcare services and features also differs depending on location.

bluejetty:00119750:ios.summary: Experience intuitive, secure browsing across intranet, internet, and web apps. Workspace ONE Web gives you instant access to your company’s internal network sites while you’re on the go without the hassle of manually connecting to a VPN.
bluejetty:00119750:ios.description:
Experience intuitive, secure browsing across intranet, internet, and web apps. Workspace ONE Web gives you instant access to your company’s internal network sites while you’re on the go without the hassle of manually connecting to a VPN. 
**Instantly Access Company Sites and Intranet**
Enjoy frictionless access to your organization’s websites and intranet in a flash without manually configuring a VPN. 
**Find All of Your Bookmarks in One Place** 
Your company can push bookmarks down to your app for you to easily locate. You can also edit and remove bookmarks or add your own. Having a hard time locating your bookmarks? Tap the action grid at the bottom and tap “Bookmarks”.
**Scan QR Codes on the Fly**
Need to scan a QR code? Navigate to the Browser’s URL address bar, tap the code on the right, enable access to the camera and your device is ready to scan!
To optimize security and productivity for your device, Omnissa will need to collect some device identity information, such as:
• Phone Number
• Serial Number
• UDID (Universal Device Identifier)
• IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identifier)
• SIM Card Identifier
• Mac Address
• Currently Connected SSID

bluejetty:00145092:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00145092:ios.description:
Block Match: Tile Puzzle — A Fresh Take on the Classic Puzzle Game
Step into the magical world of Block Match: Tile Puzzle, an innovative rendition of the classic puzzle game. Here, you need to skillfully place various shaped blocks into a 9x9 grid, embarking on a limitless, time-free elimination journey. As you clear the blocks, you have the opportunity to collect various treasure items. By following the rule of merging three identical items into one, you gradually unlock the highest level treasure chests and discover the rich rewards inside!
Is the Challenge Truly Infinite?
Become your perfect companion for passing time while training your brain. The unrestricted gameplay lets you immerse yourself at will until you are satisfied. Each round, you will face challenges with three differently shaped blocks (such as T-shapes, I-shapes, L-shapes, and squares), diving into the world of blocks!
Is It Just a Puzzle Game?
This simple, user-friendly block game is suitable for players of all ages. Keep your mind sharp and build strong logical thinking skills through block puzzle gameplay.
Is It Really This Simple?
 Drag and Drop to Eliminate: Place blocks into the 9x9 grid, filling an entire row or column to eliminate blocks.
 Space Challenge: The game ends when there is no space left to place new blocks in the grid.
 Score Accumulation: Each successful placement and elimination of rows/columns will earn you score points.
 Treasure Synthesis: Eliminate blocks with treasure items, and the items will enter the synthesis grid. Three identical treasure items will automatically upgrade to the next level item.
 Chest Reveal: The highest level treasure chest will automatically open, revealing the surprise rewards inside.
Is It Really This Lovable?
 Relaxing Elimination: Enjoy the elimination process with no time constraints.
 Audio-Visual Delight: Crisp sound effects and pleasing background music create a captivating melody.
 Easy to Learn: Intuitive controls make it easy to master the game.
 Exquisite Design: Beautiful interface design and charming characters complement each other.
 Addictive Mechanics: Simple yet highly engaging game mechanics make it hard to put down.
 Pure Experience: Clean interface and simple gameplay make it irresistible.
Is It Really This Fun?
Three-in-One Synthesis: Three identical items will automatically upgrade to the next level item. When synthesized to a chest, the chest will automatically open, bringing you rich rewards.
Limited Synthesis Space:Make effective use of the limited synthesis grid space, showcasing your wisdom and strategy. Avoid filling up the grid so that synthesis becomes impossible, and challenge your mental limits!

bluejetty:00130382:ios.name: BLEASS Voices
bluejetty:00130382:ios.summary: BLEASS Voices is a vocal processing effect for pitching, transforming, doubling and harmonizing vocals and other sources. With 12 pitch-shifted voices and detailed control over pitch, formant, tone, width and placement, it can move from sub
bluejetty:00130382:ios.description:
BLEASS Voices is a vocal processing effect for pitching, transforming, doubling and harmonizing vocals and other sources. With 12 pitch-shifted voices and detailed control over pitch, formant, tone, width and placement, it can move from subtle vocal enhancement to dense harmonies and radical transformations.
Four harmonized voices can be transposed independently by up to one octave in either direction or fixed to a chosen pitch. The remaining eight voices can be triggered via MIDI, turning incoming audio into a playable vocal instrument.
MPE support brings expressive control to performance, making it possible to create vocal chords, realistic glides, trills and other pitch-based articulations directly from a compatible controller.
Two LFOs, an envelope follower and a pattern sequencer add modulation and movement, extending BLEASS Voices beyond conventional harmonizing into more synth-like vocal processing.
All voices can use intelligent pitch correction based on a selected key and scale. Each voice also has an independent output bus, allowing individual voices to be mixed and processed separately.
BLEASS Voices works with fundamental frequencies from 66 Hz to 5.2 kHz, making it suitable not only for vocals but also for a wide range of instruments.
A Real-Time mode provides the low latency required for live performance and recording.
BLEASS Voices can be used as an AUv3 plugin on iPhone and iPad.
BLEASS Voices is also available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
More information, technical specifications and tutorials available on
https://www.bleass.com/voices/

• Simple and intuitive for young children
• Great for preschool and early learning
• Helps build vocabulary and memory
• Encourages listening and concentration
• Fun animal activities for everyday learning

bluejetty:00091148:ios.description:
Zoocasa provides real estate listings, insights and sold data for Canada and over 30 American states. We are an award-winning brokerage that provides intelligent tools like advanced online real estate search, instant home appraisals, and sold data to empower anyone to buy and sell their homes faster, easier and more successfully.
With access to over 100,000+ listings, price history and intelligent appraisal tools, it's easy to find a property you love.
Latest Listings: Get the most accurate property data, updated multiple times a day across Canada and the USA.
Zoopraisal™ Home Estimates: Algorithms and local market data to determine property value and estimate how quickly it will sell so you will never miss a deal.
Sold Data: Inform your research by viewing historical property listings and learn how a home has changed over time.
Detailed Photos: Immerse yourself in a home with easy-to-use photo galleries, fullscreen portrait and landscape images.
The Perfect Home: Set your neighbourhood and price to receive house, condo or townhouse alerts that are personalized for you.
Refine your Search: Select features that match your preferences like price range, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, home type, amenities and listed or sold dates.
Building Data: Find condo details like maintenance fees, locker information, building age, amenities and more.
The Best Agents: Connect with our agent team directly from the app to visit the properties you love. Rated 4.8 / 5 on Google by hundreds of clients!
Our goal is to empower you with real estate information and provide you with the best experience in finding your new home. We look forward to hearing from you about our app.

Descargá la app y descubrilo.
¿Qué puedo encontrar en Brubank?
Tarjeta de débito y crédito Visa
-Ahorrá con promociones en los mejores comercios.
-100% internacional: elegí pagar en pesos o en dólares. 
-Recibí notificaciones cada vez que hagas una compra.
-Máxima seguridad: pausala o reportala desde la app.
-Elegí color: verde, rosa o violeta.
Inversiones
-Dólar oficial: comprá y vendé 24/7.
-Dólar MEP: comprá y recibilo en 24 hs.
-Fondos Comunes de Inversión: invertí usando nuestras recetas de Fondos que te ayudan a diversificar tu inversión. 
-CEDEARs: invertí en empresas mundiales, sin abrir una cuenta en el exterior.
-Plazos fijos: generá rendimientos con las mejores tasas.
Caja de ahorro en dólares gratis
-Sin documentación adicional.
-Te la aprobamos en 24 hs. 
Promociones
-Ahorrá todos los días en comercios físicos y virtuales. 
-Restaurantes, supermercados, farmacias, estaciones de servicio, y más.
Pago de servicios y recargas
-Accedé a más de 5.000 servicios: luz, agas, gas, internet, y más.
-Pagá manualmente o adherite al pago automático.
-Recargá la línea de tu celular.
-Cargá tu tarjeta de transporte.
Pago con código QR
-Escaneá cualquier QR para pagar con tu dinero en cuenta o con tu tarjeta de crédito.
-Comprá de forma segura en tiendas físicas.
Préstamos, adelantos y cuotificación
-Accedé a un préstamo en pocos segundos y recibilo al instante.
-Pedí un adelanto para salvarte del apuro.
-Cuotificá tus compras para que se te haga más fácil pagarlas. 
Cuenta sueldo
Depositá tu sueldo en Brubank y desbloqueá miles de beneficios: 
-BruPlus bonificado.
-Tarjeta de crédito sin costo. 
-Atención VIP.
-Depósitos y extracciones sin costo.
BruPlus
Accedé a la versión premium de tu cuenta para disfrutar de:
-Aún mejores promos.
-Tasas preferenciales.
-Soporte VIP.
-Depósitos y extracciones sin costo.
Control familiar
-Supervisá los gastos del menor en tiempo real. 
-Detectá señales de alerta
-Protegelo de las apuestas online.
-Dale libertad con su propia tarjeta de débito. 
Soporte 24/7
-Nuestro equipo de soporte está disponible las 24 horas del día de los 7 días de la semana.
Brubank Empresas
-Abrí tu cuenta empresa sin costo, y en 24 hs.
-Facilitá las finanzas de tu pyme con la ayuda de un especialista de empresas.
-Accedé a una tarjeta de crédito Visa corporativa para todo tu equipo.
-Invertí en una cuenta remunerada.
Mi Negocio
-Si tenés un comercio o un emprendimiento, potencialo con Mi Negocio.
-Cobrá con QR o con terminal Payway.
-Disfrutá de comisiones mínimas.
-Acreditá tus ventas en 24 hs.
-Mantenimiento sin costo.
Asistencia al viajero
Descuento y cuotas sin interés en tu asistencia de viaje que incluye:
-Cobertura por pérdida de equipaje.
-Planes 100% personalizados. 
-Extras que se adaptan a tu viaje.
Seguros
-Cash Seguro: protegé todas tus extracciones ante posibles robos.
-Compra Protegida: evitá preocuparte por si tus compras se dañan.
-Celu Seguro: asegurá tu celular ante robo hasta por un año. 
-Empleo Seguro: protegé tu ingreso ante la pérdida involuntaria de trabajo, accidente o fallecimiento. 
Pago con Google Pay y Apple Pay
-Adherí tus tarjetas Brubank a Google Pay o Apple Pay para disfrutar de pagar directamente desde tu celular. 
-Sin contacto, sin QR.
Análisis de gastos
-Organizamos tus gastos catalogándolos por temáticas. 
-Accedé a un gráfico mensual con tus consumos. 
-Analizá en qué estás gastando para organizarte cada vez mejor. 
Transferencias
-A cualquier banco o billetera virtual sin costo y de forma inmediata.
-Enteráte cuándo llega tu transferencia.
Extracciones 
-Retirá tu dinero a través de cajeros automáticos, Pago Fácil o comercios Extra cash.
¿Querés conocer más? Visitá https://www.brubank.com

bluejetty:00114645:ios.summary: Turn everyday moments into unforgettable stories with this app – the playful yet powerful AI video generator that makes creativity accessible to everyone. Whether you want to surprise friends, add flair to your social media, or simply explo
bluejetty:00114645:ios.description:
Turn everyday moments into unforgettable stories with this app – the playful yet powerful AI video generator that makes creativity accessible to everyone. Whether you want to surprise friends, add flair to your social media, or simply explore new artistic effects, the app transforms photos and text into lively, animated videos within seconds. No special skills are required – just your imagination.
This app allows you to create in different ways: type a prompt for text-to-video magic or upload a favorite photo to see it animated with unique styles and motion. Express yourself with fun, bold visuals that can be cinematic, dreamy, or even whimsical. It’s the perfect tool for sharing laughs, emotions, or creativity across social platforms.
Experiment with diverse looks including anime characters, watercolor paintings, cyberpunk neon, classic film vibes, or playful 3D effects. Add your own music or voiceover to bring even more personality to your creations. Built-in AI features let you animate faces, generate characters that smile or dance, and recreate scenes with emotional depth. The app also follows viral AI trends, so you’ll always be able to join the latest creative wave.
Export your results instantly in HD or 4K and share them directly on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or save them to keep for yourself.
**Enjoy better tools**:
-Create watermark-free HD & 4K videos.
-Unlock exclusive filters, avatars, and templates.
-Extend video duration and customize freely.
-Remove ads for a smooth, fun experience.
-Use advanced AI tools to animate photos and characters.
Let your imagination take the spotlight with this app. From funny clips to magical edits, the app helps you craft videos that make people smile and get noticed. Download today and start turning creativity into shareable stories.

bluejetty:00179143:ios.name: Roadie: Road Trip Planner & RV
bluejetty:00179143:ios.summary: Plan epic road trips with Roadie. It's a clean and simple route planner for roadtrippers and campers like you - no matter if you map out your annual cross-country road trip or you live the #vanlife dream and explore the world in your camper
bluejetty:00179143:ios.description:
Plan epic road trips with Roadie. It's a clean and simple route planner for roadtrippers and campers like you - no matter if you map out your annual cross-country road trip or you live the #vanlife dream and explore the world in your campervan. Nothing beats the freedom of the open road.
PLAN MULTI-STOP ROUTES
Plan your trip itinerary on an interactive map and pin as many locations on the map as you need. Search locations of attractions, trails, or national parks and save points of interest in a list. You can now add your personal notes to every stop.
SEE DISTANCES & DRIVING TIMES
See distances connecting the road trip waypoints and know the driving times between multiple stops. Easily plan your time on the road and your gas and fuel consumption.
SHARE YOUR TRIP (like Google My Maps)
Share your trip and collaborate with friends on finding the most interesting sights and the best places to stay the night.
FIND PLACES ALONG THE ROUTE (like Roadtrippers)
Use search shortcuts to quickly find good restaurants, interesting sights or good value campsites. Type "pizza" or "burger" in the search to display these places on the map. Or just click on any place or POI in the map and add it to your list of stops or starred places.
MARK FAVORITE PLACES
Star places to visit and save them for later on the interactive map. You can add a note to be reminded of why you want to visit this place. Once you are on the highway or you map out your next road trip it is easy for you to see if one of your saved places is nearby and you can add it to your route.
USE OFFLINE & NAVIGATE
Change the order of places to visit with an easy-to-use drag-and-drop. Use the app offline while you drive on the highway and never miss out on attractions and sights along your route. Start the navigation with one click in your preferred navigation app and get driving directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
EXPORT & IMPORT YOUR ROUTES
You can make a backup of all of your routes by exporting them in GPX format. You can import them into Google My Maps or share them with friends.
MORE FEATURES COMING SOON
We're constantly updating and improving the app and its functionality. If you think something is missing or if you have any other feedback please share your idea with us. Just write an email to support@getroadie.app
———
You can use the Roadie Road Trip Planner app free of charge forever. There are some restrictions in the free version, though. For example, you can only add up to 30 stops to your routes.
All restrictions can be removed by purchasing the “Premium Membership”.
———
Terms of Service: https://getroadie.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getroadie.app/privacy_policy

Plan your trip itinerary on an interactive map and pin as many locations on the map as you need. Search locations of attractions, trails, or national parks and save points of interest in a list. You can now add your personal notes to every stop.

SEE DISTANCES & DRIVING TIMES

See distances connecting the road trip waypoints and know the driving times between multiple stops. Easily plan your time on the road and your gas and fuel consumption.

SHARE YOUR TRIP (like Google My Maps)

Share your trip and collaborate with friends on finding the most interesting sights and the best places to stay the night.

FIND PLACES ALONG THE ROUTE (like Roadtrippers)

Use search shortcuts to quickly find good restaurants, interesting sights or good value campsites. Type "pizza" or "burger" in the search to display these places on the map. Or just click on any place or POI in the map and add it to your list of stops or starred places.

MARK FAVORITE PLACES

Star places to visit and save them for later on the interactive map. You can add a note to be reminded of why you want to visit this place. Once you are on the highway or you map out your next road trip it is easy for you to see if one of your saved places is nearby and you can add it to your route.

USE OFFLINE & NAVIGATE

Change the order of places to visit with an easy-to-use drag-and-drop. Use the app offline while you drive on the highway and never miss out on attractions and sights along your route. Start the navigation with one click in your preferred navigation app and get driving directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.

EXPORT & IMPORT YOUR ROUTES

You can make a backup of all of your routes by exporting them in GPX format. You can import them into Google My Maps or share them with friends.

MORE FEATURES COMING SOON

We're constantly updating and improving the app and its functionality. If you think something is missing or if you have any other feedback please share your idea with us. Just write an email to support@getroadie.app

bluejetty:00178940:ios.description:
Your mind notices more than you think. The first thing you see when you look at your phone can change your whole day. Whether you're going through hard times, need an extra push to get stuff done, or like sharing inspirational quotes on social media, Motivation has you covered.
Positive reminders are one of the simplest and most powerful tools for mental growth. It’s all about keeping the right thoughts top of mind from the get-go every day, so they’re readily available on those hard days when you need them most.
Now, from iOS 14, you can think positive thoughts without even trying with the Motivation widget! Simply install the widget in your home screen and customize it from the app. You can have as many widgets as you want!
Customize the design of the quotes and share the uplifting message of the day with your friends, or use the image for Instagram or as a wallpaper.
The app includes a wide range of topics such as self-esteem, relationships, and dealing with stress, as well as a selection of carefully designed themes to choose from - updated frequently.
+ Read through Hundreds of Quotes
+ Find Motivational Books
+ Save or Share your Quotes
+ Set Motivational Reminders throughout the Day
+ Save your Favorite Quotes
+ Change Font and Colors
+ Filter Quotes by Category
+ Set a Home Screen Motivation Widget
From quotes about working out to love and family quotes, Motivation has them all! Browse thousands of quotes organized by category:
- Motivation to work harder
- Love quotes
- Motivation to train and work out
- Help for depression
- Boost your self-esteem and self-confidence
- Get over a break up
- Life lessons and sayings
- Sports quotes from athletes and trainers
- Business, money, success, and career
- Being present and mindful
- Quotes from and for women
- Philosophy from the best minds
- Quotes to be thankful for what you got
- Inspirations for joy
- Quotes from movies
- Verses from the Bible
- And much more!
And now with Motivation Premium you can:
+ Remove ads
+ Unlock all themes and categories
+ Set background photo
+ Get unlimited reminders
+ Search quotes
To get access to the Motivation Premium content and functionality, you can choose between a lifetime, monthly, and yearly auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged at the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Find tons of inspiring content on our blog: https://blog.motivation.app/
Privacy Policy: https://monkeytaps.net/privacy
Terms of use: https://monkeytaps.net/terms
