bluejetty:00151295:ios.description:
Nosso aplicativo oferece a melhor experiência em vendas e-grocery/e-commerce, trazendo uma variedade imensa de produtos em um supermercado próximo de você!
Veja abaixo algumas de nossas funcionalidades:
- Seleção de centro de distribuição: Selecione a unidade do supermercado mais próximo da sua casa baseado no seu CEP.
- Retirada na loja: Caso opte por essa opção, você poderá fazer a compra pelo app e ir buscar os produtos já separados na loja com mais praticidade e sem necessidade de enfrentar filas.
- Seleção de departamentos: É possível navegar entre departamentos de produtos para maior direcionamento e compras de uma seção específica.
- Receitas: Sabe aquela receita clássica de strogonoff, lasanha, bolo de cenoura?! Com o nosso app é possível selecionar todos os itens de uma determinada receita e adicioná-los no carrinho com o clique de um botão.
- Listas: Crie listas de compras de maneira simples, possibilitando adicionar todos os itens da lista no carrinho de forma prática. 
- Ofertas: Navegue facilmente pelas ofertas da loja, sendo possível encontrá-las por seção e departamento, ou até mesmo na página inicial do app. É possível encontrar ofertas dos tipos combo de produtos, leve e pague, oferta atacarejo, desconto de produto, etc...
- E MUITO MAIS!! Oferecemos um serviço online muito próximo da experiência real de compras de supermercado com mais facilidade e direto no seu aparelho celular.
Não perca tempo e baixe nosso aplicativo, sua experiência de compras pela Internet nunca mais será a mesma!

bluejetty:00030535:ios.description:
Milthm is a non-commercial rhythm game powered by passion, featuring dynamic tracks and notes. The game is themed around "Dreams" and "Rain".
1. Clean and simple UI design
The UI complements the theme of "rain", immersing players in the charming world of rain.
2. Unique and enjoyable dream replay mode
The ripples of the dream enhance the game's challenge and fun.
If you're frustrated with missing notes, you can choose "Wonderful Trial" to automatically restart on a miss or bad.
If you want to increase the difficulty and challenge yourself, you can choose "Fade out" to make notes vanish when approaching.
If you're in the mood for a chaotic game-play, you can choose "Downpour" to rain down a massive number of raindrop notes.
3. Enjoyful and vivid chart design
Chart designs that combine the emotions of the music and the story, providing a visual and auditory feast. It's not just a game; it's a wholehearted experience where animation and music intertwine to bring you unprecedented joy. Whether you're a beginner or a rhythm game expert, you'll find endless fun in the game.
4. Amazing and high-quality music tracks
The music tracks in the game convey different musical styles and emotions. The musical talent of the artists will create an immersive auditory experience. The in-game music will become your companion, leading you into its world.

bluejetty:00186193:ios.description:
Your mission, if you choose to accept, is to get clues and analyze data to solve the outbreak and save lives! In this fun app, you get to be a Disease Detective. 
Do you quarantine the village? Interview people who are sick? Run more lab tests? The better your answers, the higher your score - and the quicker you’ll climb the ranks to become a decorated Disease Detective. In level 1, you’ll start as a Trainee and earn badges by solving scenarios — with the goal of earning the top rank: Disease Detective.

bluejetty:00015235:ios.description:
Make your own flash cards and take the pressure out of test preparation. Flashcard Hero keeps track of what facts you already know so you can focus on what you don’t know and save a lot of time. 
We made Flashcard Hero for those of you who want to fit more than a few words on each card. You can add images, lists, and use text formatting to structure your content.
- Write cards on your iPhone/iPad
- Add images
- Group cards into topics
- Text formatting & lists
- Find and study only difficult cards
- iCloud Drive support (syncs with the Mac app, which is a separate purchase)
Study Options:
- Memorizing cards by covering the answer
- Multiple Choice tests with randomly picked or predefined answers
- Supports studying with the Spaced Repetition System (Leitner Box System)
For Teachers and Educators:
- Compatible with the Remote Control feature of the Mac app. You can use the iOS app as a remote to control the study mode on the Mac while you are projecting on a big screen.
People use the Flashcard Hero Mac & iOS apps to study many different subjects. Here’s a short list of the most popular subjects based on the over 2 million cards that users have shared among each other so far:
- Medicine (anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, genetics)
- Psychology
- Law & business administration (economics, marketing, international law)
- History and politics
- Languages (Latin, Chinese, Greek, Italian, Spanish, German)
- Social sciences
- Music and music theory
- Space physiology (how cool is that?)
- Many more…
You see a lot of subjects in the top ranks where people have to memorize a lot of “structured” information. That’s because Flashcard Hero is designed specifically to go beyond language learning, offering more room on each card for facts, lists, and images. You can also organize cards into topics (to match chapters of a text book, for example).
Note: This app is a single, one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. The App Store might list the app as having in-app purchases, but those are only for backwards compatibility with an earlier version of the app. With this download, you get all features right away.

bluejetty:00100310:ios.description:
How Once Works:
1. Create a film for your event and set the rules
2. Share a QR code or link so guests can join in seconds (No download needed for guests)
3. Everyone shoots in the moment with limited shots per person
4. Photos unlock together at the time you choose, ready to relive and save
Why Hosts Choose Once:
- QR join, no friction: Guests can join with or without the app via App Clip.
- Shared camera for the whole group: Centralize every candid and POV in one place.
- Limited shots = better photos: Scarcity encourages thoughtful, story-driven captures.
- Delayed reveal: Unlock photos at event end or a custom time to keep guests present.
- Private by default: You control access, visibility, and downloads.
- Host controls: Set shot limits, reveal mode (instant or delayed), and participant caps.
- Download everything: Save full galleries to your device or archive them for later.
- Beautiful “film” feel: Subtle, tasteful looks that keep skin tones and ambience true.
Perfect For:
- Weddings and receptions
- Bachelor/Bachelorette parties and showers
- Birthdays and reunions
- Group trips and retreats
- Team offsites
- School events, clubs, and fundraisers
We Care About Your Privacy:
Your event gallery is private by default and controlled by the host. We do not sell your data. See our Privacy Policy at once.film/privacy.
Support:
Questions or feedback? Please feel free to reach out to us at hello@once.film
Life happens only Once. Make sure to capture every angle of it.

What is GameDay Squad Fantasy Sports?
GameDay Squad follows the traditional fantasy sports approach of using in-game stats to apply scores to players. Coaches select a team of player cards each week and their individual scores combine to determine the team's overall score. GameDay Squad differentiates from other fantasy games using player ‘cards’ as opposed to selecting from a player pool in traditional fantasy sports. Another aspect in which GameDay Squad separates itself from traditional fantasy sports is that you get to keep your player cards and use them in future seasons.
Check out even more reasons to play fantasy sports with Gameday Squad below!

bluejetty:00121518:ios.description:
A fun and educational balloon-popping game for toddlers and pre-school kids that want to learn something new and exciting!
Pop the balloons to learn the alphabet, how to count numbers, recognize colors and identify shapes. Five different game modes available in 9 different languages.
Trains cognitive, motor, and memory skills. Free version with NO ADS.
Five game modes (in 9 languages)
• Normal – Fun and simple balloon popping. Great for teaching toddlers motor skills, coordination, and keeping them entertained
• A – Z – Learn how the alphabet is written and spoken in different languages. See and hear the letters when balloons are popped
• 1 – 20 – Learn numbers and how to count. See and hear numbers when balloons are popped
• Colors – Explore the world of colors. See and hear the name of colors when balloons are popped
• Shapes - Learn basic geometric shapes. Requires in-app purchase.
Make the exercise as challenging as you want to keep your toddler stimulated and entertained! Simple – with large and slow balloons – or more difficult with small and fast ones.
For babies or kids with visual impairments such as CVI you can disable background images and increase the size of the balloons in order to make them easier to pop
For more fun, check out our other games for kids!
Music: "Malt Shop Bop"

bluejetty:00170450:ios.name: everyday - Habit Tracker
bluejetty:00170450:ios.summary:
"Every day, it gets a little easier. But you gotta do it every day, that's the hard part."
Simple and beautiful habit tracker: Form new habits to achieve your goals
DO IT EVERY DAY: Get disciplined. Doing it every day helps you form new h
bluejetty:00170450:ios.description:
"Every day, it gets a little easier. But you gotta do it every day, that's the hard part."
Simple and beautiful habit tracker: Form new habits to achieve your goals
DO IT EVERY DAY: Get disciplined. Doing it every day helps you form new habits, and habits are what make you reach your goals
DON'T BREAK THE CHAIN: The more days you manage to chain in a row, the less likely you are to quit
VISUALIZE YOUR PROGRESS: Have a quick overview of your goals and streaks in a single beautiful board
EVERY DAY, EVERYWHERE: Get everyday on all your devices: Web, Mobile and browser extensions. Synchronized.
-------
everyday feature list:
- At-a-glance progress visualization: Easily keep accountable and track your habits and streaks from a simple beautiful board. The more you do, the prettier it looks!
- Reminders to keep you on track
- Simplicity and beauty brought across devices: Get everyday on more than 5 platforms, including Web, iPad, iPhone devices. Your data is always synchronized, accessible and backed up.
- Customize your board: Flexibility is important to adapt the tool to your needs. Sorting the habits, you can prioritize them or group them in categories. Colours can not only be used to make your board look prettier to you, but also to group your habits by type. With the 'break habit' option, have chains with descending colours for habits you want to break.
- If you measure it, you can improve it: Simple statistics that mean something to you instantly. Overcome your own streaks by seeing your current streak side to side with your longest streak ever. Use the daily completed habit counter to compare your daily progress. Have an overall idea of your progress with the total counts and completion rates.
- Flexibility for us, humans: The skip option allows you to skip days without breaking the chain when ill, on holidays or situations out of your control. The skip option can also be used to track habits that aren't daily, giving everyday a lot of flexibility. With 'no weekends', form habits you just want to pursue on weekdays. Use skip at your own peril!
- Use any character type, including emoji: everyday supports a large amount of character types to represent alphabets such as cyrillic, japanese, korean, chinese and arabic amongst others. With emoji, you can personalize your own board for that little extra of motivation :)
More on https://everyday.app/features
-------
everyday.app is a project run by Joan Boixadós, an indie maker, in the challenge to prove that by doing a little bit every day, no matter how little, you can accomplish anything in the long run. everyday is the best proof.
I'd love to answer your questions or just hear what you think about everyday. Find me online at:
joan@everyday.app (mailto:joan@everyday.app)
Twitter: @everydaycheck
FAQ: https://everyday.app/faq
More on https://everyday.app
-------
everyday is free forever with the option to upgrade to everyday Premium. With everyday Premium, you’ll enjoy unlimited access to powerful features in multiple devices that’ll help you form new habits and achieve your goals. 
About Premium billing:
Should you choose to upgrade (totally optional), your iTunes account will be charged as soon as you confirm the purchase. The Premium subscription is billed annually.
The App Store will automatically renew your subscription after 1 year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.
-------
Privacy Policy: https://everyday.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://everyday.app/terms

bluejetty:00069997:ios.name: Do Habits: Get It Done
bluejetty:00069997:ios.summary: Do Habits guides you in building healthy habits by helping you set goals, track your progress and motivates you to get them done. Unlike so many other habit apps, Do Habits lets you set a goal and track it MULTIPLE times a day, not just one
bluejetty:00069997:ios.description:
Do Habits guides you in building healthy habits by helping you set goals, track your progress and motivates you to get them done. Unlike so many other habit apps, Do Habits lets you set a goal and track it MULTIPLE times a day, not just one time per day.
Do Habits will help you build great new habits and break existing bad ones.
After setting tangible daily or weekly goals, Do Habits will help you track your habits and tell you when you've met your goal. Do Habits also keeps track of Streaks when you've met your goals in consecutive periods — and with Skip Days and Vacation Mode, a rest day or a trip away won't break your streak.
The FREE version of Do Habits allows you to create up to 3 habits. For more than 3, you'll need to upgrade to the Premium Version.
Do Habits Features:
• Allows you to set and track goals on a daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly basis
• Lets you set a goal for MULTIPLE times a day, not just once like most habit apps
• Totally customizable habit display (icons and colors) - you choose what will motivate you!
• Daily journal lets you keep notes about your habit
• Fun color options and icons let you customize your list
• Easy to edit activities in the past
• Skip Days & Vacation Mode protect your streaks when life gets busy
• Multiple reminders for each habit
• Exportable CSV data with totals and time stamps
• Passcode protection with FaceID/TouchID
• Track activity with Apple Watch or Home Screen Widget
• iCloud and Dropbox data backup 
• Shortcuts and Siri Integration
Do Habits also integrates with Apple HealthKit. This lets you set and track goals automatically based on your activity. Ex. if you want to build a new great habit of getting more steps every day, our HealthKit integration will help you with this by attributing your steps data from HealthKit directly to your steps habit. Building amazing new habits has never been easier!
Do Habits PREMIUM:
• Unlimited habits/goals.
Do Habits contains optional subscription plans. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, for the chosen plan's price. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes/App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Read our full Privacy Policy and Terms of Service here:
https://growthbundle.com/privacy-policy
https://growthbundle.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00024125:ios.description:
Grid Post – Grid Maker for Instagram lets you split and crop your large photos into grids, panoramas, carousels, and collages to create stunning Instagram feeds. Impress your followers with eye-catching layouts, puzzle grids, and professional-quality designs — all in one app.
Key Features:
Custom Grid Maker – Make grids in 3x1, 3x2, 3x3, 3x4, 3x5 and more to transform your Instagram profile.
Carousel & Panorama Posts Maker - Turn wide photos into swipeable carousels or stunning panoramas for Instagram. Easily crop and split images into perfect pieces that flow seamlessly across your feed.
Photo Collage Templates – Choose from ready-to-use puzzle and collage layouts designed for every occasion — birthdays, holidays, sales, Valentine’s Day, Halloween, Christmas, and more.
Creative Editing Tools – Enhance your photos with 55+ stunning filters, text options, and custom logo or watermarks. Add stylish effects, adjust colors, and personalize every grid, carousel, panorama, photo collage or design with ease.
Fonts & Graphics Library - Unlock 600+ premium fonts and 10,000+ graphics, stickers, and icons to customize every design. Add stylish text, creative elements, and fun stickers to make your Instagram grids, carousels, panoramas, and photo collages stand out.
Design Studio - Go beyond grids with a powerful design studio packed with ready-to-use templates. Create posters, flyers, resumes, banners, Instagram stories, and more — all in minutes, without needing graphic design skills.
Easy Sharing – The app automatically suggests the right posting order so you can upload your grids and carousels step by step without mistakes.
Why Grid Post?
Grid Post is more than just a giant square maker — it’s a complete Instagram design app. From grids and panoramas to carousels, collages, and graphic design, everything you need to level up your profile is here.
Stand out from the crowd, boost your followers, and turn your Instagram feed into a creative showcase with Grid Post – Grid Maker for Instagram.Now you don't need to use applications to get followers and following on your instagram profile, just upload photos with this new style and you will get more and more followers on your instagram profile.
Download now and have a fun!
Grid Post PRO Subscription Pricing & Terms:
Grid Post is free to download. Grid Post PRO Subscription gives you unlimited access to our premium content. Grid Post PRO offers auto-renewing subscription - $12.99/year and $3.99/Month.
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Alternatively, there is a "Manage Subscription" menu option in the App Settings menu.
Read our privacy policy at http://infostringtechnolabs.com/grid-post/privacy

bluejetty:00095881:ios.description:
Mirror helps you see yourself clearly and understand your connections, using AI to reveal the patterns between you and others. Share your chart, run compatibility, and discover your unique blueprint.
Mirror is a free app that brings every major typology into one elegant home. Your astrology placements, Human Design profile, Jungian personality type, Enneagram number, Big Five scores, numerology, and more all sit side by side in a single, easy-to-read dashboard. Use these scores to explore what makes you - you! Instantly compare your charts and personality with friends, dates, or partners to see exactly where your vibes align or diverge. Soul mates? Or Trauma bond? 
Features
- All your charts in one place. A 360° psychological blueprint combining your birth chart (both western and vedic), personality metrics, and energy type distilled into plain language and crisp visuals.
- Get every chart and test you can imagine for free. Western and Vedic Astrology, Human Design, Mayan and Chinese Astrology, Life Path, plus modern systems like Jungian Personality (ENTP, INFJ, etc.), Enneagram, Big 5/OCEAN, and DISC. Mirror adds new tests all the time.
- Daily Lens. personalized mantras, journal prompts, and real-time friend insights, all tuned to the dynamic interplay of your charts.
- Read personalized daily mantras, journal prompts and horoscopes.
- Receive daily push notifications based on your horoscope for the day.
- Deep-dive reports that turn every chart into clear, practical self-knowledge.
Premium Features
- Mirror AI. We call it “Ask,” your AI-powered companion for quick, nuanced answers to any self-discovery questions and questions about your relationships.
- Unlimited Compatibility Reports. Run instant romantic, friendship, or work reports to reveal chemistry, friction points, and communication hacks.
- Custom Friend Charts. Spin up a friend’s chart in seconds and see your chemistry ignite on the spot. to see how you match up.
- Unlimited AI Prompts: ask Mirror as often as you like for tailored insight into you, your partner, and every relationship nuance.
Mirror is free to download and try. Upgrade to a monthly or yearly plan to unlock Premium Features—unlimited compatibility reports, AI chat, and deeper self-discovery tools. Subscriptions renew automatically through your iTunes account unless you turn off auto-renew in Settings. Cancel anytime.

bluejetty:00128614:ios.description:
The new ADT+ app brings together the security of ADT, smart home management, and other innovative features to bring peace of mind to you and your family. It allows you to control everything, including your ADT+ home security system, Google Nest devices and other compatible smart devices.

bluejetty:00078973:ios.summary:

It’s the best video editor a
bluejetty:00078973:ios.description:
Media Monster is an amazing camera app that gives you the ability to capture high-quality videos and photos. Not just that, with Media Monster you can simultaneously play and record music from your iOS device!
It’s the best video editor app that brings your videos to life with the perfect soundtrack to remember them by. So, if you love having total control over your camera, the perfect app has just knocked on your door!
Why do we stand out from the crowd?
**Powerful video & music recorder duo
Media Monster works with different music apps on your device so whatever music you play, we will make sure to capture it in your videos. This video recorder is ideal for capturing the right party snaps, perfect road trip footage, soothing yoga sessions, or adventure-filled camping trips along with your daily workouts and dance routines. The possibilities are truly endless. Just utilize this background recorder and enjoy flawless video recording with music in one go.
**Apple Music, Spotify and Youtube support
The in-app music player integrated on your device can be directly connected and controlled via Media Monster. You can also browse and play a video from Youtube and record or capture photos while the Youtube video plays in the background.
**Record videos in 4k
We’ve built this movie maker to provide the highest quality video your phone is capable of supporting (we support till 4k). No lag time. No distortion. Just seamless camera quality and sound integration. Welcome, this easy way of merging the highest quality videos and music into one, with open arms!
**Exceptional video recording & editing
We’ve also built a ton of extra editing features to help make sure you get the right look every time. From auto-focus and stabilization to brightness and movement detection, we want you to have the power to capture high-quality videos in any setting. Once you’ve recorded a video, use our easy tools to edit, merge, and smarten your videos in a jiffy.
**Adjustable Camera quality
Choose from a range of different camera types and formats for both front and back cameras or just use the default. It won’t let you down!
Numerous supported camera types (depending on the device):
- True Depth
- Dual Camera
- Wide Angle
- Telephoto Camera
- Ultra-Wide Angle
- Triple Camera
**White balance, exposure & focus controls
Even though the exposure, focus, and red, green, and blue colors are automatically set by default, you can easily control them before or even during a live shoot!. 
**Import & Edit
Edit photos or videos even if they were not captured with Media Monster.
**Bluetooth & AUX
If you like to listen to music on Bluetooth devices or record sound with a microphone, we support you. Bluetooth support helps you when you are connected to an external device without having to experience any interruptions. Bluetooth remote controls can also be used to toggle recordings and capture photos.
**Import raw audio and video files
This music video maker supports the function of playing audio and video files which can be imported from your iCloud or Camera Roll. These files can then be watched or played in the background while you record your videos. Other features include a teleprompter, grid, fullscreen, autofocus, timer, filter, portrait & landscape orientation, backup storage, and the ability to add music and background audio to videos.
Note:
You can enroll in a Media Monster Membership for extra features and support. Depending on the subscription option, it renews each month or year, depending on the billing cycle you choose. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time by going to your device's Account Settings after purchase. Your payments will be processed by iTunes within 24 hours of the end of the current monthly cycle. Unfortunately, refunds can't be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms: https://mediamonsterapp.com/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://mediamonsterapp.com/privacy.html

이용대상 ｜ 만 13세 이상 (만 13세는 회원가입 필요 )

2시간권 : 1일권 2천원 / 정기권 1주일 4천원, 1개월 7천원, 6개월 2만원 , 1년권 4만원
01. 이용권 구매
‘서울자전거 홈페이지’ 또는 ‘서울자전거-따릉이’앱에서 구매할 수 있습니다.
앱은 스마트폰 앱스토어에서 다운받아 설치하시면 됩니다.
02. 대여하기
- LCD형 따릉이 : 대여화면에서 자전거 번호 입력 -> LCD 에 이용권번호 입력하여 대여가능합니다.
- QR형 따릉이 : QR코드 촬영 후 따릉이 이용이 가능합니다.
03. 안전주행
주행전 브레이크와 타이어, 체인 상태를 꼭 확인하세요.
주행시 이용자 안전을 위해 안전모 등 안전장구를 착용하고, 교통법규를 준수하세요.
안전한 따릉이 운행을 위해서는 이어폰 사용을 자제해주세요.
04. 반납하기
서울 시내의 모든 사울자전거 대여소에 반납 할 수 있습니다.
자전거 잠금장치를 잠그면 반납처리 됩니다.
('반납되었습니다'라는 음성멘트와 안내문자를 통해 정상처리여부를 꼭 확인하세요!)

bluejetty:00074229:ios.name: Xasteria: Astronomy Weather
bluejetty:00074229:ios.summary:
Xasteria helps you decide if tonight is worth observing. It brings together astronomical weather forecasts, sky conditions and observing tools in one ad-free app, built around the 7Timer ASTRO forecast.
Configurable forecast sources:
• 7Ti
bluejetty:00074229:ios.description:
Xasteria helps you decide if tonight is worth observing. It brings together astronomical weather forecasts, sky conditions and observing tools in one ad-free app, built around the 7Timer ASTRO forecast.
Configurable forecast sources:
• 7Timer / GFS, worldwide coverage, ~20km resolution:
 · Cloud cover (with layer breakdown)
 · Astronomical seeing
 · Atmospheric transparency
 · Temperature and humidity
 · Rain / snow
 · Atmospheric instability
 · Wind speed and direction
• MET Norway, based on the ECMWF model, particularly useful in regions with significant terrain variation
• Multi: combines MET Norway’s short-term forecast with 7Timer astronomy data. Disagreements are highlighted.
Sun/moon details:
• Sun / Moon rise, set and twilight times.
• Moon phase and elevation.
Tools:
• Aurora forecast, with worldwide and local data/maps.
• ISS and satellite passes for your location, plus NASA’s ISS Live Feed.
• Interactive Light Pollution map using World Atlas 2015 or Xasteria/VIIRS 2025 data.
• Quick access to Clear Outside, Meteoblue, Windy, Astrospheric, Sat24, water vapor satellite imagery and more.
Display
Three display modes: 7Timer icon/graphic view, color-stripe view, or raw text. The left panel can be switched to icons, and summary icons and cloud layers are configurable in settings.
This app will always be ad-free, with no in-app popups asking for reviews. If you would like to support it and the 7Timer service, Xasteria Plus adds an Apple Watch app, Home Screen widgets, OpenWeather real-time forecasts, Apple Weather, satellite maps and tracking, night vision mode, lunar calendar, solar eclipse tools and more.
A quick rating or review on the App Store is always appreciated. For suggestions or feedback:
http://astro.ecuadors.net

bluejetty:00142430:ios.description:

With the Flow Photo Art, you'll have unlimited artistic possibilities, and in just a few steps, you'll be able to achieve the most subtle artistic results.

bluejetty:00148825:ios.summary: O aplicativo Maratone a Bíblia é uma proposta inovadora de ler e estudar a Bíblia de Gênesis a Apocalipse. A ideia foi idealizada por Philippe Azevedo (@mapasdoph) e segue sendo uma das formas mais criativas de manter a constância na Palavr
bluejetty:00148825:ios.description:
O aplicativo Maratone a Bíblia é uma proposta inovadora de ler e estudar a Bíblia de Gênesis a Apocalipse. A ideia foi idealizada por Philippe Azevedo (@mapasdoph) e segue sendo uma das formas mais criativas de manter a constância na Palavra de Deus.
Maratone a Bíblia surgiu da necessidade de incentivar homens e mulheres a dedicarem mais tempo para as Escrituras. Afinal, todo mundo maratona uma série ou vários filmes por vários minutos seguidos. Agora com o app será possível fazer isso também com a Bíblia.
Uma de suas ferramentas é o Pomodoro Timer, técnica que ajuda no foco e concentração. Com isso, é possível driblar distrações e ter mais foco para estudar a Bíblia, de forma simples e prática. 25 minutos de concentração de leitura e estudo e 5 de descanso.
O app Maratone a Bíblia conta com três versões de Bíblia: ACF (Almeida Corrigida Fiel), NVI (Nova Versão Internacional), que possui uma linguagem mais acessível, e a JFA (João Ferreira de Almeida), que traz uma tradução mais clássica. O usuário também pode optar por ler e estudar a Bíblia de forma física.
No app Maratone a Bíblia, estão disponíveis os 66 livros da Bíblia, divididos em: Pentateuco, Livros históricos, Livros poéticos, Profetas maiores, Profetas menores, Evangelhos, Atos, Cartas e Apocalipse.
Pentateuco: Gênesis, Êxodo, Levítico, Números e Deuteronômio
Históricos: Josué, Juízes, Rute, I e II Samuel, I e II Reis, I e II Crônicas, Esdras, Neemias, Ester
Poéticos: Jó, Salmos, Provérbios, Eclesiastes e Cantares
Profetas maiores: Isaias, Jeremias, Lamentações, Ezequiel e Daniel
Profetas menores: Oseias, Joel, Amós, Obadias, Jonas, Miquéias, Naum, Habacuque, Sofonias, Ageu, Zacarias e Malaquias
Evangelhos: Mateus, Marcos, Lucas e João
Atos do Apóstolos
Cartas Paulinas: Romanos, I e II Coríntios, Gálatas, Efésios, Filipenses, Colossenses, I e II Tessalonicenses, I e II Timóteo, Tito e Filemon.
Cartas Gerais: Hebreus, Tiago, I e II Pedro, I II e III João, Judas.
Profético: Apocalipse
Ainda no aplicativo, o usuário consegue visualizar os livros mais lidos e populares da plataforma.
Dentre as funcionalidades, o app Maratone a Bíblia registra quantos capítulos o usuário leu e a quantidade de minutos/horas que ele passou lendo a Bíblia. Isso permite que o cristão acompanhe a sua evolução na leitura e estudo bíblico. Na leitura digital, ele consegue marcar os trechos mais importantes e até copiar para compartilhar com amigos e familiares.

bluejetty:00015309:ios.name: I Am Saving
bluejetty:00015309:ios.summary:
If you give your child pocket money on a weekly basis, this app will help them learn to save.
A parent or a child sets up a saving goal by telling the app what they'd like to save for, how much it costs, how much money they have now and ho
bluejetty:00015309:ios.description:
If you give your child pocket money on a weekly basis, this app will help them learn to save.
A parent or a child sets up a saving goal by telling the app what they'd like to save for, how much it costs, how much money they have now and how much they receive weekly. The app then visualizes the progress and tells the child mow long then need to keep saving.
The app also helps form a good habit of logging incomes and outcomes. Every time the child receives pocket money or spends some, they open the app and input how much money they received or spent. After doing that, they see an updated progress towards their saving goal.
The goal can be adjusted any time: may be the price of the thing they want has changed or you opted to start giving them a different amount of money every week. May the kid just changed their mind, that's totally fine.
Finally, when the child has saved enough to buy what they wanted, the app congratulates them with their achievement and offers to set up a new goal.
NOTE FOR PARENTS
Help you child setting up their goal for the first time and encourage them to save by offering them a piggy bank or something similar.
The app works best for children of ages 6–12. If the child doesn't yet know how to count money, offer them your help.
PRIVACY
We're taking children's privacy very seriously. The app does not collect or send any data. Nobody except you have access to your data. You own it and it stays on your device.

bluejetty:00080408:ios.description:
Can you escape Hidden Ryokan is a free 3D escape room game set in a hidden Japanese inn deep in a quiet forest. Gather the clues, find hidden items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play to the end.
Flowing gardens in quiet moments, a breeze lightly scented with fresh green leaves.
Numerous mysteries unfold in the quietly standing inn.
Can you gather clues and escape from here?
Please enjoy the leisurely time enveloped in the tranquil silence of the forest. Explore the ryokan, search for the clues hidden inside, and find your way out.
■ Renewed for clearer puzzles
We've adjusted the difficulty of the puzzles for clearer gameplay. And you can now save the clues you want to check again at any time, so you can quickly look back at specific parts whenever you need them.
■ An escape room game anyone can clear
The difficulty is set for beginners to intermediate players. Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers are provided, so even if you've never played an escape room game before, you can play casually and clear it all the way to the end. Look closely, think it through, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.
If you love mystery games, puzzle adventure games, or hidden object games, you'll feel right at home. Tap every place that catches your eye, collect items and hints, and use them to get the keys and open the way out.
■ Observation and quick thinking
Tap on any area you're curious about—you may find an item or a hint. Use everything you find to obtain the keys. In this point-and-click escape game, sharp observation and quick thinking are what lead you out. Piece the clues together like a detective, one by one.
■ Hints and answers when you need them
Stuck on a puzzle? Check Hint 1 first, and if you still need help, Hint 2. The answer is there too, so you never have to give up halfway. Use as much help as you like and enjoy the mystery at your own pace.
■ A quiet Japanese inn in the forest
A garden where time flows slowly, a breeze carrying the scent of fresh green leaves, and an inn standing quietly as if hidden in the woods. Between puzzles, take a breath and enjoy the tranquil silence of the forest.
■ Play anytime
Your progress is saved automatically, so you can play a little during a short break and pick up where you left off later. Or settle in on the weekend and aim to escape all at once.
■ Features
・Puzzle difficulty adjusted for clearer gameplay
・Difficulty for beginners to intermediate players
・Hint 1, Hint 2, and answers
・Save clues to review later
・Autosave
・Beautiful 3D graphics
・Free to play
■ How to Play
・Tap on areas of interest
・You can obtain items and hints
・Use them to obtain keys
・Observation and quick thinking are key
■ Recommended for
・Beginners trying an escape room game for the first time
・Fans of room escape games, mystery games, and brain games
・Players who enjoy point-and-click adventures and finding hidden items
・Anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle game to play in short breaks
・Anyone who loves Japanese inns, gardens, and the quiet of the forest
■ More escape games from ArtDigic
ArtDigic creates 3D escape games set in beautiful villas, seaside houses, and resorts around the world. If you enjoy Hidden Ryokan, look for our other escape room games and continue your journey from one mystery to the next.
Can you escape from the inn hidden in the quiet forest?
Enjoy your leisurely time.

bluejetty:00130524:android.description:
"Survivor Master-Sifu" is a roguelike game. You will play as a wandering swordsman and learn various skills and techniques from various martial arts sects in it.
As the Jianghu is in chaos, many sects are fighting over peerless secrets that can change the world.
At that time, you're just a nameless swordsman, but you own one of the peerless secrets, which many sects are chasing after. The secrets on you will involve you in the unescapable Jianghu disputes, which is an adventure that includes the risk of losing your life at any time.
If you want to be an ordinary swordsman, then you must leave the Jianghu after destroying the secret.
If you want to become a grandmaster of martial arts, then embark on your cultivation journey! You have to defeat countless enemies and improve your skills, then escape the siege of countless martial-arts masters and fierce monsters. Try your best to survive survive to the end!
Game Features:
[Casual Game with One-handed Operation]
With an ultra-convenient operating system, you can play the game with one hand. Not only easy to play, but also full of fun. You can open the game at any time, and enjoy a relaxed and enjoyable game time beyond your busy work and life.
[Become the Master of Jianghu while AFK]
Get abundant free resources while AFK. It only takes a second to get a lot of game resources. The game accumulates free resources easily and quickly, so you can enjoy a more pleasant game experience.
[Endless Customization Options]
Over 100 different costumes and accessories, which can be freely matched to create a unique fashion style. Make your character stand out from the crowd! Customize freely in the game, show your fashion taste and creative inspiration to the fullest, and enjoy the infinite charm of fashion.
[Diverse Gameplay and Numerous Resources]
Diverse modes and 10+ dungeon challenges are waiting for you to conquer, as well as 10+ funny minigames. Try a variety of different challenges and events, and get numerous game resources and rewards. Through continuous efforts and accumulation, you can challenge the peak of martial arts and become the strongest one who dominates the Jianghu.
[Various of Free Perks to Claim]
There are different events with free perks every day, which can be claimed just by logging in. You can also get various gift packs and participate in limited-time events for free.

bluejetty:00061385:ios.description:
LuxTrust Mobile – carry out your most sensitive online operations directly from your smartphone and without using any hard devices (such as the classic Token or a Scan).
WHAT DOES LUXTRUST MOBILE DO?
LuxTrust Mobile allows you to:
- Securely access our partner websites (banks, e-government, …)
- Confirm and validate online financial transactions
- Sign documents electronically directly 
- Perform various operations on guichet.lu
HOW TO ACTIVATE IT?
If you already are a LuxTrust customer and have your Token or Scan at hand, simply install it and follow the steps indicated in the app. 
If you are not a LuxTrust client and you want to use the app, order your LuxTrust electronic identity on www.luxtrust.lu. 
HOW TO USE IT?
LuxTrust has three main modes:
- App2App: Once set-up in your banking app, LuxTrust Mobile can automatically exchange with it so that you do not need to enter an OTP (one-time password). You just have to confirm or cancel the operation. Please check with your bank how to enable this feature.
- Scan the QR code (mosaic image) when connecting to a website using a desktop or tablet: You will select LuxTrust mobile instead of the Token for instance. You can then scan the QR code displayed after entering your User ID and Password. The app decrypts the image and generates the OTP (one-time password) you need to insert on the website.
- Receive a Push Notification when accessing to our partners’ website from a desktop, tablet or smartphone. Partners’ websites having this feature enabled will automatically send you a notification asking you to confirm or cancel the specific operation. You can also find it under “Pending transactions”.
OTHER FEATURES
You can activate your LuxTrust Mobile app on a second device (like a tablet) and enable TouchID or FaceID to unlock it, for more convenience.
DO YOU NEED HELP?
If you have any questions or need help, feel free to contact our Helpdesk at +352 24 550 550 or by email at: helpdesk@luxtrust.lu.
SECURITY NOTICE
Before installation and as well as during utilisation, please ensure that your devices (smartphone, tablet, etc.) are appropriately secured and protected. For security reasons, LuxTrust do not accept rooted or jailbroken devices and cannot be held liable in case such devices are used.
To remain protect at all times, do not disclose your security codes, PINs, and passwords to anyone. 
If you suspect that your device or credentials have been compromised, stop using the app and immediately notify LuxTrust by telephone at +352 24 550 550. Our colleagues from Helpdesk will offer you support and guidance. 
ABOUT LUXTRUST
LuxTrust is leading European electronic identity and trust services provider. Certified and acting in compliance with the latest European regulations (eIDAS, PSD2, GDPR, ETSI), LuxTrust delivers digital services related to the identification and authentication (required to equip individuals with a valid electronic identity and to secure access to websites and applications) and the creation and validation of electronic signatures.

bluejetty:00070844:ios.description:
Spend a full day with Caillou and learn through more than 30 fun educational games!
Would you like to join Caillou in his daily routine? Wake up, get ready, go to school, play in the park, and end the day at home in this delightful interactive adventure designed especially for young children.
From morning to bedtime, kids will help Caillou complete everyday activities while developing essential skills through play. Learning has never been so fun!
SUNRISE
Start the day by learning the time, getting Caillou dressed, preparing breakfast, brushing teeth, and walking safely to school.
MORNING
At school, children will practice math, spelling, music, languages, memory, perception, and more through 11 engaging games.
AFTERNOON
Time for outdoor fun! Play sports, recycle, go shopping, and enjoy activities in the park with Caillou and friends.
EVENING
Help Caillou bathe, tidy his room, make pizza, feed the pet, and get ready for bed.
BONUS ACTIVITIES
- Snakes and Ladders board game with minigames
- Over 30 collectible puzzles
- Drawing, coloring, and sticker activities
FEATURES
- Educational game for ages 3–6
- Step-by-step instructions with visual aids
- Reward system that motivates learning
- Encourages independent play
- Parental controls
- Endorsed by early childhood education specialists
- Available in 8 languages

Web: http://www.taptaptales.com

Bringing joy to children and contributing to their development through the creation and publication of amazing interactive adventures full of fun educational activities.
Motivating and helping the kids to accomplish the tasks of the educational game.
Learning and growing with our users, adapting to their needs and sharing happy moments with them.
Helping parents and teachers in their educational and caring endeavors with young children, offering them top-quality, state-of-the-art learning applications.

bluejetty:00187713:ios.description:
The One Bible App: Your Daily Companion for Reading, Studying, and Growing in Faith
Experience the power of God's Word with The One Bible App! Get access to multiple Bible versions, dynamic study tools, and daily inspiration – all within one easy-to-use app. Whether you need a specific verse, want to dig deeper into scripture, or listen to the Bible on the go, The One Bible App has you covered.
Key Features:
Multiple Versions of the Bible: Read whatever translation you prefer, such as KJV, NIV, ESV, AMP, NASB, and others!
Offline Study: Save Bible versions and available audio to read and study offline – great for when you are on-the-go.
Audio Bible: Hear the Bible being read with the handy audio feature (on certain versions), great for commutes or multitasking.
Parallel Reading: Studying multiple Bible versions? Use our parallel reading feature to have a side-by-side view of two different Bibles.
Easy Navigation: Locate any book, chapter, or verse instantly with our clean and simple navigation.
Search Capability: Search quickly and relevantly by keyword, topic, or passage to locate what you're looking for.
Note-Taking & Highlighting: Make your study your own by taking notes, highlighting verses in multiple colors, and underlining passages of significance.
Bookmarks: Bookmark your favorite verses and easily go back to them for additional reflection.
Verse of the Day: Start your day inspired by a daily Bible verse that supports your walk in faith.
Reading Plans & Devotionals: See committed devotionals and reading plans aimed to take you through particular topics or books of the Bible.
Topic Explorer: Read Bible verses addressing a variety of issues and stories, making it easier for you to understand the Bible.
Red Letters: Instantly display the words of Jesus in red (in most editions).
Bible Reading Tracking: Track your progress and mark passages as read.
Sharing: Share verses and links with others via email, text, and social media.
Account Sync: Back up and sync your notes, highlights, and bookmarks across all your devices with a One Bible account.
Customization: Modify font size, type and choose between light or dark mode for a personalized reading experience.
The One Bible App is your one stop for all things Holy Bible. Not only a digital Bible but a comprehensive tool to read, study, and live out your faith on a daily basis. Get The One Bible App today and start experiencing the life-altering Word of God!

bluejetty:00134313:ios.summary:
The rescue team led by the brave Jessica is in a hurry to help everyone and help the city to regain peace and order! Walk the whole adventure with her and acquire new friends and a cheerful mood.
Help
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a re
bluejetty:00134313:ios.description:
The rescue team led by the brave Jessica is in a hurry to help everyone and help the city to regain peace and order! Walk the whole adventure with her and acquire new friends and a cheerful mood.
Help
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a rescuer and helping people? It's so great to swim in the rays of gratitude of the city's residents! This game gives you a chance to make this dream come true! Now city residents are in a panic - wild animals roam the streets, scare children and destroy city property! Who, if not rescuers, can restore the normal way of life!
There are many quests to overcome, from putting out fires to cleaning up after hurricanes! In the meantime, you will rescue cute animals, frightened children and civilians from troubles. You will have to clear rubble, remove trash, rebuild roads, get to the animals through a series of difficult obstacles and feed them tasty treats.
To complete your mission, you need speed, ingenuity, and the ability to be a team player!
Exciting Events Await!
Take part in thrilling regular events that will put your rescue skills to the test! Join the Hospital Event to assist doctors and nurses in saving lives, explore ancient mysteries in the Egypt Archaeology Event, and take on daring missions in the Train Rescue Event, where every second counts. Each event brings unique challenges, exciting tasks, and rewarding experiences that will keep you engaged and ready for action!
Earn points
In the course of the quest, you will need resources that have yet to be collected. Develop your own strategy to help you complete tasks in as efficient and as simple way as possible. And don't forget about the time limit! Remember that, if you fail to meet the deadline, the points that had taken you so much effort to earn, will be canceled. In short, be alert!
By the way, timely task completion is great to develop self-restrain and teach you to always be collected!
Harder with each step!
The complexity of the game increases with each next level, which means you won't get bored. Unlock new locations, pass through challenging mazes, solve tricky puzzles and receive generous rewards for a job well done!
Develop your characters and compete with other players for the title of champion of the Rescue Service! There are advantages to playing as a team: other players will support you if you run out of energy! And of course having fun together is always more enjoyable.
More possibilities!
You can pump up your character faster if you buy additional packages of resources and bonuses. They are not expensive but they will make the quests even more interesting! After all, if the character is properly pumped up, he will perform tasks faster and better than others!
Enjoy the game
Time-management games are timeless classics, and Rescue Team is yet another testament to this. Enjoy excellent modern graphics, dynamic gameplay and pleasant music. The game is installed on a smartphone or tablet in one click and does not require a lot of free memory. The controls are intuitive - follow the on-screen prompts and guide the character to where his help is most needed. Become one with your character and prove to your teammates that you are the best rescuer in this vibrant and cheerful city!
Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/rescuedash/
Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/rescue_dash/
If you have any questions, contact tech support at support@matryoshka.com.
We read every email carefully.
The Matryoshka Games team.

bluejetty:00077106:ios.description:
Let's welcome all the business and leisure travelers coming from all around the world! 
Have you ever dreamed of being a hotel owner? This strongly addictive hotel time management game has you covered.
Get yourself ready and build your own hotel empire, manage your staff and fulfil customers' requests to become the world’s greatest luxury hotel. Complete daily quests and get rewards to unlock new fascinating adventures and places.
What is awaiting you in this FUN game?
Operate and manage your own 5 star hotels chain with 300+ hotel levels
Manage your own team in the hotel story game
New maps and adventures all over the world
Delight your guests with time-management skills
Complete daily quests to receive new rewards and extra money
Deliver your best hotel service and room service and get likes
Upgrade your hotel rooms to the next level! 
Use Boosters to help you complete different levels 
Build your own professional hotel story
Attract more guests coming from different countries to your dream hotel and create your own hotel story in this game. Satisfy your customers’ needs on time and ensure their smooth stay to unlock more enjoyable hotel adventures. Managing a hotel has never been so exciting as it is!
Serve your customers with the best hotel service
Prepare daily hotel amenities and make sure your hotel rooms are clean before the guests check-in. Upgrade equipment to improve your serving time and ensure customer satisfaction during their stay here. Quickly react to customers' requests and cook them tasty meals with room service as fast as you can. Earn likes and extra tips for excellent 5-star hotel service you could bring to your customers. 
Become a hotel owner of a dream team
Work with the best staff and help them fulfill orders in line with hotel standards. Grab the chance to explore different hotel cultures and connect with people sharing the same hotel dream. At the end of the day, it’s your responsibility to make sure your guests are satisfied with your service without any complaints and become a great hotel manager in the hospitality industry. 
Unlock your hotel management skill with 300+ game levels
Test your time management skill and creativity in an exciting hotel business dream. Serve your customers in a timely manner by using boosters during peak time and speed up your hotel service as you expand your hotel brand. 
Get ready for an adventure to your Dream Hotel, satisfy customers' needs and expand your business to the world’s best luxury hotel!

bluejetty:00077171:ios.name: NBC Bay Area: News & Weather
bluejetty:00077171:ios.summary: The NBC Bay Area app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire and earthquake updates, traffic tracking and 24/7 news streaming tailo
bluejetty:00077171:ios.description:
The NBC Bay Area app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire and earthquake updates, traffic tracking and 24/7 news streaming tailored for San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose and the entire Bay Area.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC Bay Area in one app. Follow stories across San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose and the Bay Area, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, wildfires, earthquakes, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC Bay Area app?
If you live or work in San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose or the Bay Area, the NBC Bay Area app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC Bay Area app?
Follow Bay Area local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC Bay Area journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, regional Bay Area contests and local races
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC Bay Area anchors
Stay ahead of the weather, wildfires and earthquakes with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access First Alert Weather live Doppler radar to track microclimate conditions, wildfire movement, earthquake advisories and severe weather
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC Bay Area newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from the NBC Bay Area Investigative Unit and consumer guidance from NBC Bay Area Responds
Personalize your NBC Bay Area experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC Bay Area app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose, Berkeley, Fremont, Palo Alto, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Silicon Valley and the Bay Area who need real-time weather tracking, traffic updates and local news coverage.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election, wildfire and earthquake alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, wildfire advisories, earthquake updates, breaking news or election notices you choose.
Can I watch NBC Bay Area live in the app?
Yes. You can stream the 24/7 NBC Bay Area digital news channel, watch live NBC Bay Area newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC Bay Area provides local news, First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, wildfire tracking, traffic updates and 24/7 streaming for San Francisco, Oakland, San Jose and the Bay Area.

bluejetty:00156658:ios.description:

• Use Touch ID or Face ID to quickly log in to the mobile app

• View charts summarizing account(s)

• View and Manage your HSA investments
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX Health®

bluejetty:00030774:ios.name: Color Wheel Palette: ColorGear
bluejetty:00030774:ios.summary: Color Gear is a handy tool that helps to create harmonious color swatches. To find the right color combination, designers and artists use color theory and the basis of it: color wheels and harmonies. Or maybe you have just started to learn
bluejetty:00030774:ios.description:
Color Gear is a handy tool that helps to create harmonious color swatches. To find the right color combination, designers and artists use color theory and the basis of it: color wheels and harmonies. Or maybe you have just started to learn the basics of color science and you need a simple app to study the color harmony in practice.
Use color wheel that suits your needs
Our app supports two color models — Full Color Wheel (RGB model) and Basic Itten's Color Wheel. Color scheme by Itten is typically used by artists, and RGB is designed for online use. For both of them you can apply one of the 10 color combinations \ harmonies.
Ability to extract colors from your image
Select the desired picture from your phone and application's algorithms will extract colors. Then you can choose favorite colors and save the palette.
Get matching colors to your custom color
Just type in your color code and discover color harmonies with this particular color.
Use color editing tool
It is very important to balance the quantitative ratio of color in order to make your palette look harmonious in practice. The application has a convenient function to quickly swap colors in the images. There are 3 pictures and gradient in the palette editing carousel. You can see how the selected colors look in different ratios. 
Easy to manage and share
Also you will be able to save, export and remove palettes. To share the desired palette just choose mode — text HEX codes or image. You can always copy a particular color code under color swatch to the clipboard.
Developing Color Gear we tried to make it professional and easy to use. Two color circles, 10 color harmonies, ability to input a color code manually, and convenient palette editing tool that are always at hand in one application.

سواء كنت تريد تصميم فيديو لوسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، إنشاء مقطع يجمع ذكرياتك، أو إضافة نصوص أنيقة على الفيديو، ستجد في فيديو ماستر تجربة سهلة، سريعة، وعملية.

أبرز مميزات التطبيق:
	•	قص الفيديو بسهولة ودقة
	•	تعديل بداية ونهاية الفيديو بكل مرونة
	•	دمج الصور ومقاطع الفيديو معًا في مشروع واحد

bluejetty:00014317:ios.description:
Winning stock lists, real-time charts and up-to-the-minute market news: now available everywhere, thanks to the newly enhanced Investor’s Business Daily app.
Investor's Business Daily is proud to have been named "Best Financial Research and Data Company" in the 2023 FinTech Breakthrough Award program.
IBD Digital members now have access to their favorite premium features, IBD premium lists, charts and personal stock lists. Not an IBD member? You’ll still be able to keep up with market news, videos and information like you would on Investors.com.
Features:
• Your personal stock lists, now synced across all your devices
• Access to premium features for all IBD Digital members
• Exclusive stock lists like IBD 50, Sector Leaders, IPO Leaders and more
• The latest daily market analysis with The Big Picture and Stock Market Today
• Customizable stock list on the home screen
• Personalized news pages with embedded videos to keep you up-to-date on stocks you’re watching
• Tap stock symbols to see IBD’s exclusive Smart Select Ratings
• A widget accessible on your device home screen lets you create a personal stock list to see mini-charts, current price/volume and ratings.
• A native iOS login screen so you can use Face ID/Touch ID.
The IBD app is free to download but IBD Digital subscribers get access to premium ratings and interactive tools. IBD Digital subscription gives you unlimited access to our stock research and analysis across multiple devices—mobile, Mac and PC.
After the one month free trial, your membership will automatically renew each month/year, and you will be charged $34.99/month or $329.99/year through your iTunes account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription remains active until the end of the period. 
Try us free for 1 month! If you enjoy your IBD Digital trial, do nothing and your membership will automatically renew every month or every year, depending on your choice of subscription.
Digital Subscription Options:
Monthly - unlimited access for $34.99 per month.
Cancel anytime.
Annual - unlimited access for $329.99 per year (save $89.89). 
Cancel anytime.
If you subscribe via iTunes: 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. 
Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan above.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
If you have any questions about how the app functions or how to access to your subscription on other devices, please contact us at (800) 831-2525 or outside the United States at (310) 448-6600.
Privacy policy: https://www.investors.com/investors-business-daily-privacy-policy/
Term of use: https://www.investors.com/home/investors-business-daily-inc-terms-of-use/

Habit Rewards is a habit tracker that rewards you for completing your habits and tasks. Every check-off earns coins, points you spend on rewards you choose: a coffee, an episode, a new book, a lazy Sunday. Build the habit, earn the coins, claim the reward.
Use it as your habit tracker, goal tracker and daily routine planner in one. Most habit trackers stop at a checkmark. Habit Rewards turns your daily routine into a reward system you design yourself, so sticking with it feels worth it on day 3, not just on day 90.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add a habit and pick how hard it is. Harder habits earn more coins.
2. Check it off each day and watch your streak grow.
3. Add rewards and give each one a coin price.
4. When your balance covers a reward, claim it and enjoy it, guilt-free.
A REWARD CHART FOR ADULTS
Reward charts and token systems are not just for kids. Habit Rewards works like a token economy for grown-ups: coins are the tokens, your reward list is the menu. Fill it with small treats for everyday wins and bigger rewards to save up for. Need ideas? Start from ready-made reward samples and make them your own.
HABITS AND TASKS IN ONE APP
- Daily habits, a few times a week, or on the weekdays you choose
- One-off tasks that earn coins too, so the to-do list gets done
- Group habits into morning routine, workout, study or any list you like
- Reminders that arrive when you need them
QUIT A BAD HABIT, TOO
Switch any habit to "Quit a habit": smoking, alcohol, sugar, late-night scrolling. Every day you stay off it earns coins. If you slip, mark the day and it costs coins instead.
STREAKS THAT FORGIVE A BAD DAY
Life happens. Skip a day when you need to, and your streak survives. Forgot to check in yesterday? Check off past days too. One off day should not undo a month of work, because that is the day most people quit.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Streak counter and calendar view for every habit
- Statistics: completion rates, trends, averages and totals
- Home Screen widgets that show today's habits at a glance
- A mood journal alongside your habits
MAKE IT YOURS
- Custom icons, colors and coin amounts for every habit
- Create your own coin types
- Works offline; sign in to back up and sync across devices
HABITS PEOPLE TRACK WITH HABIT REWARDS
- Fitness: workout, steps, running, yoga, stretching
- Health: drink water, sleep on time, take vitamins, cut sugar, no alcohol
- Focus: study, read, deep work, no phone in bed, side project
- Home: make the bed, dishes, laundry, declutter, meal prep
- Mind: meditate, journal, gratitude, breathing exercises
- Challenges: 30-day and 75-day challenges, a no-spend month, Dry January
WHO IT'S FOR
- Anyone who downloaded a habit tracker, used it for four days and stopped
- People who respond better to a reward than to guilt
- Anyone building a dopamine menu of healthy treats who wants to earn them
- Adults who want a self-reward system: points for chores, workouts or study, spent on treats you pick
FREQUENTLY ASKED
Is it free?
Yes. The free plan includes 3 habits and 3 rewards, with streaks and reminders; one-off tasks don't count toward the limit. Habit Rewards Pro unlocks unlimited habits and rewards.
What happens if I miss a day?
Mark the day as skipped and your streak stays alive.
What are the rewards?
Whatever you decide. Add a reward, give it a coin price, and claim it with the coins your habits earn.
Questions or ideas? Email us at hi@habitrewards.me. We read everything.
Terms of Use: https://habitrewards.me/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://habitrewards.me/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00022401:ios.name: Used Car Tycoon Games
bluejetty:00022401:ios.summary: Do you like idle car games? Have you ever thought of becoming a rich second-hand car shop tycoon with beauties? Busy work in real life prevents you from fulfilling your desires for the time being, come and vent through the used car simulato
bluejetty:00022401:ios.description:
Do you like idle car games? Have you ever thought of becoming a rich second-hand car shop tycoon with beauties? Busy work in real life prevents you from fulfilling your desires for the time being, come and vent through the used car simulator, "Used Car Tycoon Games", a business mobile game that simulates the purchase and sale of used cars! Burn the asphalt with your fast and furious managing skills
 Though it’s not a racing game, you can feel all the pleasantness! You will start a second-hand car sales shop from scratch, attract more customers by acquisition, fixing cars, hiring employees, unlocking facilities, increasing publicity, etc, to earn profits, build a used car empire, and become an idle car tycoon. 
 Game features:
 【Various vehicle types】
 There are many car models such as worn-out vans, miniature cars, small cars, sports cars, off-road vehicles, lego cars, pumpkin cars, punk cars, different-dimensional tank cars and so on. They must satisfy your desire to collect rare cars! Enjoy this career! 
 【Many interesting game stories】
 Helping villagers build roads, helping schools upgrade school buildings, help racers win races, and help taxi companies build cheap and easy-to-use models. Get on your idle game wheels and warm-up your car tycoon engines to experience the game stories. 
 In this game, you can find vintage car dealers to buy vehicle fragments. Also, you can go to the river to salvage car wrecks with cranes. What’s more, you can bring tools to excavate debris outdoors, and hire villagers to find antique car fragments. While the collection is completed, a god-level collection with a sense of age will be assembled! 
【Car repair and modification gameplay】
 Mechanic game car fixing, paint job picking, dents repairing, welding and painting will be permanent items in your to-do list from now on, like the best hot car games and car tuning game adventures go!.
 After modification, the rear wing, aerodynamics kit, wider competition-grade tires, and unique speed coatings will give the vehicle a new look. I believe you can't wait to get them to the speedway to have the contest with passion at that time. 
【Test your brainpower】
 Do you really think this is just a game with tapping? No!
 It is also a strategy game that requires IQ. You need to consider the upgrade sequence of various elements, the logic of unlocking, and the combination of various resources to get your beloved car! 
 There are also various interesting puzzle games to make your game full of fun! 
Please note! "No Middle Merchants Earn the Price Difference" is an idle car game for free, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money. 
Are you ready to become a used car repair shop tycoon? Fasten your seat belt and start your simulation of paradise! Our classic ‘Fix and Sale My Car’ game is waiting for you to download and experience it!

bluejetty:00146949:ios.description:
Curious about Transcendental Meditation? Start here.
The TM app is your starting point for discovering the Transcendental Meditation technique—a simple, natural technique you practice with your eyes closed, without concentration or control of the mind. That effortlessness sets the TM technique apart from other forms of meditation. Explore what TM is, how it works and what learning involves, and connect with a certified teacher when you're ready.
What you’ll find inside
– Moments of clarity: short videos on stress, relationship and everyday life
– A guided journey through TM: covering the science, the technique, and what the course involves
– Real stories from meditators around the world
– Research on what TM practice does for your mind and body
– Answers to your questions via live chat, no commitment required
How TM is learned
You learn the TM technique in person, one-on-one with a certified teacher who tailors it to you. The course includes in-person and hybrid formats, and the app supports you through every step of that journey, and beyond.
No experience needed. No commitment required.
Download the app to explore what TM is and what learning involves. When you're ready, you can get in touch with one tap.
Already learning or practicing the TM technique?
Access the timer, deepen your knowledge, and continue your journey. The app supports an established TM practice with tools, content, and community.
We never sell your data or use it for advertising.
Read the Terms of Service:
https://tm.community/terms-of-service
Read the Privacy Policy:
https://tm.community/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00148133:ios.description:
FutbolEc: La mejor aplicación para seguir los torneos y equipos ecuatorianos de fútbol, ¿lo dudas?, te desafiamos a leer las más de 1500 reseñas (de todas las versiones de la app) así como los comentarios de nuestros usuarios!
¿No puedes ver o escuchar un partido del Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol: Serie A, Serie B, Superliga Femenina, Torneo de Ascenso, Copa Sudamericana, Eliminatorias, Copa Libertadores, partidos amistosos o partidos de la TRI por algún motivo?, no te preocupes! Descarga la aplicación FutbolEc y revisa noticias, estadísticas, resultados en vivo, alineaciones y videos de todos éstos partidos. Recibe también notificaciones de goles de los partidos, ¡en vivo!. 
- Equipos participantes: Listado de equipos participantes con su respectiva plantilla (información de su DT actual y jugadores), estadio, noticias y estadísticas.
- Partidos: Listado de partidos agrupados de acuerdo al torneo correspondiente. Presenta información, alineaciones, videos y resultados en vivo sobre los partidos que se están desarrollando, los próximos a jugarse y los ya jugados.
Presenta un detalle de los goles y tarjetas roja de cada partido, su autor y el minuto en que se provocó. Conoce también mayor información de cada jugador presente en la cancha.
- Posiciones: Presenta la tabla de posiciones acumulada, la perteneciente a cada una de las etapas. Conoce también la tabla de posiciones de torneos internacionales en las que participe la TRI o un equipo nacional representando a Ecuador en un torneo internacional (Copa Libertadores, Sudamericana, etc). Visualiza también el cuadro clasificatorio de las distintas competiciones, así como 8vos, 4tos de Final, Semifinales, 3er puesto, Final, etc.
- Goleadores: Presenta el listado de goleadores actuales de los distintos torneos. El listado presenta la foto y nombre del jugador, la cantidad de goles y el equipo al que pertenece. Conoce también información adicional de cada goleador.
Las notificaciones permiten informar al usuario el inicio y fin de un partido, así como cada uno de los goles que se han anotado, tarjetas rojas, etc, en vivo!!! Además estas notificaciones indican al usuario cuando estará disponible un nuevo video de su(s) club(es) favoritos.

bluejetty:00183435:ios.description:
BeerTasting.App – Your Beer Guide
Over 350,000 beers and 225,000 BeerTasters!
BeerTasting is the largest international beer community - developed in the heart of Europe and loved and appreciated by beer fans around the world. Discover new beers, find your favorites, and never forget a great beer again. With BeerTasting, your iPhone becomes a beer scanner, beer diary, and guide through the world of breweries, beer styles, and trends.
Scan & automatically recognize beer
Simply photograph the label on your bottle - the app recognizes the beer instantly. You get information about the brewery, beer style, alcohol content, ratings, and reviews. This way you can quickly find the best beer - whether it’s craft beer, pilsner, IPA, lager, wheat beer, stout, or a specialty beer.
Rate beers & keep your beer diary
With just a few clicks, you can rate beers. Adjust the sliders to your taste, add personal notes, or write detailed reviews for the community. The app becomes your beer diary and always shows which beers you liked. Your ratings also help other BeerTasters around the world.
Compare beers & discover favorites
BeerTasting gives you insights and statistics. Compare beers, discover new favorites, and keep track of your beer enjoyment. With every beer you rate, you become more of an expert and see how your taste develops.
Experience the community
More than 225,000 BeerTasters worldwide share thousands of new ratings and reviews every day. Read tasting notes, discover exciting beer styles, and connect with other beer lovers. Become part of a lively international beer community and benefit from the knowledge of thousands of beer fans.
All the facts at a glance
Beer, brewery, beer style, alcohol content, top- or bottom-fermented - in the BeerTasting.App you’ll find all information clearly summarized. Give a “thumbs up” to show you like a beer. Use the beer bottle icon to count how often you’ve had a beer. And of course, you can change your rating at any time.
Always informed & in tune with the scene
The beer world is constantly evolving: new breweries, new beer styles, trends, and festivals. With BeerTasting, you stay up to date. We report on beer events, publish brewery portraits, write about beer trends, and inform you about exciting topics like craft beer, raw ingredients, or beer enjoyment. From time to time there are also giveaways - from beer books to special beer rarities.
Find & add beers
Thanks to a database of over 350,000 beers, you’ll find almost any beer instantly. If a beer is missing, you can simply report it via a beer request - we’ll add it for you. The database grows every day, and you’ll be notified as soon as your beer is available.
Download for free now and become part of the international beer community!
BeerTasting.App – Scan. Find. Rate. Enjoy.

bluejetty:00132964:ios.name: Landlord Simulator
bluejetty:00132964:ios.summary:
Step into the shoes of a property manager!
Welcome to the captivating world of estate management, where the decisions are yours to make. Your success hinges on making the right calls and navigating the tricky web of tenant relationships. Y
bluejetty:00132964:ios.description:
Step into the shoes of a property manager!
Welcome to the captivating world of estate management, where the decisions are yours to make. Your success hinges on making the right calls and navigating the tricky web of tenant relationships. Your objective? Oversee your tenants' every move and ensure bills are settled promptly to fuel your journey towards upgrading your apartments and maximizing your earnings.
Your ethical compass becomes your greatest asset in this exciting journey. Will you opt for the path of financial gain, enforcing high rents and taking swift action against those unable to pay? Alternatively, will your empathy shine through as you offer affordable rates and provide flexibility? Embrace either choice, knowing that both avenues offer their own rewards and impacts. The consequences of your actions will mold your reputation, calling for a strategic balance between your pursuit of power and your display of compassion.
As the judge of your own destiny, the type of landlord you become is entirely within your grasp. Embrace your role and wield control over bills, room allocations, and the construction of a formidable empire. The time has come to accept the responsibility of rent collection and payments, striding forward towards payday while addressing late payments with tact. The importance of your decisions in building management will echo through the hallways and corridors of your property.
Expand your realm through strategic upgrades and extend your reach, allowing you to wield greater authority over the rental landscape. Every choice, every decision, propels you closer to your ultimate goal, while the threat of the bailiff looms should you need to enforce action. At the same time, take measures to address any pests or inconveniences that arise, all the while being conscious of the costs and the forces at play.
Forge a reputation as the estate manager who brings harmony to the lives of your renters, or create an image of a shrewd landlord who thrives on profit. Navigate the complexities of tenancy, lease management, and rental payment. As you renovate to rent and manage rooms for rent, you're crafting your own business empire.
The choices are yours to make, the consequences are yours to bear, and the legacy you craft is yours to shape. Are you prepared to rise to the occasion and emerge as the ultimate "Landlord Simulator" in this captivating journey of property management?
