bluejetty:00039076:ios.description:
Dig, Dig, and Dig!
This game is an underground mining and resource collecting game. 
Dig freely for minerals and treasures. 
Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.
◆Recommended for◆
*Those who enjoy grinding games.
*Those who want to collect many items.
*Those who enjoy creating builds in hack-and-slash games.
*Those who seek a relaxing game.
◆Game Flow◆
1: Dig and collect ores and treasure boxes.
2: Sell collected ores to get coins.
3: Use coins and materials to forge new drills.
4: With new equipment, you can dig deeper and faster.
◆Features◆
-Many Materials-
There are many minerals underground.
You may find special items in gold treasure boxes!
-Puzzle Forging-
Use the collected minerals to create new drills. 
You might create the ultimate drill if you fit the ores into the blueprint smartly.
-Random Special Effects-
Your drill might gain special effects.
Combine them effectively to strengthen your power! 
* Focus on movement speed for carrying resources quickly?
* Enhance explosions for massive destruction?
The choice is yours!
-Zen-like Relaxing Game-
No enemies.
No time limit.
No story.
All you have to do is just mine!
◆Credits◆
Sound: Koukaonrabo, Koukaonziten, OtoLogic
BGM: Music Atelier Amacha

bluejetty:00124414:ios.description:
***TRANSFORMERS ROBOTS IN DISGUISE!*** Join the battle of good vs evil, and face off as an Autobot or as a Decepticon in this strategy game of war. Choose a side, and assemble the ultimate team of Transformers the galaxy has ever seen. Join forces with Transformers characters like Optimus Prime and Bumblebee, or side with Megatron and Starscream. Use the Space Bridge to summon over 100 bots from Cybertron. Create an impenetrable defense in this building game and prepare for the final fight in Transformers: Earth Wars.
***Transformers: Earth Wars is the final fight of Good vs Evil. Which side will you choose?***
***Build***
Protect your base by building an impenetrable fortress with technology from Cybertron! Collect and store Energon and Alloy to strengthen your Auto Cannons or increase your Energon Storage. Do not let the enemy destroy your headquarters!
***Unleash Your Abilities***
Each Transformers character comes equipped with abilities. Change form to deploy stronger attacks and turn the tide of battle! Unleash Starscream’s Airstrike, break through defenses with Optimus Prime, utilize Autobot Ratchet’s healing ability and repair your team. 
***Unite!***
Form alliances with fellow Autobots and defend against Decepticon attacks in global competitions and weekly events! Plan strategies with other Decepticons and bring devastation to the Autobot bases! The global chat and alliance features make even the multiplayer experience worth fighting for!
Transformers: Earth Wars offers beautiful 3D graphics and animations that make for great game play. Go to the showroom and check out some of your favorite Transformers characters! 
Whether you’re an Autobot or Decepticon, just remember that ***Transformers characters are more than meets the eye!***

bluejetty:00120461:ios.description:
Punjab Group of Colleges “The Largest Educational Network in Pakistan” strongly believes in revealing world-class education to the potential intellectuals. The chief objective of establishing PGC app is to stand with the revolutionized world where the innovation in technology has all the dilemmas sorted for students. The app is designed to reveal just in time information, relevant course-based material for swift learning and necessary administrative updates.
PGC App provides every individual with an All-In-One Solution. The App facilitates the learning fanatics with the major features related to
1. Campus Network: Puts forward the information of 390 campuses in 111 cities
2. Programme: It exposes you to the programs offered in different cities/campuses
3. Admissions: Gives you the information on admissions and scholarships
4. News & Events: Updates you on all the happenings at various PGC campuses
5. Profile: Provides you with all the important and personal information
6. Time Table: Informs you with the weekly schedule of classes
7. Attendance: Keep track record of your attendance
8. Fee: Keeps you posted on the program fee and its submission
9. Result: An overview of your test and exam performances instantly
10. EL by PGC: Enhance your way of learning while making it handy
Striving for an ideal future of its students, Punjab Group of Colleges gives access to world-class education for the learning fanatics. The main objective of including E-Learning in this app was to make learning handy and at your fingertips. By allowing the app to be a part of your learning journey every day, you bear the capacity of sitting back home and upgrade your knowledge without wasting your time. Lamenting the fact, the app is definitely ‘A Better Solution Than Tuition.”
- The app offers hundreds of syllabus related MCQs which will benefit you to prepare and practice for the exam. Learning through this feature becomes simple and increases your overall performance. All this is supported by Practice Keypad & Results.
- Permits the user to enhance their skills and intellect by thoroughly going through Video Lectures.
-- Allows the user to prepare for the exams by directly accessing All Intermediate Boards Past Papers of last 5 years on the app for effective learning.
This app will provide you with an edge to excel in the world of learning, sharing knowledge and producing great results.

bluejetty:00085735:ios.description:
- see a real caller name for unfamiliar calls and telephone numbers, now you know whos calling you
- checking the phone number before you answer the call thanks to the offline database of scammers and spammers (1.9 million entries), do not forget to update this list inside the application! This is an option of the Automatic Phone Number Identifier - true and real time Caller ID and free blacklist
Block calls from numbers by your choice
SMS block by numbers and contained text
- Access to ALL NumBuster data about phone numbers is possible ONLY through the search bar by number within the app or when you use the function “share contact in NumBuster” from your call log in iPhone
- you can see how this telephone number is called by other people
- you can send a request to any NumBuster User in your contacts - and find your mutual acquaintances! Who are your mutual friends? It's useful, safe and just fun!
- you can find out the name who is calling from an unfamiliar incoming phone number, the caller ID works thanks to an anonymous exchange of knowledge about telephone numbers between all NumBuster Users!
- protection from fraudsters, advertising (spam), from collectors, car dealers, dealers, intruders - check the number according to current online data
NumBuster true id caller name - professional solution for your protection.
In addition to combating telephone fraudsters, advertising, surveys, dealers and financial pyramids, NumBuster constantly learns and informs you about phone numbers:
- banks
- shops
- car dealerships
- insurance companies
- collectors
- robocalls
Including virtual phone numbers, under which employees of companies and fraudsters are trying to hide!
With the help of the call number identifier you can find out whose phone number is calling and to whom it belongs, our social caller id allows you to find the name by phone number and understand where the call comes from, who is calling from an unfamiliar phone number and from where.
- The program takes into account the experience of hundreds of thousands of Users and allows you to identify most unwanted calls and sms with advertising and scammers
PC Magazine / RE: "NumBuster - App of the Year 2015!"
IMPORTANT
- Your phone number will still be able to see ONLY for those you call yourself - we carefully protect your data, contact lists and call log from intruders and are not using these in any wrong behaviour
- Numbuster does not cooperate with banks, data collection agencies, marketers and other scammers. NumBuster works for their victims, and not vice versa!
- No one can find out your phone number! No name search in the app!
- No one, including Moderators, can even theoretically access your data and the contents of your contacts. Its prohibited for evereyone.
- our User Agreement: https://numbuster.com/en/tos
The application has paid features!
• Payment for them occurs when you confirm the purchase in iTunes
• subscriptions auto-renew if you don’t cancel them 24 hours before they end
• your account will be charged the amount of payment for a subscription 24 hours before its termination, if you do not turn it off
• auto-renewal of a subscription can be turned off in the Settings of your iTunes Account.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/numbusters
There are no applications for smartphones capable of "hacking" the service of telecom operators, allowing you to call from a "hidden", "unknown" or "anonymous" number!
1) Enable call forwarding on your smartphone
2) Set up the function so that the redirection is triggered when your number is “unavailable” or “busy”.
3) In the settings of this function, enter the phone number of another smartphone (your friend or relative, who is usually with you).
4) Now, when an incoming call from the "hidden" drop the call without picking up the phone
5) The call is immediately forwarded to the number that you specified in the function settings.
6) You will see on the screen of the second smartphone a REAL number =)

bluejetty:00061447:ios.description:
Welcome to the bank you'll love. Bank, save, and invest in one beautifully simple app that's trusted by millions.
BANK
– Open your online N26 bank account in minutes — right from your smartphone. Get a physical or virtual Mastercard debit card, add it to Apple Pay, and start using it straight away. 
– Send money in seconds using MoneyBeam and instant transfers.
– Want even more perks and features? Discover our premium accounts and give your banking experience an upgrade. Choose from N26 Smart, N26 Go, and N26 Metal.
– Open your joint account in minutes and manage shared finances alongside your personal account. 
– Self-employed? Handle all your business finances with an N26 business account and get up to 0.5% cashback for every payment you make with your N26 Mastercard. 
– Send money near and far via international money transfers powered by Wise with N26. Just a few taps in your N26 app and your money arrives in 35+ countries with no hidden fees. 
– Split eligible past purchases with N26 Installments, or get approved for an overdraft of up to €10,000 in minutes (available in Germany, Austria, and Spain). With N26 Credit, you can get a loan instantly with no paperwork (available in Germany, Austria, Spain, and France).
– And if you have questions, contact us day and night via the chat in your N26 app — in five languages.
SAVE
- With N26 Instant Savings, grow your money with full flexibility, no matter what membership you have. Earn interest on all your savings with no deposit limits** and access your funds anytime.
- Achieve your goals by organizing your money into N26 Spaces sub-accounts, and automate your savings with N26 Round-ups and Income Sorter.
- Get spending insights to help you stay on track. 
* The interest rate is based on country and membership. Available to eligible N26 customers in 16 countries across Europe, including Germany, Austria, France, Spain, Ireland, and the Netherlands.
INVEST
- Trade thousands of stocks and ETFs — right in your banking app. Or select one of our ready-made funds and let the experts do the work.*
- You can start with €1, and buy and sell anytime.
- Manage your investments without having to download another app. Get a complete overview of your portfolio, transaction fees, gains, and losses.
- Not much time on your hands? Automate your investments with our free, fully-flexible investment plans.
*None of these statements constitute investment advice. Check our website for availability in your country.
TRAVEL THE WORLD WITH N26
Pack your bags — we've got the rest. Get the best exchange rates, free ATM withdrawals abroad, travel insurance, lounge access, travel eSIM connectivity, and 24/7chat support, all in one.
BE SIMPLY SECURE AND FULLY IN CONTROL
- As a fully-licensed German bank built on the latest technology, we’re always working to make sure your money is in safe hands.
- Get control over the security of your account with customizable settings in your N26 app. Lock and unlock your card, change your PIN, set spending limits, and hide your sensitive data from prying eyes — instantly and effortlessly. 
- Turn down the lights and use your N26 app in dark mode if you want to.
Imprint and Cookie Policy: n26.com/app

bluejetty:00027561:ios.description:
Oseterics Yoga, Tai Chi, Chair and Face workout for active aging
Discover the most comprehensive gentle wellness and health tracking app designed exclusively for adults in their 50s, 60s, and beyond with more than 250 senior-led workouts
Oseterics helps you maintain flexibility, balance, and vitality at any mobility level!
Ad-Free Experience: Focus on your practice without interruptions or distractions. 
Multi-Device Access: Use on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a single account. 
Progress syncs across all devices. Transparent Pricing: Monthly or yearly subscriptions with no hidden fees. 
Save significantly with annual plans. Fixed-income seniors can email us for financial assistance.
Do checkout our Mac App with advance features of follow along facial exercises as well as invite friends to share workouts
Manage Your Balance and Mobility: A Focus on Fall Prevention
Our Advanced HealthKit Integration allows you to seamlessly track vital health metrics that are crucial for managing your balance and mobility and proactively addressing Fall prevention. Monitor walking steadiness, step length, heart rate, breathing rate, and over 10 additional health metrics to gain a comprehensive understanding of your progress and overall health improvements. The app makes it easy to display graphs of your data, allowing you to easily spot any abnormalities or trends that might indicate a need for adjustments in your routine or further consultation, ensuring you stay active and safe.
Why Choose Oseterics Yoga?
*Diverse Library - Large collection of videos on gentle wellness varying from flexibility, strength to menopause and balance workouts
* Difficulty - Targeted themes meant for your graceful aging made in different difficulty levels 
* Extensive Chair Yoga Library - The largest collection of chair workouts for seniors with limited mobility, perfect for knee pain, back issues, or post-surgery recovery. 
* 50+ Expert Instructors - Learn from experienced teachers who are seniors themselves and truly understand your needs.
* Condition-Specific Programs: Arthritis relief, diabetes management, Fall prevention, hypertension routines, post-surgery recovery, knee strengthening, migraine relief, heart-healthy cardiac yoga, face exercises, lung capacity improvement, agility, improved mobility, re-energizing and so much more
Free Features
*Leverage the Health Metrics to monitor your balance & mobility. Set notifications to prompt you if pattern worsens
*Browse Real Life Stories and Podcasts for free
Smart Features for Your Journey:
* AI-powered personalized recommendations.
* Flexible 15, 30, or 45-minute daily goals.
* Workout suggestions with each workout.
* Bring your friends via sharePlay in your workouts
Progress Tracking and Sessions
* Progress tracking with achievement badges.
* Schedule your sessions with inbuilt tracker
* Target your daily goals and maintain streaks
* Workout history and favorites.
* Custom reminder notifications.
Tailored Programs Include:
* Beginner to advanced levels.
* Gentle modifications for all poses.
* Chair yoga for limited mobility.
* Regular yoga for active seniors.
* Tai Chi movements.
* Follow along Facial exercises.
Key Benefits:
* Safety First Approach
* Accessibility Focus
* Short Duration
* Gentle Wellness
Our instructors come from USA, Poland, UK, South Africa, Ireland and Hawaii, bringing diverse expertise to your practice.
More Information: https://www.oseterics.com/oseterics-yoga-terms-and-conditions/https://www.oseterics.com/oseterics-yoga-app-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00117711:ios.description:
The Entrust Identity mobile application is the new Entrust mobile platform for delivering strong identity credentials to both employee and consumer users. With this version of the application, users will continue to benefit from the authentication and transaction verification capabilities that replace hardware tokens, while adding advanced password reset capabilities for employee use cases.
One Application, Multiple Uses
The Entrust Identity application allows you to create identities and activate unique one time passcode soft token applications for use with different organizations that use the Entrust Identity IAM platforms for strong authentication.
Verify Transactions
Protect yourself when initiating any type of online transaction such as account login, financial transactions, etc by receiving confirmation of your transactions right to your mobile application. Confirm the details and enter your secure, one time passcode to complete the transaction.
Manage Employee Passwords
When password reset and unlock management becomes a burden for an IT department, allowing employees to manage their passwords right from this mobile application improves the experience for everyone. Employees will use the same strong credential they would when managing passwords through web portals to simplify the process – without compromising security.
Entrust combines security with usability for millions of customers across the globe.
For more information on Entrust and the Entrust Identity mobile applications please see:
Information on Entrust: www.entrust.com

bluejetty:00165749:ios.summary:

"How much drive space will I need for this Alexa 35 shoot?”

bluejetty:00165749:ios.description:
Everything you need to know about every camera worth using.
"How much drive space will I need for this Alexa 35 shoot?”
"What's the dynamic range of the Venice 2?”
“How long will these batteries last me on a Komodo?”
"How big is this file going to be when I export?”
If you've ever asked these questions, this is the app for you. Whether you’re making decisions on set, troubleshooting in an edit bay, or figuring out which camera to buy, CameraKit has you covered. Search over 200 cameras with a list that includes Arri, Canon, Red, Sony, Blackmagic, Panasonic and more. All specs and data sourced by hand: no AI means no hallucinations.
SPECS
Includes dynamic range, sensor size, native ISO, lens mounts, resolutions, video outputs, maximum FPS and a link to the manufacturer's website for firmware & manuals.
STORAGE
Determine how much footage you can fit on your camera card or hard drive-- or how much storage space you'll need for a given recording time. 
TRANSFER
Predict just how long it will take to move your files, whether you’re transferring to a drive or over the internet. 
POWER
Estimate how long your batteries will last, or how many you'll need for a shoot, with the option to factor in accessories like your monitor or wireless transmitter. 
SENSOR
See the sensor size for the current resolution and compare sensors between cameras.
COMPATIBILITY
See how well each camera and format performs with the latest versions of Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, Avid Media Composer, Assimilate Scratch and DaVinci Resolve. Also see if it's been approved by Netflix for original programming. 
AND MORE
Jot down observations and anything you want to remember about a camera with Notes. Compare specs or any other tool like Storage or Compatibility. Calculate film footage for 8mm, 16mm, 35mm and 65mm cameras. Save your calculations and return to them later with a tap. Mark any camera as a favorite for quick access.
"CameraKit is easily the de-facto standard and is utilized by many of our productions to demystify complex technical nuances of filmmaking."
-Andy Johnson, Netflix
"With the abundance of camera formats now out there, it’s easy to get lost with which system can do what. With the CameraKit app this information is now at your fingertips."
-Richard Lackey, CineD
"This is one of my favorites. It has every single piece of information for nearly every single camera on the market today. Comparing recording formats between cameras has never been easier."
-Shane Hurlbut, ASC
• Support •
For support, send me an email at zak@grayhourmedia.com or message me on Instagram @_zakray.
To see all supported cameras and formats, just install the app (it's free to download!) and open the main dropdown menu.
Current countries for manufacturer phone support are the US, UK, Canada, France, Germany, and China.
No internet connection required: all data is hard-coded into the app, so there’s no syncing process, and you’ll be able to access it even without a cell signal.
• Disclaimer •
The "price" feature uses affiliate links from B&H Photo Video. I receive a commission if you make a purchase from one of these links.
• About •
CameraKit is developed by Zak Ray and the team at Gray Hour Media in NYC & LA. Gray Hour produces fresh and original content for film, episodic and the web. Head to www.grayhourmedia.com to check out our work!

bluejetty:00040002:ios.description:
One Mother: Your Ultimate Spiritual Companion
An App that redefines the category, One Mother is a home for your soul—an invitation to go beyond mindfulness and experience meditations where healing, discovery, and profound transformations await. This is the spiritual tool you’ve been looking for, crafted to elevate your meditation practice and help you reconnect with the divine essence within.
With 120+ meditations channeled directly from spirit, One Mother offers more than relaxation. Each session is infused with divine codes to help you unlock your deepest potential, heal on every level, connect with your spirit guides, and manifest the life you’ve always dreamed of.
At the heart of it all is Mariya—a powerful intuitive, healer, and one of Spotify’s top meditation teachers. Through her unique blend of spirituality and divine connection, Mariya brings you unscripted meditations that are pure, spirit-led, and designed to unlock the power within.
At One Mother, we understand that meditation is not a one-size-fits-all practice. Your spiritual path is unique, and so are your needs. That’s why we provide meditations that grow with you, offering guidance for every step of your personal evolution. 
What you’ll find on One Mother:
- A variety of channeled meditations to help elevate your spiritual journey.
- Profound energy healing journeys, with effects similar to reiki or acupuncture, to restore balance and vitality.
- Instant state-shifting transmissions to elevate your mood and energy levels effortlessly.
- Deeper connections with spirit guides, the Akashic Records, and your Higher Self for profound insights and guidance.
- Light Language transmissions to awaken and activate your spiritual gifts.
- Guided past life regressions to explore and heal your soul’s history.
- Ancestral healing journeys to connect with and release inherited patterns and energies.
- Soul retrieval meditations to reclaim and integrate lost parts of yourself for greater wholeness.
- Chakra balancing practices for aligning and harmonizing your energy centers.
- Heart-healing meditations to open your heart and dissolve emotional wounds.
- Manifestation meditations to align your intentions with the universe and attract your deepest desires.
- Inner child healing meditations to nurture and heal past emotional wounds with compassion.
- Protection meditations to safeguard your energy and maintain strong energetic boundaries.
And much, much more!
WHAT ONE MOTHER OFFERS: 
Access to over 120+ guided meditations on a range of uniquely spiritual topics such as chakra alignment, heart healing, energy cleansing, manifestation, etc. 
Over 18+ different one-of-a-kind categories that are unique to One Mother. This includes light language, monthly portals, working with elementals and Gods & Goddesses, and so much more!
10+ carefully selected healing paths to help you in a specific area of your life. This is a selection of meditations to be completed over several days in relation to one topic - e.g. femininity, manifestation, self-expression etc.
Monthly meditations to help you align with the energies of cosmic events such as portal days, solstices, eclipses etc.
Meditations for every level and stage of spirituality - we are here to grow with you, wherever you’re at in you’re journey. 
New meditations are added weekly so that you always have a new soul journey to discover.
BONUSES:
All monthly plans will receive an Etheric Wings Workshop COMPLETELY FREE, worth $125!
All yearly plans will receive both the Etheric Wings Workshop (worth $125) and a BONUS Third Eye Activation Workshop (worth $175)
TERMS of USE: https://www.onemother.com/terms
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.onemother.com/privacy
SUPPORT: support@onemother.com

bluejetty:00078904:ios.summary: "Pray Daily" is your invitation to a deeper, more meaningful relationship with the Divine. Immerse yourself in a spiritual haven, where every tap, every scroll, every interaction brings you one step closer to the heart of God. Designed for
bluejetty:00078904:ios.description:
"Pray Daily" is your invitation to a deeper, more meaningful relationship with the Divine. Immerse yourself in a spiritual haven, where every tap, every scroll, every interaction brings you one step closer to the heart of God. Designed for the devoted soul, this app seamlessly combines time-tested scriptures with modern functionalities to guide, inspire, and enlighten.
Deepen Your Connection Through Prayer
Harness the profound power of prayer. With "Pray Daily," every morning ushers in hope, and every night brings solace. Our extensive database of verses ensures that your conversations with God are always heartfelt and sincere, allowing you to express your most profound feelings, aspirations, and desires with ease.
Elevate Your Scripture Reading Experience
"Pray Daily" has been built to enhance your scripture reading. Revel in the divine teachings, customize your reading experience, and let the words of the Lord resonate. From adding notes to highlighting significant passages, and from listening to calming Bible audios during daily commutes to having His word guide you even without an internet connection, the scriptures have never been this accessible.
AI Priest - The Fusion of Faith & Technology
In moments of doubt, introspection, or simply seeking understanding, turn to our advanced AI Priest. This modern marvel, powered by cutting-edge technology and infused with biblical wisdom, stands ready to assist, advise, and guide you in all spiritual matters.
Challenge and Relax with Bible Trivia
Add a dose of fun to your spiritual journey. Dive into our extensive collection of Bible trivia, quizzes, and challenges. Perfect for both ardent Bible scholars and those seeking a relaxed yet enlightening activity. Every quiz brings a new opportunity to learn, reflect, and grow.
Structured Spiritual Growth
Guidance is paramount in one's journey of faith. Our selection of Bible plans is curated to cater to diverse needs. Be it deepening understanding, seeking emotional healing, or simply walking a path of enlightenment, "Pray Daily" has a plan tailored just for you.
A Global Church Experience
Our interactive Bible games not only provide moments of relaxation but also reward you with captivating views of sacred sanctuaries from across the globe. Each jigsaw puzzle piece you collect unlocks a new perspective, a new beacon of faith.
Chronicle Every Step with God
Your spiritual journey is precious. With "Pray Daily," every insight, every revelation, and every heartfelt prayer is preserved, letting you revisit and reflect upon these cherished moments anytime.
Key Features:
A rich, immersive prayer platform for conversations with God.
Extensive personalization in scripture reading.
Instant guidance with the AI Priest feature.
Engaging Bible trivia to test and expand your knowledge.
Curated Bible study plans to guide your spiritual journey.
Unlock breathtaking visuals of churches worldwide.
Detailed logs and records of your spiritual milestones.
Join a global community of believers, deepening their faith, and drawing closer to God every day. Download "Pray Daily" now.
[Subscription]
Weekly VIP Membership offers weekly subscription for US$1.99, Monthly VIP Membership offers monthly subscription for US$4.99, and Yearly VIP Membership offers yearly subscription for US$29.99 with 3 days free trial, you can cancel the subscription before the free trial converted to the paid subscription, or you will be automatically renewed and charged every period. The price is shown in United States Dollar, actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. You can cancel your subscriptions anytime by going to your account settings in App Store.
More information about Subscription: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://privacy.woombit.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00069589:ios.summary: We have created Go Life to help people rediscover wellness through a balance of physical activity and nutrition. The app allows you to monitor physical activity carried out over the course of the day as well as nutrition, giving you a measu
bluejetty:00069589:ios.description:
We have created Go Life to help people rediscover wellness through a balance of physical activity and nutrition. The app allows you to monitor physical activity carried out over the course of the day as well as nutrition, giving you a measure of the changes that you are making to your daily lifestyle, rendering them more sustainable.
Go Life is integrated with all the products from our Go Life line: fitness bracelets, scales, nutritional balance, cardiac band and bike-monitor. It also offers the possibility of obtaining precise details regarding your training, the changes it is having on your body and what you eat. The development of the app involved fitness experts so that Go Life can provide its users with the best technical know-how in the sector.
KEY FEATURES:
- Monitoring of physical activity, nutrition, water and sleep
- More than 80 sports are supported
- Tens of thousands of foods analysed and new foods are always being added
- Accurate calculation of your caloric consumption during training
- Flexible dieting with the possibility of varying the amount of protein
- GPS* tracking for running, walking and cycling with interactive maps and the possibility of sharing and export in GPX format
- Measurement of heart rate with the camera of your smartphone
- Weekly summary of your physical activity and nutrition
- Accurate calculation of base metabolic rate
- Variation of basic liquid requirements based on the physical activities carried out
- Integration with HealthKit and CareKit to share your training and other data with the Salute app
- Publication of your workouts on your Strava feed
(*) Please note that prolonged use of the GPS function in the background can dramatically reduce the life of your battery.

bluejetty:00135495:ios.name: Zepp
bluejetty:00135495:ios.summary:
The official app for Amazfit, the Zepp app is free to use and trusted by top athletes such as running back Derrick Henry and sprinter Gabby Thomas. 
Built for sports and performance, it’s where you’ll track your training, health and recove
bluejetty:00135495:ios.description:
The official app for Amazfit, the Zepp app is free to use and trusted by top athletes such as running back Derrick Henry and sprinter Gabby Thomas. 
Built for sports and performance, it’s where you’ll track your training, health and recovery data, log your nutrition, and get easy-to-understand scores with AI-powered coaching and guidance — all protected with the highest level of data security.
TRACK MACROS: Snap a photo of your meal and instantly get calories, weight, and macronutrients. No watch required, just the Zepp App. Perfect for athletes balancing training with strict diets. Log as many meals as you want with no limits, or enter them manually if that’s easier.
HEALTH & FITNESS DATA: Vital health metrics like heart rate, sleep, stress, and blood oxygen, the Zepp App tracks your fitness progress in detail. It captures daily activity such as steps and calories burned, and advanced training data like pace, distance, speed, strength logs, and recovery insights.
SLEEP MONITORING: The Zepp App monitors sleep with precision sensors and syncs the data to the Zepp App for full recovery analysis. You'll find detailed metrics on stages, duration, breathing, and recovery quality so you know if your body is ready to train hard or needs more rest to perform at its best.
HEART HEALTH: See all your essential heart health data in one place. Track heart rate, HRV, and resting heart rate (RHR), and manually add blood pressure and blood glucose from external devices for a complete view of the most important muscle in your body.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR WATCH: The Zepp App is where you’ll find software updates for your Amazfit smartwatch, band, or ring. It also gives you access to the Zepp Store, with hundreds of downloadable mini apps and watch faces to choose from.
DATA SECURITY: The Zepp App delivers the highest level of data security, keeping your information safe and private. Safeguarded by Amazon Web Services (AWS), all data is regionally stored, encrypted, fully GDPR compliant, and never sold.
FREE TO USE: The core experience of the Zepp App is free. You won't need to pay to view data tracked by your Amazfit device, upgrade software, or import maps. You'll also get free access to a core version of Zepp Aura, your very own wellness coach. For personalized wellness advice powered by AI, Zepp Aura Premium Subscription is available for a monthly or yearly fee, but there's no obligation to sign up. 
ZEPP AURA PREMIUM: Unlocking unlimited access to Zepp Aura will provide in-depth health assessments, a personal wellness assistant, sleep music and more (region specific).
- Available in: Most countries and regions
- Subscription Plans: Monthly or yearly options
- Subscriptions are confirmed via your Google account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours in advance. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited once a purchase is made.
- Details: https://upload-cdn.zepp.com/tposts/5845154
PERMISSIONS: The following optional permissions can enhance your experience but are not required:
- Location Access: Used for automatically tracking running or cycling routes, and to show local weather
- Storage: Used to import or export workout data, as well as save workout photos
- Phone, Contacts, SMS, Call Logs: Used to display calls/notifications/texts on your watch and enable call reminders
- Physical Activity: Used to synchronize step counts and workout information
- Camera: Used for taking pictures and scanning QR codes to pair your devices
- Calendar: Sync and manage schedules
- Nearby Devices: Used to discover and connect to smart devices through bluetooth
DISCLAIMER: Zepp is not a medical device and is intended for general fitness and health management purposes only

bluejetty:00070318:ios.name: Video Buffer Pre-Recorder 4K
bluejetty:00070318:ios.summary:
Record the action that happened before the shutter! Save your device storage and skip the tedious post-game editing! Never miss a moment again!
Yes, it really records in 4K: up to 4K at 120 fps on recent iPhones (e.g. iPhone 17) and 4K at
bluejetty:00070318:ios.description:
Record the action that happened before the shutter! Save your device storage and skip the tedious post-game editing! Never miss a moment again!
Yes, it really records in 4K: up to 4K at 120 fps on recent iPhones (e.g. iPhone 17) and 4K at 60 fps on older models (e.g. iPhone 12), with your Apple Watch as a remote.
We're all used to pressing the record button and capturing life as it happens. But what if you could record things that already happened, pressing the button to catch the last few seconds? That's what makes Video Buffer so unique — you set the buffer time and hit the record when something interesting happens. You haven't missed a thing and saved your time and device storage!
Video Buffer can be vital in all kinds of ways: 
Sports coaches and parents can use the app to record in-game highlight moments as they happen.
Physical Education teachers could use buffered video footage to analyze performance and settle disputes between players.
Sports officials and referees can review their decisions using a Buffer Camera as a video assistant. 
Drivers can use Video Buffer as a Dashcam, recording unexpected events on the road without overloading device memory storage.
Skateboarders can capture only good lands and save time scrolling through many similar frames on the camera roll.
Parents can catch their kids playing, making it easy to record that funny interaction that might otherwise be lost.
Nature lovers can save time and storage while filming astonishing lightning flashes or waiting for the animal to appear or strike a funny pose.
Video Buffer features include:
- buffered video recording that ensures you'll never miss a moment
- long buffer time, up to 100 seconds
- 3 recording buttons, each with adjustable buffer time 
- DualCam Mode - record front and back camera footage simultaneously 
- option to capture only the buffer - the recording will end & save automatically
- 4K video quality: up to 4K 120 fps on recent iPhones, 4K 60 fps on older models such as iPhone 12
- custom video resolution and FPS (30-240)
- portrait or landscape orientation
- saving to iCloud or device folders with a custom prefix for the filenames
- Apple Watch support — a remote on your wrist to make it easier than ever to hit that record button
- Slow-motion support - gives sports and fitness trainers the best look at swing, ball movement, or technique. Note: Works only with some back cameras - set 240 FPS in Settings.
If you've ever missed something because you couldn't hit a record in time, Video Buffer is the answer!
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00137866:ios.description:
Welcome to MuscleFit: Your Ultimate Workout Planner!
Tailored Programs: 
Embark on a transformative fitness journey with our 28-day calisthenics and chair workout programs, designed to suit your needs.
Home Fitness Made Easy: 
No gym? No problem! Achieve your fitness goals with 28 day chair workout and 28 day calisthenics plan from the comfort of your own home.
Personalized Approach: 
MuscleFit caters to individuals of all ages and fitness levels, prioritizing health and physical appearance to help you look and feel your best.
Goal-Oriented Planning: 
Define your objectives, whether it's weight loss or muscle gain, and let MuscleFit create a professionally crafted workout plan tailored to your needs and preferences.
Dynamic Adjustments: 
Stay motivated and engaged with our ever-evolving workout plans. We adapt your routine weekly based on your progress and feedback, ensuring optimal results.
Variety and Convenience: 
Access over 500 different workouts, including cardio, strength training, and recovery exercises, all without the need for equipment. Enjoy audio and video instructions, a weight-loss tracker, and a workout timer for added convenience.
Customized Support for Your Body:
MuscleFit is designed to offer targeted assistance for your body's needs during workouts.

bluejetty:00034141:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene world of Tile Park, where your objective is to match tiles and eliminate all.
This soothing puzzle game offers a refreshing twist on classic tile matching challenges. Instead of pairing tiles, you'll need to form groups of 3 identical tiles.
The game starts with a beautifully designed board filled with various colourful tiles, each with unique icons.
At the bottom of the screen, you'll find a board to hold the tiles you select, with space for up to 7 tiles at a time.
Tap on a tile in the puzzle, and it will move to an empty slot on the board below. When you successfully match 3 tiles of the same image, they will disappear, making room for more tiles.
Since the board can only hold 7 tiles at once, strategic thinking is key. Avoid tapping on tiles randomly.
Ensure you can match 3 tiles of the same kind; otherwise, you'll fill up the board with mismatched tiles and run out of space.
When the board is full with 7 tiles and you can't make any more matches, it's game over.
Stay focused, match the tiles, and enjoy the relaxing gameplay of Tile Park.

bluejetty:00148636:ios.summary:
Daybreak: Change Your Relationship with Alcohol
Daybreak is a supportive health and wellbeing app that helps you change your relationship with alcohol. Whether you want to reduce your drinking, take a break, or go alcohol-free, Daybreak is
bluejetty:00148636:ios.description:
Daybreak: Change Your Relationship with Alcohol
Daybreak is a supportive health and wellbeing app that helps you change your relationship with alcohol. Whether you want to reduce your drinking, take a break, or go alcohol-free, Daybreak is here to support your choice—without judgement or pressure.
Changing behaviour around alcohol can be challenging, but you don’t have to do it alone. Daybreak offers a safe and anonymous space to access the information, tools, and support you need to reach your goals.
Members often say they feel healthier, sleep better, save money, and enjoy more time doing what they love—without hangovers.
What the Daybreak App Offers:
- New! Drink Tracker – Set personal goals, track your alcohol use, and visually monitor your progress. Celebrate wins with a community that understands your journey.
- Peer Support Community – Join a non-judgemental, anonymous community of people working toward similar goals. Share experiences, ask for advice, and support others.
- 100+ Personal Activities – Access evidence-informed exercises designed to help you reflect, cope with triggers, and form healthier habits.
- Safe & Private – Engage anonymously in a secure environment. Daybreak protects your privacy so you can feel confident and supported.
- Technical Support – Need help? Our team is available via support@daybreakprogram.org.
Why Download Daybreak?
- Your Goal, Your Way – Choose to cut back, quit, or simply check in with your drinking. There’s no pressure—just support for whatever goal feels right for you.
- Understand Triggers – Learn how work stress, relationships, mental health, or social pressures may affect your drinking, and get tools to manage those triggers.
- Be Inspired – Members often talk about how changing their drinking has improved their health, relationships, finances, and sense of wellbeing.
- Professionally Informed – Developed with mental health professionals, Daybreak is grounded in evidence-based approaches.
- Trusted Non-Profit – Created by Hello Sunday Morning, an Australian not-for-profit with over 10 years' experience helping people reduce alcohol-related harm.
Clinical Evaluation Results
An independent study by the National Drug Research Institute at Curtin University found that:
- People likely to be alcohol dependent reduced drinking from 40.8 to 20.1 standard drinks per week.
- Risky/harmful drinkers reduced intake from 22.9 to 11.9 drinks per week, below Australia’s health guideline of 14 drinks.
Pricing & Subscription Terms
- Free for Australians – Funded by the Australian Government, Department of Health.
- International users can choose:
 - Monthly: $12.99 AUD
 - Annual: $119.99 AUD
Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled 24 hours before the billing cycle ends. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Manage subscriptions via your App Store settings.
Terms and conditions: https://hellosundaymorning.org/daybreak-terms-and-conditions
Data Usage Guide
Daybreak primarily uses low-data features such as chat, forums, and tracking. Approximate usage:
- Light (tracking/reading): ~5MB/week
- Moderate (some interaction): ~20MB/week
- Heavy (frequent posting): 40MB+/week
Wi-Fi is recommended to reduce mobile data use.

bluejetty:00138686:ios.name: Weapon Master: Backpack Battle
bluejetty:00138686:ios.summary: Weapon Master: Backpack Battle is an addictive casual game that combines backpack management, synthesis, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay. In the world of Weapon Master, you'll play as a weapon forging apprentice, continuously explorin
bluejetty:00138686:ios.description:
Weapon Master: Backpack Battle is an addictive casual game that combines backpack management, synthesis, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay. In the world of Weapon Master, you'll play as a weapon forging apprentice, continuously exploring, crafting, and fusing materials and weapons in your backpack to increase your combat power, defeat powerful monsters, and eventually become a legendary Weapon Master.
-Backpack Management, Unique Mechanics
In Weapon Master, you'll have a dedicated backpack where you can craft weapons to boost your fighting prowess. You'll use the items in your backpack for battles and progression. Beyond just the quality of your weapons, the most important aspect is how you strategically arrange high-quality weapons in your limited backpack space. By constantly crafting better weapons and optimizing your backpack layout, you'll become increasingly powerful.
-Automated Combat, Easy to Pick Up
In Weapon Master, the only thing you need to worry about is managing your backpack. Whether it's weapons or items, just throw them into your backpack, and they'll automatically trigger during combat, making the gameplay simple and accessible.
-Use Your Wits, Overcome Adversity
Don't think you can mindlessly tap your way to victory in Weapon Master. The game's roguelike system requires you to carefully select and upgrade different skills based on your available weapons and the current situation. Additionally, the various weapon combinations can lead to unexpected changes. When you face challenges, carefully consider your skill choices and weapon layouts to help you achieve a winning streak.
-Numerous Stages, Waiting for Your Challenge
In Weapon Master, each stage is designed with many interesting elements, such as Rhinos, Egypt Pharaoh and Rockman etc.. Explore and solve puzzles, sweep through waves of elite enemies - every combat scenario is filled with enjoyment and challenge.
-Diverse Characters, Multiple Weapons
Different game characters（wukong、Luna,etc.)come with unique attributes, allowing for more exploration in gameplay. A variety of super weapons are available (Crossbow, Magic Orb, Sumeru Hammer, Ruyi Jingu Bang, etc.) to help you achieve greatness in battle.
Game Features:
1. Arrange your items in a limited backpack space and enjoy the satisfaction of efficient storage!
2. Collect rare weapons, organize your backpack, defeat enemies, expand your backpack, and enhance your combat power.
3. Certain weapons can be combined to create even stronger equipment!
4. Level up, upgrade skills, defeat bosses, and progress through the game!
Weapon Master: Backpack Battle is a super fun casual game that combines crafting, idle, and tower defense elements. The unique backpack management mechanic will bring you endless enjoyment. As a weapon apprentice, you'll embark on a journey to become a renowned Weapon Master. If you love captivating casual games, don't miss out on Weapon Master: Backpack Battle! Give it a try now!
Contact Us:
Email: weapon-master@noxjoy.com
Discord：https://discord.gg/5udMsYzZXx

- Explore a vast, infected world with secrets waiting to be discovered

bluejetty:00180789:ios.name: Onsite Inspection Survey Cam
bluejetty:00180789:ios.summary: Introducing the GPS Survey Camera, your essential tool for reporting and progress tracking on construction sites. Capture high-quality images for inspections and monitoring, documenting every project stage with precision. Easily track chang
bluejetty:00180789:ios.description:
Introducing the GPS Survey Camera, your essential tool for reporting and progress tracking on construction sites. Capture high-quality images for inspections and monitoring, documenting every project stage with precision. Easily track changes, identify issues, and keep projects on schedule with this reliable visual documentation solution.
The photos and videos you capture here will include easy GPS location stamps, notes, datetime stamps, and many more features. This app can make your survey work as simple as possible.
The Top Survey GPS Map Camera offers several key features.
The in-app camera enhances the quality of your photos and videos by adding GPS stamps.
Photo and Video Settings:
Adjust the timer, ratio, Grid and sound of your choice to click your perfect pictures or videos.
Text Settings:
Font style: Set the font style according to your preference.
Text Size: Adjust the text size to the given values.
Font color: Select the color of fonts from multiple color options.
Set the stamp background color and transparency.
Logo Settings:
Logo Size: Adjust logo size as required.
Stamp Settings:
Stamp Position: Choose from Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Right, and Bottom Left.
The survey details appear as stamps on the photo.
The photo itself directly incorporates all the survey-related details.
If you are working on any project, add the project name to the photo or video.
Company Name: You can also mention the company’s name.
Notes: Write any specification that you want to add to the photo or video; simply add survey notes.
Add precise GPS coordinates to the photo or video.
Date & Time: With geotags, you can easily create date-time stamp photos.
Address: Geotagging images allows you to add a GPS stamp to photos.
Accuracy: Determine the GPS photo location's accuracy.
Altitude: When geotagging photos, add an altitude watermark.
Here, you can create a file name with the following details:
To the file name itself, add the project name, company name, note, coordinates, date and time, address, and altitude.
Why do you need to have this app on your device?
Adding geotags to photos and adding text to videos is a simple process.
The in-app GPS camera features a date, time, and geolocation feature.
The GPS photo tagger is used for all geo-tagging camera-related tasks.
The date and time stamp appear on photos and videos taken with a GPS map camera.
The camera is equipped with notes for adding text to the photo, such as an autostamp and a date stamp.
A top survey with a date, time, and GPS map stamp is a fine combination.
The geotagging app incorporates real-time features such as a time stamp camera and location during the surveying process.
Who can use this GPS survey map camera in conjunction with the Geotagging and Timestamp Camera App?
Civil engineers, while surveying and leveling construction sites, can click photos or videos with this app.
Researchers can greatly benefit from sharing field images of GPS land surveys with others, with exact location details available on the photo map.
Those covering accident scenes or disaster management firms may take advantage of this app, specially designed for them as a geocamera.
In land surveying, the camera timestamp and photo GPS locations aid in capturing all the details in a photo before sharing it, which we will refer to as GPS images.
When real time and location are involved, you should share them with others.
The app can assist archaeologists in clicking photos or videos with precise location details, dates, and time stamps.
Download this app to support your survey work and even explore new fields. If you have more suggestions or queries, write us at: appsupport@susampinfotech.com.

bluejetty:00116603:ios.description:
Leap into a thrilling adventure with Broken Sword – Shadow of the Templars: Reforged!
The million-selling, multi-award-winning classic that defined a genre is back—beautifully enhanced and fully remastered for mobile.
Step into the shoes of intrepid American George Stobbart, as he and fearless journalist Nico Collard are swept into a mysterious journey of intrigue and jeopardy.
From the cafés of Paris to long-forgotten temples in Syria, from shadowy alleys in Spain to underground crypts in Ireland, guide George on a globe-spanning adventure, exploring exotic locations, solving ancient mysteries, and thwarting a dark conspiracy to reveal the secret truths of the Knights Templar.
FEATURES
- Solve ingenious story-driven puzzles
- Explore beautifully re-imagined locations across Europe and the Middle East
- Fully voice-acted with unforgettable characters and dialogue
- Unlock achievements that reward both progress and creativity as you play
- Remastered in stunning Full HD with enhanced audio
- Original soundtrack by acclaimed composer Barrington Pheloung
- Works completely offline
- One-time purchase
- No ads, no in-app purchases
- iCloud save support
Whether it’s your first time or a return to an old favorite, this is the ultimate way to experience one of gaming’s greatest adventures.
Based on the original game from 1996—never before on the App Store!
Differences from the 2010 Director’s Cut:
- Paris in the Fall – return of the classic intro
- Play George Stobbart – exclusively from his perspective
- Full HD – repainted backgrounds & sprites
- Toggle feature – switch back to original 1996 graphics
- Play your way – touch, controller, and mouse support
- Consequences – careful out there, George!

bluejetty:00116285:ios.description:
HeartCare – Your Smart Heart Health Tracker
HeartCare is a powerful and easy-to-use health tracking app focused on heart-related metrics. It helps you monitor, record, and understand your heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen levels — all in one place. Take control of your heart health with smart tracking and intuitive insights.
Key Features:
- Heart Rate Tracking & Recording
Log and monitor your heart rate data anytime. View detailed records and trend analysis to better understand your cardiovascular health.
- Blood Pressure Tracking
Easily log your daily blood pressure data and visualize long-term trends to monitor your heart condition.
- Blood Sugar Entry & Monitoring
Record blood glucose levels manually to keep an eye on your diabetes risk and overall wellness.
- Blood Oxygen Level Logging
Track your blood oxygen saturation to stay informed about your respiratory health.
- Smart Chart Analysis
All your health data is visualized with intelligent graphs to help you quickly spot changes and trends.
- Centralized Health Data Management
Keep all your key health records in one place, enabling more effective health tracking and management.
- User-Friendly Design
Intuitive interface that's easy to navigate for users of all ages — no complex setup or devices required.
Why Choose HeartCare?
- Specialized in heart health tracking, with essential features built around your cardiovascular well-being
- Supports manual input for multiple health indicators for full control and flexibility
- Visual data analytics help you identify trends and detect potential issues early
- Lightweight and responsive app for seamless daily health management
Start your journey to better heart health today with HeartCare – your personal heart health companion.
Subscription and Terms
HeartCare is free to download and use. Upgrade to Premium to unlock unlimited data entries and additional features with a renewable iTunes subscription.
We offer auto-renewable subscriptions in the following sizes:
- Subscriptions are available for 1 week or 12 months
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- The current subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: 
https://heartcare.calocare.life/Privacy-Policy.html
Terms of Use:
https://heartcare.calocare.life/Terms-of-Service.html
Disclaimer: HeartCare is intended for general wellness and self-tracking purposes only. It is not a medical device and should not be used for medical diagnosis, treatment, or monitoring. The information provided is for reference only and does not constitute professional medical advice. If you have any health problems, please consult a doctor. The app is not responsible for any health problems or results.

bluejetty:00088561:ios.description:
Yes Milano City Pass is the official app of the Milan municipality dedicated to all the visitors;
Explore Milan like never before with the YesMilano City Pass, the ultimate companion for three days for an unforgettable city adventure. This official city pass offers convenient access to public transportation, the city's top attractions, and a wealth of engaging audio-guided tours.
Key Features:
- 3 days validity
- Seamless Transportation Access:
Enjoy the convenience of unlimited access to Milan's extensive public transportation network (ATM). Hop on trams, buses, and the metro to navigate the city effortlessly.
- Must-Visit Attractions:
Unlock the gates to Milan's most iconic attractions with the Milan City Pass. Gain entry to renowned landmarks such as the magnificent Duomo di Milano, the historic Sforza Castle, and the world-famous La Scala Theatre and many others.
- Self-guided Tours:
Enhance your Milan experience with a plethora of audio-guided tours. Choose from a wide selection of pre-recorded tours that provide fascinating insights into the city's rich history, art, and culture. Explore Milan's neighborhoods, churches, and hidden gems at your own pace.
- Itinerary Planning:
Yes Milano City Pass app makes itinerary planning a breeze. Browse curated agenda and create your own custom routes. Seamlessly integrate public transportation options into your plans for a stress-free adventure.
- Exclusive Discounts:
As a Yes Milano City Pass holder, enjoy exclusive discounts at select restaurants, shops, and cultural venues across the city. Make the most of your visit with special offers and savings.
- Digital Convenience:
No need for physical tickets or paper passes. Yes Milano City Pass is entirely digital, accessible from your smartphone. Simply show your pass at attractions and transportation points for hassle-free entry.
- Multi-Language Support:
The Yes Milano City Pass app caters to an international audience with multilingual support, ensuring that visitors from around the world can explore Milan with ease. Available languages: Eng-Ita-Fra-Spa-Ger-Chi
Unlock the beauty, history, and culture of Milan with the YesMilano City Pass. Maximize your time in the city and create lasting memories with this comprehensive and convenient tourist pass.
Download the YesMilano City Pass app today and embark on an unforgettable journey through the heart of Milan!

bluejetty:00026519:ios.name: FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS
bluejetty:00026519:ios.summary:
Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth.
Experience both classic and new stories within the FFVII universe presented in a retro-style look combined with modern, beautifully rendered
bluejetty:00026519:ios.description:
Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth.
Experience both classic and new stories within the FFVII universe presented in a retro-style look combined with modern, beautifully rendered graphics, that’s easily accessible on the go. Team up your favorite characters and customize each one with iconic gear and weapons to defeat powerful opponents in Solo or Co-op battle mode.
・A purchase of a virtual currency in this App grants a license for the virtual currency.
For full terms of service, please see the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/ww/) and TERMS OF SERVICE FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS (https://en.ffviiec.com/static/terms-of-service).
◆ EXPERIENCE NEW AND ORIGINAL STORIES FROM THE FINAL FANTASY VII UNIVERSE
Discover the never-before told story of a young hero, Sephiroth.
Encounter new characters along the way and play as iconic heroes, such as Cloud and Zack, in the epic storylines of the original FINAL FANTASY VII and CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- in episodic installments.
FINAL FANTASY VII: The story of Cloud Strife, an elite SOLDIER operative turned mercenary. Cloud lends his aid to an anti-Shinra organization: Avalanche, unaware of the epic consequences that await him. Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of the entire world.
CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- : The story of Zack Fair, a promising young operative in the Shinra military’s elite unit, SOLDIER. The story takes place seven years before the events of FFVII. Follow the tale of Zack’s dreams and honor – and the legacy that connects him to Cloud.
The action unfolds through the characters in a modern-stylized polygon look, inspired by the original FFVII.
Even those experiencing FFVII for the first time can enjoy this expansive world in this epic saga that defined RPGs for gamers throughout the world!
◆ EVOLVED GAME SYSTEM OPTIMIZED FOR MOBILE WITH HIGH-QUALITY GRAPHICS
Immerse yourself in beautifully rendered, fast-paced command-based battle evolved from FFVII’s Active Time Battle -- now revamped to play smoothly on mobile devices with high-quality graphics. The battles give spotlight to classic FINAL FANTASY RPG elements such as, Abilities, Materia, Summons, and heart-pumping Limit Breaks, while supporting additional features on mobile such as Auto Mode and Battle Speed that make the game even more enjoyable to play.
◆ BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE THE ULTIMATE PARTY
Form a party of your favorite characters from FFVII series titles, such as Cloud, Tifa, Aerith, Zack and more! Dress them with new gear unique to FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS. 
◆ WORK TOGETHER WITH FRIENDS in CO-OP BATTLE
Lead your group of friends from around the world with up-to 3 member Co-op battle to defeat powerful bosses together! 
Follow the official #FF7EC Pages:
Website: https://en.ffviiec.com/
X(former Twitter): https://twitter.com/FFVII_EC_EN

bluejetty:00100034:ios.description:
What kind of life will your kitty live?
Become a kitten and experience every moment yourself in this cute idle life game!
From a little kitty to an elderly cat, you’ll grow step by step, making meaningful choices along the way.
Pick a career, fall in love, and enjoy unique events and adventures in a world filled only with cats.
Every choice leads to a different story, so no two lives are ever the same!
▶ Life Choices
Decide how your kitten will grow.
Choose careers, discover love, and shape a unique adventure each time you play this cute idle game.
▶ Various Careers
From artist to office worker, even a snackbar owner—each career opens new choices, special events, and fun adventures.
▶ Exciting Events & Adventures
Every event brings new surprises.
Go on adventures, make tough choices, and enjoy unforgettable moments with your kitty.
▶ Adorable Cat World
No humans—only kittens and kitties!
Live a healing life surrounded by love, career goals, and cozy adventures.
▶ Relaxed Idle Gameplay
Play free and offline anytime, anywhere.
This idle cat life game always offers a healing experience!
Sometimes you’ll choose love, sometimes a career in an office, and sometimes a snackbar adventure.
Each choice can completely change how your kitten will grow and what events unfold.
Download Cat’s Life: Cute Simulation Game now and start your own kitty adventure—idle, healing, free, and offline!

bluejetty:00180167:ios.description:
Titan Smart World is the official companion app for Titan Smartwatches, bringing together health tracking, fitness insights, smartwatch customisation, and smart connectivity in one seamless experience. Designed to help you stay informed, active, and connected, the app empowers you with meaningful insights while making everyday interactions with your smartwatch effortless.
Whether you're tracking your wellness, managing your workouts, or personalising your watch, Titan Smart World helps you get the most out of your Titan Smartwatch.
Key Features
Comprehensive Health Insights: Monitor your daily, weekly, and monthly health trends with easy-to-understand summaries across key wellness metrics, helping you make informed decisions about your well-being.
Smartwatch Customisation: Manage your Titan Smartwatch with ease—from watch faces and settings to notifications and device preferences—all from one place.
Personalised Dashboard: Make the app your own by customising your dashboard with widgets and layouts that highlight the information you care about most.
Personalised Wellness Goals: Stay focused on your health with the Focus Wheel, allowing you to prioritise the wellness metrics that matter most to your lifestyle and goals.
Fitness & Activity Tracking: Track your workouts and sports activities, review your performance, and share your achievements with friends and family.
Apple Health Integration: Keep your health data in sync by seamlessly connecting with Apple Health, giving you a more unified view of your wellness across compatible apps and devices.
Multilingual Experience: Experience the app in your preferred language with VANI (Vernacular Access for Native India), supporting 9 Indian languages for a more personalised experience.
Light & Dark Themes: Choose between light and dark modes for a comfortable viewing experience in any environment.
Seamless Performance: Enjoy a clean, intuitive interface with smooth navigation, reliable device connectivity, and optimised performance designed for everyday use.
Download Titan Smart World today and unlock the complete Titan Smartwatch experience—track your wellness, achieve your fitness goals, stay connected, and personalise your smartwatch, all in one app.

bluejetty:00097409:ios.name: Tatami ∞
bluejetty:00097409:ios.summary:
Tatami is a casual puzzle game where you fill the board with boxes of the specified size. If you like thinky games like Shikaku, Picross, or Sudoku, but wish for shorter pick-up-and-play levels, you’ll love Tatami.
Things start simple, but
bluejetty:00097409:ios.description:
Tatami is a casual puzzle game where you fill the board with boxes of the specified size. If you like thinky games like Shikaku, Picross, or Sudoku, but wish for shorter pick-up-and-play levels, you’ll love Tatami.
Things start simple, but as soon as you get comfortable the game gets a little trickier and a little weirder. And then some more! But it stays a kind game: there are no timers or scores, and you can skip any level with no penalty.
And the levels never end! There are enough high quality, procedurally generated boards to last you a lifetime. On the road to infinity, there are over 100 special handcrafted levels full of surprises. And maybe there’s a super secret, super tricky challenge hidden somewhere; I’m not at liberty to say.
The first two hundred levels are free, and the rest can be unlocked with a single in-app purchase. The same purchase allows you to customize the game with themes and cute alternative icons.
Your progress is synced and dark mode is supported, so you can play anywhere, anytime, on the most convenient device. And obviously: no ads, no tracking, no data collection, no account required, no dark patterns. Just a honestly fun game to keep you company when you need a little break.
This game was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.
– Kaylee
Terms & Conditions: https://kaylees.site/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00162237:ios.summary:

This Is All Boyner!
We continue to work to provide you with a seamless
bluejetty:00162237:ios.description:
At Boyner, Türkiye’s online shopping app, thousands of brands are waiting for you, along with 90-minute delivery and the convenience of shopping with price protection.
This Is All Boyner!
We continue to work to provide you with a seamless online shopping experience. With Boyner evolving into a marketplace, you can access more brands and categories with just one click and reflect your style with a wide selection ranging from clothing and footwear to bags and accessories. With the Ready-to-Spend Limit, you can shop from participating brands now and start making your payment 30 days later. Come and discover, because this is all Boyner!
The Boyner Way of Gifting
If you’re unsure what to get your loved ones, inspiration is waiting for you at Boyner! From Teacher’s Day to New Year’s gifts, you can easily find the perfect gift for special occasions with a wide range of products across many categories. Plus, Boyner Gift Assistant is by your side every step of the way to help you choose the right gift!
2026 Winter Style at Boyner
All the essentials you need for winter are together at Boyner, so you can create warm and comfortable outfits without compromising your style in cold weather. Discover cozy coats, jackets, soft knits, sweaters, sweatshirts, jeans, boots and many more pieces all in one place; effortlessly complete your winter looks, from the busy city routine to weekend plans. Explore clothing, footwear and accessory options designed to suit different styles and needs and discover the season’s favorite pieces for your 2026 winter style.
The Latest Makeup and Skincare Products at Boyner
From a radiant look to everyday beauty touches, your favorite beauty and cosmetic products are waiting for you at Boyner. Complete your beauty and skincare routine with foundation, blush, eyeliner and mascara, as well as cleansers, moisturizers and sunscreens. Discover your signature fragrance among warm and sophisticated scents that complement the fall and winter seasons. Alongside iconic brands such as Estée Lauder, Lancôme and Clinique, don’t forget to explore products available exclusively at Boyner.
Winter-Ready City Style
Pieces that bring the comfort and style of winter to the city’s fast-paced lifestyle are waiting for you at Boyner. Complete your new-season wardrobe with warm coats and jackets, soft knits, jeans and winter accessories, and add a modern, dynamic touch to your city style on cold days.
Your Destination for Home & Electronics Shopping
Products designed to make every moment at home more enjoyable are waiting for you at Boyner. Discover practical solutions ranging from tea and coffee machines to air purifiers, robot vacuum cleaners and sound systems. Add style to your home with serving dishes and decorative accessories, and explore Karaca, Pip Studio and Boyner Evde collections.
Boyner Now – At Your Door in 90 Minutes
Opportunities filled with special discounts across dozens of categories are waiting for you at Boyner Now.
We deliver the products you select from the store closest to your location to your door within 90 minutes.
With scheduled delivery, you can have your order delivered on the day and at the time you choose.
Make your surprises even more special with gift wrapping and the option to add a personal note.
Complete all your transactions quickly through a single screen and enjoy a seamless shopping experience.
Sending a gift with Boyner Now is easy! Select the address where you want to send your gift, add your favorite products to your cart, and let us deliver them either within 90 minutes or on the date and at the time you choose. Boyner Now makes both you and your loved ones happy!

Try the most popular and traditional solitaire game in multiplayer mode, no longer solitary, compete with real players from all around the world and win real cash! Jump into a world of brain-teasing fun, and leave with your heart filled with nostalgia and pockets filled with rewards.

If you like card game, Solitaire Arena will give you endless fun and big rewards!

 1. Win real money tournaments 
2. Big rewards for champions 
3. Enjoy awesome daily gifts & bonuses 
4. Nice and smooth graphic 
5. Potential prizes

7. Special challenges and surprises

 Find These Unique Features: 
1. Addicting and refreshing interactive experience 
2. Compete with players from all over the world with just a simple click 
3. No robots, play with real person online 
4. Amazing rewards for your success 
5. Withdraw money immediately  
There are more for you to explore in the Solitaire Arena. Don't hesitate, download it now and join the classic card game. Highly addictive and 100% fun, enjoy and win big money now！
Solitaire Arena is totally free to download and play. Note that Cash tournaments are not available in the following states: AZ，AR，CT，DE，LA，MI，MT，SC，SD，TN，IN，ME
If you need any help, feel free to contact our Customer Support Team at solitaire@mobilefox.club

●《插畫聯萌模式》塔仔、咪嚕、點點、蚵仔新登場！化身超萌貓貓開局胡牌，搭配專屬配音與牌桌動態，讓每場牌局都超有戲！

●《遊戲幣超多》每日簽到解任務，天天領獎勵、麻將瘋狂玩到爽！
●《人物模式》人物裝扮自由選，打造專屬你的牌桌角色，展現你的牌桌時尚，胡牌更過癮！
●《玩法最齊全》台灣麻將、香港麻雀、廣東麻雀、跑馬仔應有盡有！總有一款滿足你
●《娛樂城》21點、骰寶、捕魚、老虎機！超高賠率、一夕致富，體驗拉斯維加斯般的豪賭快感！
●《區域爭霸賽》全台高手齊聚！挑戰縣市排行榜，爭奪最強封號！
● 《表情快捷鍵》麻將表情包隨點隨傳，讓牌局互動感滿點！
● 《贏牌動畫》全新動畫翻新，超爽視覺加持，胡牌爽度再升級！
● iTech Labs國際機構認證亂數配牌，絕對「公平、公正、公開」
初哥學打麻雀，唔洗怕交學費！?
● 《食糊提示》 內置番數表、聽幾多飛一目了然，麻雀初哥入門零難度！
● 《3分鐘一鋪》 收工搭車、等地鐵隨時開枱，隨時隨地過足麻雀癮！
● 《日日攞錢》 登入做任務、獎勵攞唔完，打麻雀唔驚輸晒盡情玩！
● 《視像開枱》 即時語音約埋親友打麻雀，邊打邊吹水，熱鬧過雀館！
● 《百變娛樂城》21點、魚蝦蟹應有盡有，唔打麻雀一樣咁好玩，1秒變富豪！
● 《多樣造型》 隨心變換角色同頭貼，打麻雀唔鬥牌技鬥造型！
● 《特效升級》 麻雀食大牌動畫全方位 Upgrade，贏牌快感更過癮！
－台灣麻將&香港麻雀 遊戲特色－
●正宗台灣中文、香港廣東語配音
●牌面大！更清楚、操作更容易！斷線還能重連
●多樣上桌模式，能自由選擇「人物」或「大頭貼」呈現，滿足你的視覺偏好，打牌更自在！
●認證會員免費補幣至神幣888，每天都能免費玩線上麻將遊戲！
●獨創幸運轉金樂，神幣最高送10倍；賭神黃金骰，勝場神幣加倍送！
●每日定時線上麻將賽，隨時拚牌技、爭排名！
●團隊解任務，好友、公會豐富好禮！
●首創一手局(1/4圈)，3分鐘胡一把，臨時有事也能快打一下！

bluejetty:00070239:ios.name: Basketball Games 2026 Pro
bluejetty:00070239:ios.summary: The exciting and energetic basketball arena is alive for people all around the world to enjoy the ultimate basketball showdown. The game offers various modes, including the American league, club clash and world tour making it an all-in-one
bluejetty:00070239:ios.description:
The exciting and energetic basketball arena is alive for people all around the world to enjoy the ultimate basketball showdown. The game offers various modes, including the American league, club clash and world tour making it an all-in-one thrilling experience.
Before the game begins, players have the opportunity to select their favorite team from a huge number of options. Mind blowing graphics and environment makes the experience real. The basketball court comes alive with color, action, and the fans roar with every shot. The referee's whistle adds to the realism, making it feel like you're right there in the middle of the court.
You are going to get challenged to play various shots to overcome your opponents, from long-range three-pointers to hook shots and slam dunks. With each shot, the tension and excitement build, making it impossible to look away.
No matter which mode you choose to play, this basketball game offers an exciting experience that will hook you and keep you coming back for more. So, step onto the court, pick your team, and let the games begin!
Basketball Games 2026 Pro Features:
-HD graphics and intuitive touch controls
-Interesting and unique gameplay
-Cheering background environment
-Addictive different camera angle shots to get a full view of the stadium
-On-screen score display to keeps points in check
-Engaging background music that will help you blend in gameplay
-Challenging but easy to pick and play
-A lot of options to pick your team
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FdXzuVGi480OVnRiMgVql2R9DZB1GqGAWNtOyVQdnag/edit
Terms of Uses: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nP2KXbooXhodFJlLJCyr9GAitqY0uVnN/view?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00064798:ios.description:
Your comprehensive banking app. For banking anytime and anywhere.
+++ Account balance and transactions +++
Current account balance clearly displayed at all times for all products and with a personalised view – all account transactions at a glance always.
+++ Send money +++
Transfer money (in real time) – manually or by scanning a bill/QR code. Create standing orders and scheduled transfers.
+++ Mobile payments +++
Use your smartphone or smartwatch with Apple Pay to conveniently pay on the go by credit card or virtual card (free of charge). 
+++ Cash on every corner +++
Deposit and withdraw money at over 12,500 partner locations, even without a card or purchase.
+++ Manage credit cards +++
Keep an eye on your transactions at all times, receive push notifications, display card details, personalise card options or (temporarily) block your card. 
+++ Saving and investing money +++
Invest in securities, monitor your securities account, create an investment plan and build up your assets. Free maxblue online securities account included.
+++ Analyse your finances +++
In the finance planner, your income and expenses are automatically grouped into categories. This way, you can quickly see how much money you spend on what.
+++ Benefit from a wide range of products +++
Put our diverse product range to work for you and bring new ideas to life.
+++ SelfServices for added convenience +++
Access over 70 banking services directly in the app – from changing your address to arranging an appointment.
+++ Simple Mode+++
More focus, less distraction. With Simple Mode, you can enjoy the same secure banking experience in a simplified view that keeps things clear and easy.

bluejetty:00167666:ios.description:
Readsy is audio romance, performed rather than read.
Every story is narrated end to end by a voice recorded for Readsy alone — no synthetic
reading, no abridgement. Slow burn, forbidden, enemies to lovers, and the quiet
in-between: browse by mood, by heat, or by how long you have tonight.
WHAT YOU GET
• Hundreds of narrated stories, with new Readsy Originals every week
• A free preview on every story, so you hear the voice before you decide
• Heat rated up to three peppers, shown before you press play
• The most intense moments marked on the timeline, so you can go straight to them
• Sleep timer, playback speed, and a player that remembers where you stopped
• Six narration languages: English, Spanish, German, Portuguese, French, Italian
• Discreet billing and a library nobody else sees

Start any story free. A subscription opens the full catalogue and every new release;
it renews automatically until you cancel, and you can cancel at any time.
