A Po
bluejetty:00115774:ios.description:
O que é a Power App? É um aplicativo de treino onde você terá praticamente uma personal na palma da sua mão — mas não qualquer personal. Será a Natasha Moraes, hoje uma das profissionais de educação física mais requisitadas do Brasil. 
A Power é um programa de treino totalmente voltado para mulheres que buscam aquele corpo dos sonhos — seja ganho de massa, perda de gordura ou ambos os objetivos. Não importa sua idade ou seu nível de treino: com a metodologia da Natasha, você vai encontrar exatamente o que procura, e o espelho vai te mostrar resultados que você nunca viu, mas sempre sonhou. 
Tanto para quem treina em casa quanto para quem treina na academia: se o que você busca é desenvolver glúteos, tornear pernas, definir abdômen e braços, ganhar massa muscular e perder gordura simultaneamente - seja muito bem-vinda à melhor decisão da sua vida! 
É o programa de treino para mulheres mais completo do mundo: vídeos e fichas de treino com a melhor didática para você alcançar resultados em pouco tempo.
 CONTEÚDO DO PROGRAMA: 
- Treinos atualizados mensalmente, tanto de academia quanto para treinar em casa — assim você estará sempre mudando os estímulos do corpo e conquistando os melhores resultados possíveis. 
- Vídeos explicativos sobre todas as séries, pra você realmente ter uma personal na palma da sua mão. 
- Treinos em casa com vídeo aulas completas, onde você treina juntinha com a Natasha. 
- Suporte 7 dias por semana. 
- Grupo de alunas onde todas se ajudam e se motivam — na Power, você encontra sua família fitness. 
- Diversos módulos bônus pra quem quer aprender ou praticar coisas novas.
- Acesso pelo navegador ou pelo aplicativo. - E aí, que tal entrar para o melhor programa de treinos para mulheres do Brasil? Baixe agora mesmo o app da Power, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time! Estamos ansiosos pra te ajudar a conquistar seus objetivos o mais rápido possível! 
 “O corpo dos seus sonhos começa com uma decisão!”

bluejetty:00062588:ios.description:
*** Fun educational baby games for babies and toddlers of age 1 and up
*** SORT AND CLASSIFY by animals, shape, color, seasons, vehicles, and much more
*** Developed with certified child psychologists
***15 beautiful baby games
*** Ascending difficulty level
About the game:
-----------------
"TinyHands Sorting 2" is an educational game for babies of age 1 and up. 
The game consists of 15 beautiful baby games each focused on a set of basic concepts from the child's world such as shapes, colors, seasons, animals and vehicles.
The game is designed to enhance the following skills:
- Sorting and classifying
- Hand-eye coordination
- Concentration
- Visual perception
- Vocabulary
Game Boards:
------------
The game consists of 15 baby games ordered in an ascending level of difficulty.The boards were CAREFULLY CHOSEN in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world.
The Airport: sort airplanes by COLOR.
The Swamp: Sort frogs by SIZE.
At the beach: Assign items to the correct SURROUNDING.
Kitchen and bath screen: Assign items to the correct room in the HOUSE.
Star and circle screen: Classify geometric SHAPES.
Balls and hats screen: Classify objects based on their SHAPE
Different items screen: Classify objects based on their SHAPE
Three colors screen: Classify objects based on their COLOR
On the road and in the sky: Sort different VEHICLES
In the meadow: Sort different ANIMALS
INSTRUMENTS screen: Sort between PAINTING and MUSIC instruments
SEASONS wear: Sort SUMMER and WINTER clothes
TinyHands Baby Games:
TinyHands Baby Game Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking baby games. The baby game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching baby games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.
We are sure that your children will enjoy this exciting educational game that will encourage their thinking and contribute to the development of their basic skills.

bluejetty:00100588:ios.name: Block Loop!
bluejetty:00100588:ios.summary:
Block Loop – Visual Therapy in Motion
Block Loop turns pixel block destruction into visual therapy. Launch cute frog shooters into a looping system and clear vibrant pixel blocks in smooth, rhythmic waves that feel both calming and deeply
bluejetty:00100588:ios.description:
Block Loop – Visual Therapy in Motion
Block Loop turns pixel block destruction into visual therapy. Launch cute frog shooters into a looping system and clear vibrant pixel blocks in smooth, rhythmic waves that feel both calming and deeply satisfying.
Each level is carefully designed to feel clean and rewarding. Every shot snaps into place, every cleared block brings visual relief, and every completed board restores a sense of order and flow. With simple controls and relaxing gameplay, Block Loop is the perfect pixel puzzle to reset your mind.
Challenges for Your Mind:
While easy to play, Block Loop offers gentle puzzle depth. Timing your shots, choosing the right order, and managing the loop efficiently create thoughtful challenges without pressure or stress. The puzzles reward calm planning and smooth decision-making rather than speed.
Features You’ll Enjoy:
• Relaxing pixel puzzle gameplay with vibrant visuals
• Cute frog shooters that add charm to every level
• One-tap controls that feel natural and intuitive
• Smooth animations and satisfying visual feedback
• Short, contained levels ideal for quick breaks
• A calm, cozy atmosphere with no timers or penalties
Ideal for quick breaks, satisfying sessions, and anyone who loves clean visuals, soothing gameplay, and calming pixel effects.
Step into the loop, clear the board, and let every pixel pop bring a moment of peace.

bluejetty:00031275:ios.summary:
Meet people who have the same music taste, just like you.
Music Mate is a new kind of music social app.
Share your playlists and saved songs to discover people with similar music tastes.
Import playlists from Apple Music, Spotify, NetEase
bluejetty:00031275:ios.description:
Meet people who have the same music taste, just like you.
Music Mate is a new kind of music social app.
Share your playlists and saved songs to discover people with similar music tastes.
Import playlists from Apple Music, Spotify, NetEase Music, QQ Music, YouTube Music, and more.
Just paste a playlist link and bring your entire music world into Music Mate.
---
Meet music lovers through playlists
On Music Mate, you can upload your playlists
and show off your music taste.
See who saved the same songs as you,
and find people who listen to the same music.
Music isn’t just something you listen to —
it can also be a way to connect with others.
---
Works with all major music platforms
Music Mate supports importing playlists from major music services, including:
• Apple Music
• Spotify
• NetEase Music
• QQ Music
• YouTube Music
• Soda Music
• and more
Just copy and paste a playlist link to import it instantly.
No matter which music app you use,
you can share your playlists on Music Mate.
---
Discover shared music taste
View songs others have saved
and see what music you have in common.
Music Mate calculates your Music Match Score,
making it easier to find people who truly share your taste in music.
---
AI helps you think of the top
Not sure what to talk about?
Music Mate analyzes both of your playlists and music taste
and uses AI to generate conversation topics.
Start chatting from the songs you both love —
and let music make conversations feel natural.
---
Turn music into a way to connect
With Music Mate, you can:
• Share your playlists
• See what music others love
• Discover new songs
• Meet music lovers
• Start conversations through music
Music isn’t just something you listen to —
it can also bring people together.
---
Version 4.0 — Major Update
• Import playlists from all major music platforms
• AI-powered music taste sharing and conversation suggestions
• Added Light Mode
• Faster loading performance
• Pin favorite chats
• 100+ experience improvements
---
If you love music and want to meet people with similar taste,
welcome to Music Mate.
Upload your playlist
and see who listens to the same music as you.
---
*** App Store Editors’ Choice ***
*** Featured in App Store Events & Stories ***
*** Over 300,000 users worldwide (as of July 2026) ***
---
Terms of Service
https://musicmate.fun/terms-conditions-of-music-mate-app
Privacy Policy
https://musicmate.fun/privacy-policy-of-music-mate-app

bluejetty:00132401:ios.summary:

HotClays
bluejetty:00132401:ios.description:
Score trap, skeet, and sporting clays.
Just tap hit or miss to score. Total up scores for each practice. Send scorecards over text or email. Backup your scores for free, and sync between devices to score multiple groups at once.
HotClays is perfect for coaching. Scores for each event are grouped together on a single page, making it easy to upload weekly scores to your league.
The following sports are supported:
TRAP
■ American Trap
■ American Trap Doubles
■ Double Barrel
■ Double Rise
■ Down-The-Line
■ Olympic Trap
■ Olympic Double Trap
■ Single Barrel
■ Wobble Trap (ABT)
SKEET
■ American Skeet
■ English Skeet
■ Olympic Skeet
■ Olympic Skeet Final
■ Skeet Doubles
■ Skeet Shoot-Off
■ Wobble Skeet
SPORTING CLAYS
■ English Sporting
■ Five Stand
■ Sportrap
■ FITASC Sporting
■ Compak Sporting
■ Super Sporting
OTHER FEATURES
■ Landscape scoring: Rotate your device sideways for a wider scoring interface. Especially useful for devices with smaller screens.
■ Statistics: Automatically computed from score sheets. More statistics coming with each update.
■ Reliable scoring: Scores are auto-saved frequently to minimize the risk of losing your place in a round while scoring.
■ Directional scoring (trap only): Hold down the hit or miss button when scoring to keep track of target directions.
PREMIUM PRICING AND TERMS
HotClays Premium offers one payment option:
$79.99 / year (billed annually)
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Read the terms of service here:
https://www.hotclays.com/legal/terms
Read the privacy policy here:
https://www.hotclays.com/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00124110:ios.name: Pearl’s Peril: Hidden Objects
bluejetty:00124110:ios.summary:
Pearl's Peril does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Calling all eagle-eyed fans of Hidden Object Games! Play Pearl's Peril,
bluejetty:00124110:ios.description:
Pearl's Peril does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Calling all eagle-eyed fans of Hidden Object Games! Play Pearl's Peril, the stunningly beautiful Hidden Object Adventure Game set in the golden age of mystery and adventure!
Join heiress and ace pilot Pearl Wallace on a round-the-world hunt for clues as she unravels the mystery of her father's apparent suicide. From New York City to the heart of Africa, follow Pearl into deadly danger as she strives to unmask the real killer and reveal their villainous plans! 
Renovate and redecorate the Wallace family's exotic estate on the private Polynesian island of Artemis!
Uncover a diabolical plot that touches everyone in Pearl's life, and could even topple nations!
If you love Hidden Object Games, Pearl's Peril is the mystery you've been waiting for. Stand side by side with trailblazing 1930s heroine Pearl as you explore hundreds of exquisite hand-drawn scenes and exotic locations. Meet and make friends, and test your skills against a huge international community of Pearl's Peril Adventurers.
Your adventure begins here!
A NEW WAY TO PLAY
Pearl’s Peril is growing! Play Iris's Eyes to match objects to their silhouettes and unlock exclusive island decorations!
HUNDREDS OF BEAUTIFUL SCENES
No other Hidden Object Mystery can match Pearl's stunning hand-drawn scenes. From the streets of 1920s New York to Paris, Polynesia and beyond, an exotic world of glamour, mystery, adventure, and romance comes lavishly to life.
A GRIPPING STORY
Epic adventure, mind-bending mystery, and heart-stopping romance are woven into the fabric of Pearl's Peril, for a rich, rewarding story you won't forget.
Game Story by Steven-Elliot Altman, Johanna Fischer, Karen Haloran, William Hiles, Catherine Duquette, and Sebastian Nußbaum.
UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY
You'll need a keen eye and a sharp mind to unlock the secrets of Pearl's Peril and uncover the mastermind behind her father's untimely fate!
YOUR PERSONAL PARADISE
Welcome to Artemis Island, the Wallace family's private estate. Build and decorate to create the island getaway of your dreams!
If you love Hidden Object Games, Pearl's Peril is the mystery you've been waiting for. 
---------------------------------------------------------------
Having problems? Any suggestions? We would love to hear from you! You can reach us here: http://woo.ga/PPhelp
Become a fan of the game for the latest stories, rewards, and competitions:

bluejetty:00095964:ios.name: Shutter Declutter: Pic Cleaner
bluejetty:00095964:ios.summary:
Never run out of storage again!
Too many photos cluttering your phone? Dreading the thought of sorting through thousands of memories? Shutter Declutter makes photo cleanup actually enjoyable!
Declutter your photos for FREE with a stress-f
bluejetty:00095964:ios.description:
Never run out of storage again!
Too many photos cluttering your phone? Dreading the thought of sorting through thousands of memories? Shutter Declutter makes photo cleanup actually enjoyable!
Declutter your photos for FREE with a stress-free, habit-based approach.
Here's a quick overview of the features you can expect in Shutter Declutter:
- Easy way to free up storage space with daily photos.
- Rediscover and share memories.
- Daily swipes - Get your daily dose of photo cleanup at no cost.
- Quickly find duplicates and similar photos.
- ADHD friendly: Clean up a little bit at a time. Don't overwhelm yourself!
- Daily recommendations to help tackle the items that are eating up the most space.
Want to declutter even faster? Go unlimited for premium features to 10x your swiping ability. 
Pro features include:
- Unlimited swipes
- Screen Time - Block social media until you do your daily declutter
- Compress videos you want to keep to save even more space
- Select The Best: Automatically find similar photos taken close together on that day to easily find the best one
- Pin Album Sheet: The fastest way to organize your photos into albums with a single tap
- Customize your app with themes and different app icons
- Remove duplicates: You didn't need those anyways
- Auto-play videos inline: Declutter even faster
Clear up storage space on your phone for the things you actually care about, by getting rid of the things you don’t.
----- Habit Based Approach -----
Unlike other apps that dump your entire photo library on you at once, Shutter Declutter takes a cozy, less daunting approach. Each day, you'll be shown photos taken on this day, one, two, three years ago (and beyond!). Review your memories and swipe away the ones you don't need anymore.
Clean a little each day, and watch your storage space grow!
Prefer tapping to swiping? Enable button mode and give your thumbs a break.
----- Easy To Get Started -----
- No account needed - Download and start cleaning immediately.
- No weekly subscriptions - Because that's too expensive.
- Ad-free experience - Focus on your memories without any distractions.
- Reminders - So you never forget to declutter!
Seriously, it's cheaper than buying more cloud storage (and way more satisfying).
----- Organize your photos -----
- Sort your photos into your existing albums.
- Create new albums to organize as you go.
- Mark your best ones as favorites.
----- Rediscover & Share Your Memories ----- 
While decluttering, you'll stumble upon forgotten gems! Found that perfect shot from your friend's wedding three years ago? Share it and become the best friend who "remembered" their anniversary.
Works with Photos, Videos, Screenshots, and Live Photos - I've got all your memories covered.
----- Celebrate Your Progress ----- 
Earn achievement medals as you clean and see exactly how much space you've reclaimed. Show off your decluttering skills to friends and achieve photo zen.
----- Declutter Your Way -----
- Endless Mode - Don't want to declutter by day? Keep swiping until every single photo is sorted.
- Endless Random Mode - Waiting in line? Have some spare time? Do a quick decluttering session.
- Calendar Jump - Got a vacation's worth of photos to tackle? Jump straight to those dates and power through them.
Transform your chaotic photo library into an organized collection of memories you actually want to keep. Your future self (and your phone's storage) will thank you.
Happy Swiping!
Sincerely,
- elle
---
The app offers in-app purchases for access to pro features. All charges are made through your Apple account, with pricing varying by plan and country. The total price will be clearly displayed before you complete your purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically, either monthly or annually, depending on your plan.
Apple Terms of Use Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023827:ios.description:
kicker Fußball News – Dein Spiel. Deine Sport-App.    
Alle Spiele. Alle Tore. Alle Sport-News.    
Mit kicker bleibst du jederzeit und überall am Ball. Erhalte Live-Ticker, Fußball News, Video-Highlights, Live-Tabellen, personalisierte Push-Nachrichten und Statistiken direkt auf dein Handy. 
Dein Zugang zur ganzen Fußball- und Sportwelt – jederzeit live dabei. 
Deine Vorteile auf einen Blick: 
- Match-Radio - Bundesliga Spiele per Audio live verfolgen
- Live-Ticker in Echtzeit – vom Rasen, der Eisfläche oder aus der Halle auf dein Smartphone 
- Push-Benachrichtigungen – Kader & Aufstellungen, Anpfiff, Tore & Karten, Ergebnisse sowie Transfermeldungen & Breaking News – individuell konfigurierbar    
- Tabellen, Spielberichte & Spielpläne – Fußball total von den Profis bis zum Amateurbereich mit 1.500 Ligen     
- Statistiken – Zahlen, Daten, Fakten zu Spielern, Teams, Ligen und Meisterschaften     
- Video-Highlights – aus DFB-Pokal, Champions League, LaLiga, Serie A & sowie die kicker Bundesliga Klassiker    
- kicker Games – Manager- & Tippspiel mit über 300 Wettbewerben und starken Preisen    
Blitzschneller Live-Ticker 
Verpasse kein Spiel, kein Tor und kein Ergebnis aus der 1. und 2. Bundesliga, 3. Liga, Regionalligen, Amateurfußball, DFB-Pokal, Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Österreichische Bundesliga, Super League, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, Nationalmannschaft und viel weiteren Ligen von Australien bis Zypern.    
Push-Center & Personalisierung    
Individualisiere deine Push-Benachrichtigungen und erhalte für deinen Lieblingsverein oder spezifische Ligen alle relevanten Updates und Eilmeldungen – direkt über das intuitive Push-Center.    
Match-Videos 
Ausgewählte Szenen der Champions League sowie LaLiga, Serie A, Ligue 1, dem DFB-Pokal und der 3. Liga direkt in der App – verfügbar als Video-Clip, auch im Live-Ticker integriert.    
Mehr als Fußball: Alle Sportarten in einer App    
Neben Fußball bekommst du aktuelle Sport-Highlights, Live-Ticker und Push-Benachrichtigungen zu weiteren Sportarten:    
- Handball    
- Basketball    
- Eishockey    
- American Football    
- Tennis    
… und vieles mehr!    
Features   
- Darkmode für bequemes Lesen – systemweit oder individuell    
- Tabellenrechner – berechne Spieltage & Tabellenverläufe selbst    
- Vorlesefunktion für Artikel & Spielberichte    
- „Mein kicker" – das individuelle Feature für deinen Verein, Liga oder Wettbewerb auf der Startseite    
kicker+ & kicker PUR     
- Mehr Tiefe mit kicker+: exklusiver Content, Interviews, Daten und Analysen für echte Fußballfans    
- Werbefrei mit kicker PUR – keine Tracking-Daten, geringerer Datenverbrauch, schnellere Ladezeiten   
Alles an einem Ort   
- kicker Podcasts – kompetent, aktuell und unterhaltsam    
- kicker Shop – aktuelle Fanartikel sowie deine perfekte Fußballausstattung    
- Social Media – offizielle Posts von Spielern & Clubs aus Instagram, TikTok, X und mehr – gebündelt im kicker Feed        
Jetzt kostenlos laden – erlebe Sport, wie er sein sollte: live, schnell und individuell!

bluejetty:00017012:ios.description:
The official app for Queer Screen allows you to explore, connect and streamline your Festival experience. 
The FESTIVAL app lets you: 
Explore the Festival program: 
 - Browse the program by name, date, venue
 - Browse ‘What's On Next' at the Festival 
 - View both free and ticketed events
Buy and download tickets: 
 - Go paperless: your tickets can be scanned directly from the screen
 - Buy tickets securely with your credit card anywhere, anytime 
 - Buy passes and redeem sessions immediately 
 - Add your tickets to Passbook
 - Add your sessions to iCal
Schedule your attendance and share with friends: 
 - Create a shortlist of events through your Wishlist and connect it to your calendar
 - Share events with friends through email, Twitter and Facebook 
Left your printed tickets at home? 
The app stores all your ticket barcodes on your device regardless of how you purchased (web, phone or in-person). Door staff can scan your ticket right from your device's screen.
About Queer Screen: 
Queer Screen’s Mardi Gras Film Festival was established in 1993 as a celebration of the diversity of
sexualities and gender identities through queer storytelling on screen. It is now one of Australia’s largest
film festivals of any kind. Since 2015 Queer Screen has awarded $42,000 in funding to Australian
filmmakers. In 2018 Queer Screen launched Pitch Off, which awards $10,000 to produce a short film dealing with LGBTIQ experiences. The annual My Queer Career competition pioneered queer short film competitions exclusively for locally produced work, and screens during the Mardi Gras Film Festival in Feb/Mar. Since 2013 the Queer Screen Film Fest has delivered the latest LGBTIQ movies to Sydney’s screens in September.
About the developers: 
Ferve Tickets are proud to support this year's Queer Screen’s program.
Whether you're buying tickets online or at the box office, knowing where to be for the next show, or having your tickets and passes when you need them, we're with you the whole way.

bluejetty:00063705:ios.description:
Play, organize and edit your iPhone's videos and music with ease!
Offline Media plays the videos, music and images stored locally on your iPhone and iPad - no internet connection needed. Import your files, organize them into folders, playlists and albums, and enjoy them anywhere.
And now it does more than play: trim your videos and songs, turn any song into a ringtone, convert videos to audio, and tune the sound with the built-in equalizer.
MUSIC PLAYER
-> Play your music with the built-in music player.
-> Equalizer with presets for Rock, Pop, Jazz, Classical, Hip Hop, Dance and more - or create your own custom sound with pre-amp control.
-> Sleep Timer - choose how long to keep playing and fall asleep to your music.
-> Organize your music into playlists and albums, and pick your own playlist artwork.
-> Sort your songs by title, artist or date, or drag them into your own custom order.
VIDEO LIBRARY
-> A dedicated video library for all your movies and clips.
-> Organize your videos into folders.
-> Import videos straight from your device's photo library.
EDITING TOOLS
-> Trim Video - cut any video down to the part you want.
-> Trim Audio - cut any song into a new track.
-> Ringtone Maker - turn your favorite part of a song into a ringtone.
-> Convert to Audio - extract the soundtrack of any video and add it to your music.
IMPORT AND MANAGE
-> Play all iOS supported video, audio and image formats.
-> Easily import videos, music, images and documents from your device.
-> Import files from Dropbox.
-> Supports File Sharing - connect your iPhone or iPad to your computer and copy files with Finder or iTunes.
-> Built-in File Manager to create and manage your media library: move, rename, select and sort your files.
AND MORE
-> Connect to your Chromecast device and play your videos, music or pictures on the big screen.
-> Passcode lock with Face ID to protect your privacy.
-> Available in 30 languages.

bluejetty:00123882:ios.description:
Catch and evolve monsters!
Dive into a breathtaking fantasy world filled with mysterious monsters to capture, battle, and train. Explore sprawling landscapes, bustling cities, and mythical dungeons in this expansive open-world RPG!
Join a band of unlikely heroes and free the world of Erden from the deadly Pandemonium. Collect, train, and evolve over 180 creatures and warriors to fight alongside in supercharged monster battles!
Immerse yourself in the engaging single-player offline story or build your team and test your skills against global players online. Battle it out in fast-paced PvP leagues and form guilds with other players to unlock limited-edition gear, power-ups, and more to take your team to the next level!
CAPTURE & EXPLORE
• Catch, train, and evolve over 180 monsters and heroes across an impressive story-driven adventure!
• Encounter friends and foes as you journey across the 6 diverse regions of Erden, each with their own unique monsters to collect.
• Discover legendary weapons, accessories, and equipment to boost your warriors and gain the upper hand on your opponents.
BATTLE & CONNECT
• Build a strategy from hundreds of unique ability combinations to devastate your opponents in engaging turn-based 4v4 combat!
• Jump online to compete in real-time PvP leagues and form collaborative guilds with other players to uncover one-of-a-kind items.
• Participate in weekly online events that offer exclusive unlockables and limited characters to add to your collection!
EXPERIENCE THE STORY
The world of Erden is plagued by an ancient curse—the Pandemonium, a shroud of evil that descends once every 100 years. Only the fabled Crestbearers can cease its destruction, but all have failed to stop it from returning to wreak havoc once again.
Join two young heroes and the allies they befriend along the way and embark on a perilous quest to uncover the secret to ending this age-old curse once and for all!
Follow us on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/EvertaleEN/
Issues or questions? Contact our support:
evertalesupport@zigzagame.com

bluejetty:00141810:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of the Standoff 2 case simulator! Open cases and boxes for free, get unique skins, and add them to your inventory.
Sell extra skins, aim for arcanas, and even get a gold karambit! Create your dream inventory without spending real money.
In our simulator, you will find almost all collections from Standoff 2 cases. Explore the market where you can search for skins by various parameters and purchase cases from old collections, sticker packs, charms, and keychains.
Your inventory will contain all the skins and medals you have earned, including those from the Standoff 2 Gold Pass. Level up medals by completing the Gold Pass multiple times and aim for the most expensive medal - Diamond.
Use the craft feature to create an arcana from Legendary rarity skins. Apply stickers, hang keychains, complete the Gold Pass, spin the prize wheel, and receive daily gift boxes.
Discover your player rank, collect a collection of fully upgraded medals, and enjoy all the features of the Standoff 2 case simulator!
Please note: this app is a simulator and is not affiliated with the original Standoff 2 game. Skins cannot be transferred to the original game. Case Simulator for Standoff 2 is an unofficial game for fans.

bluejetty:00127120:ios.name: Calculator Plus v2
bluejetty:00127120:ios.summary: Calculator Plus is a standard and scientific calculator that has simplicity at its core, while not compromising on functionality. Even with its simple user interface inspired by the built-in Calculator app on iOS, it offers much, much more
bluejetty:00127120:ios.description:
Calculator Plus is a standard and scientific calculator that has simplicity at its core, while not compromising on functionality. Even with its simple user interface inspired by the built-in Calculator app on iOS, it offers much, much more - and with no ads!
With full expression and live answer preview, be faster than ever at calculating, and see exactly what you typed. Understand your answers by displaying them in exact form, scientific notation, fractions and more. Catch the exact errors with helpful syntax errors, with beautiful animations to complement your calculations. The full scientific calculator is also present in the portrait layout, so you can calculate scientific operations away one-handed on your phones, or via a space-efficient vertical window on larger screens.
That's not all! If you're on a Mac, or have a hardware keyboard connected to your iPad or iPhone, simply type your math expressions normally and it will be registered - including every scientific operation listed. Clipboard support not only allows you to copy your calculations for others to see, it also gives you the ability to instantly take any expression from anywhere and paste into the app. Plus, enjoy bonus functionality like math expression autocorrection, voice dictation, Apple Pencil Scribble, and more!
Download Calculator Plus to experience it for yourself!
Feature List:
- Standard & Scientific Calculator.
- Simple UI design puts focus on your calculations.
- Live expression and answer display while typing.
- Full scientific calculator in the portrait layout with minimal rearrangement.
- View long operations comfortably with scrollable calculation panels.
- Multiple display formats: Exact Form, Scientific Notation, Fractions and more!
- Bi-directional clipboard: Copy & Paste any expression into and out of the app.
- Math Evaluation Overrides: For those who want to configure autocorrect or prefer non-standard notations/conventions.
- Custom Scientific Typing Mode: Append, Substitute or a hybrid of both when using on-screen buttons.
- Full Hardware Keyboard input support (including scientific operations!)
- Apple Pencil Scribble support on iPadOS 14+ in English.
- Basic Voice Dictation input support in English.
- iPadOS SlideOver, Split View and Stage Manager multitasking support.
- Satisfying clicks with haptic feedback on modern iPhones.
- Complete support for all math operations and input methods on the Apple Watch app.
- Useful Syntax Error hints to let you know exactly what's wrong.
- Lightweight: only a few MB in size.
- No ads, no tracking :)
If you have or find any problems, feel free to contact me under App Support within Calculator Plus.
Developer: Wern

bluejetty:00135105:ios.description:
ZingPlay - Vương quốc game thú vị và hấp dẫn, là cổng game giải trí đa nền tảng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam! Phát triển bởi ZingPlay Game Studios thuộc VNG, ZingPlay mang đến những trải nghiệm game chất lượng, những giây phút vui vẻ, giải trí và thách thức trí tuệ không thể bỏ qua.
ZingPlay nổi tiếng với các trò chơi đa dạng được "làm mới" từ những tựa game tuổi thơ gắn liền với thế hệ 8x, 9x như Cờ Tỷ Phú, Khu Vườn Trên Mây, Sinh Tử Môn! Dù bạn đang tìm kiếm những trận chiến căng thẳng hay những giây phút giải trí thư giãn, ZingPlay sẽ không làm bạn thất vọng.
1. iCá: Bắn cá cùng iCa và trở thành đại gia sở hữu 11 loại súng đa dạng. Đón đầu thử thách từ dàn BOSS siêu khủng và trải nghiệm đồ họa dễ thương. Hàng ngàn vàng miễn phí mỗi ngày đang chờ đón bạn.
2. Bida: Thử tài bi-a với game Bida. Trải nghiệm những mode chơi đa dạng như 8 bi, 9 bi và Bida Phỏm. Đồ họa sắc nét và hiệu ứng sinh động sẽ làm bạn phải say mê.
3. Cờ Tỷ Phú 2 - GAME HOT 2024: Lập chiến lược và tích luỹ tài sản của bạn trong Cờ Tỷ Phú 2 , tận hưởng đồ họa 3D sắc nét và thách thức hàng ngàn người chơi khác trên toàn thế giới. Chơi Cờ tỷ phú chiến thuật mới ngay tại ZingPlay!
4. Khu Vườn Trên Mây: Tạo nên khu vườn riêng của bạn trong game Khu Vườn Trên Mây. Kết bạn bốn phương, trồng cây và trang trí theo phong cách riêng và thách thức thần May Mắn để nhận được phần thưởng hấp dẫn.
5. Cờ Tỷ Phú 1: Tung xúc xắc và xây dựng đế chế của riêng bạn trong trò chơi Cờ Tỷ Phú. Tương tác với hàng trăm ngàn người chơi khác, khám phá nhân vật chibi đáng yêu và trải nghiệm sống động.
6. Cờ Tướng: Khám phá trí tuệ và lối chơi chiến thuật qua trò chơi Cờ Tướng. Giao diện đẹp, gần 500.000 người dùng và chế độ chơi Cờ Úp mới sẽ đem lại cho bạn những trận đấu thực tế và hấp dẫn.
7. Cờ Cá Ngựa: Tham gia trò chơi Cờ Cá Ngựa và trải nghiệm sự hấp dẫn của giao diện 3D tinh xảo cùng hệ thống nhân vật chibi phong phú và kỹ năng đa dạng, hứa hẹn đem đến những trận cờ sôi động.
8. Sinh Tử Môn: Tham gia trận chiến thuật nóng bỏng của game chiến thuật Sinh Tử Môn hot nhất hiện nay. Thể hiện khả năng lãnh đạo của bạn và dẫn dắt một đội quân lớn để chiến thắng.
9. Thị Trấn Củ Cải: Trở thành thị trưởng của một thị trấn trong game nông trại mới nhất 2023 Thị Trấn Củ Cải. Trồng cây, giao thương và chia sẻ với bạn bè, đắm mình trong hình ảnh 3D và âm thanh dễ thương của thế giới nông nghiệp.
10. Ngư Chiến: Hòa mình vào đấu tướng dưới đại dương khốc liệt với trò chơi Ngư Chiến. Thể hiện tư duy chiến thuật với lối chơi thần tốc, tối giản, kịch tính của dòng game Auto-Battle 5v5
11. Cá Béo: Tham gia cuộc phiêu lưu bắn cá độc đáo trong game Cá Béo. Sử dụng kho súng cực khủng, đua top hàng tuần để nhận phần thưởng giá trị.
 LIÊN HỆ ZINGPLAY 
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fanpagezingplay.
- Trang chủ: https://play.zing.vn

bluejetty:00126865:ios.description:
The NightVision Light is an illumination app (variable light intensity) that is best suited for operations in the dark. You can light close at hand softly with either red color light or bulb light according to your intentions.
Red color light mode protects your night vision.
There might be occasions that you need to confirm with a star map or check the settings of your telescope or camera in the dark with a flashlight. However, white color light of the flashlight spoils your dark-adapted eye because the pupil of your eye shrinks by it. In this reason, it is necessary to take a preventive measure against it by using a red color light of low illumination that allows for maintaining your vision in the dark. The NightVision Light app turns the screen to illumination in red color to protect your night vision.
Bulb light mode prevents the reddish foreground from "star-scape" photos caused by the red color light. 
It is very effective to apply the red color light for operations in the dark to avoid affecting your night vision. However, amount of light received by the sensor of your camera is good enough and the red color light may cause a reddish foreground (fogging in red) in the "star-scape" night photography. To avoid this phenomenon, the bulb light model is newly applied. The intensity of the bulb light is variable.

There might be occasions that you need to confirm with a star map or check the settings of your telescope or camera in the dark with a flashlight.  However, white color light of the flashlight spoils your dark-adapted eye because the pupil of your eye shrinks by it.  In this reason, it is necessary to take a preventive measure against it by using a red color light of low illumination that allows for maintaining your vision in the dark.  The NightVision Light app turns the screen to illumination in red color to protect your night vision.

Bulb light mode prevents the reddish foreground from "star-scape" photos caused by the red color light. 

It is very effective to apply the red color light for operations in the dark to avoid affecting your night vision.  However, amount of light received by the sensor of your camera is good enough and the red color light may cause a reddish foreground (fogging in red) in the "star-scape" night photography.  To avoid this phenomenon, the bulb light model is newly applied.  The intensity of the bulb light is variable.

bluejetty:00033967:ios.description:
Welcome to your personal tattoo design guide! Whether you're dreaming of a bold new piece or something uniquely yours, Next Ink is here to help you create the perfect tattoo.
Explore a Variety of Styles With Next Ink
You can browse through a wide range of styles to match your vision - from intricate mandalas and fierce dragons to delicate florals and minimalist designs. Dive into endless possibilities and find a tattoo that truly speaks to you.
Personalize Your Tattoo 
Next Ink offers more than just a selection of designs. By inputting your name, birthday, birthplace, and other personal details, you can get a tattoo design that reflects your unique story. This personalized touch turns your body art into a meaningful masterpiece.
Visualize Your Dream Tattoo 
Now you can see how tattoos will look on your own skin by simply taking a photo. Adjust the size, angle, and position for a perfect fit. Update the app and visualize your dream tattoo in real-time!
Seamless Design Process 
Step into this creative world and see how easy it is to bring your tattoo ideas to life. You can explore countless design options and customize every detail to fit your personal style. Whether you're a tattoo enthusiast or getting inked for the first time, this tool makes the design process seamless and enjoyable.
Subscription Information:
Next Ink offers an auto-renewing subscription at $39.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to our VIP features. Your payment will be charged to your Apple Account as soon as you confirm your purchase. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase. Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy: [https://idealabs.mobi/privacy-policy]
Terms of Use: [https://idealabs.mobi/terms-of-service]
Feedback: [support.arvin.tattoo@idealabs.mobi]

bluejetty:00175512:ios.name: Screw Pin Puzzle！
bluejetty:00175512:ios.summary: Welcome to Screw Pin Puzzle, an addictive and entertaining game that will push your puzzle-solving skills to the limit. With its intricate puzzles and unique gameplay mechanics,the game offers a thrilling experience for players of all ages.
bluejetty:00175512:ios.description:
Welcome to Screw Pin Puzzle, an addictive and entertaining game that will push your puzzle-solving skills to the limit. With its intricate puzzles and unique gameplay mechanics,the game offers a thrilling experience for players of all ages. Dive into the captivating world of screw pins and get ready to embark on a journey filled with mind-bending challenges. Can you unravel the mysteries and become the ultimate Screw Pin Puzzle master?
Game Features:
Engaging Gameplay: Immerse yourself in the engaging gameplay of Screw Pin Puzzle. Each level presents a new twist and requires you to think strategically. Be prepared for increasingly complex puzzles that will put your problem-solving abilities to the test.
Unique Puzzles: Discover a plethora of meticulously designed puzzles that will keep you hooked for hours on end. From intricate patterns to cleverly placed obstacles, each level offers a fresh challenge that will leave you craving for more.
Unlocking Order: Unlike traditional puzzles, Screw Pin Puzzle introduces the concept of unlocking order. You must carefully analyze the puzzle and determine the correct sequence in which to unscrew the pins. One wrong move can lead to a dead-end, so choose your unlocking order wisely.
Beautiful Skins: Customize your gaming experience by choosing from a wide variety of stunning skins. Transform the look and feel of the game with vibrant colors and visually striking designs. Find the perfect skin that resonates with your style and adds a touch of personalization to your gameplay.
Global Leaderboard: Compete against players from around the world and establish your position on the global leaderboard. Showcase your skills, climb up the ranks, and prove yourself as the reigning champion of Screw Pin Puzzle.
Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game features intuitive controls that are easy to pick up. However, as you progress through the levels, the difficulty ramps up significantly. Only the most determined and skilled players will conquer the later stages of the game.
How to Play:
Objective: Your main objective in Screw Pin Puzzle is to unscrew all the pins from the puzzle board by determining the correct unlocking order. Pay close attention to the patterns and obstacles presented in each level.
Unlocking Order: To unscrew a pin, tap and drag it in the correct direction according to the unlocking order. The pins need to be unscrewed in a specific sequence to successfully complete the puzzle. Analyze the puzzle, plan your moves, and execute them strategically.
Obstacles: As you progress through the game, you'll encounter increasingly challenging obstacles. These may include locked pins, limited moves, or intricate patterns. Analyze the puzzle, devise a strategy, and overcome these obstacles to advance to the next level.
Hint System: If you find yourself stuck on a particularly challenging level, take advantage of the hint system. It will provide you with valuable guidance to help you determine the correct unlocking order and make progress. Use hints wisely to sharpen your skills and solve even the toughest puzzles.
Skins: Customize your gameplay experience by selecting different skins from the skin gallery. Experiment with various combinations and find the perfect look that resonates with your taste and style. Transform the game's aesthetics to suit your preferences.
Are you ready to embark on the ultimate screw pin puzzle-solving adventure? Download Screw Pin Puzzle now and put your skills to the test. Unravel intricate puzzles, unlock new levels, and compete with players worldwide to become the master of Screw Pin Puzzle! Prepare to be challenged like never before as you navigate through a series of increasingly difficult puzzles. Enjoy countless hours of fun and excitement with this addictive casual game.

bluejetty:00091641:ios.name: OnePulse - Paid Survey Rewards
bluejetty:00091641:ios.summary: It is not every day that we have the opportunity to have our voice heard by the world's biggest brands. OnePulse surveys do precisely that. Influence your favourite brands worldwide by taking just a minute or two to answer a few questions a
bluejetty:00091641:ios.description:
It is not every day that we have the opportunity to have our voice heard by the world's biggest brands. OnePulse surveys do precisely that. Influence your favourite brands worldwide by taking just a minute or two to answer a few questions and provide your opinion. You can even see how you stack up against others who responded.
What are Pulses?
Pulses are short surveys typically curated by global brands to collect your opinion. Pulses are always a set of 3 questions to make it quick & easy for you to get stuck in & earn some cash at the same time.
Topics of the Pulses vary quite a bit from lifestyle to your impression of current events. You can even see how your responses stack up against the rest of the community - all anonymous, of course.
Get rewarded for giving your opinion.
With each Pulse you complete, a reward will appear in your account. The more Pulses you complete, the higher you rank & the more cash you will earn.
The cash reward starts at 7c per response and will increase with the progression you make in the app. Once you have $20 in your account, you can then withdraw it & spend it however you like. No strings attached!
Reasons to download our app... 
- Rewards for your highly-valued opinions 
- New Pulses all 365 days of the year with weekly quizzes
- Stay on top of the latest news and trends 
- Compare your opinion to our community 
- Level up and increase your rewards
What do other people say?
See for yourself:
"I love the quick-fire surveys, so straightforward to answer."
"Quickest surveys I've ever taken and for the most currency."
"Unique questions. I actually see the difference I'm making to companies."
We have a community of thousands of people who interact with OnePulse daily. So if this is what they are saying, go see for yourself.
What questions am I asked?
Great question!
You can expect to be asked your opinion on specific topics, views, events and behaviour. Fancy the skinny latte over the frothy cappuccino? You could find yourself having to choose during a pulse. 
Besides being asked questions about your favourite hot beverage, it's common to see pulses for topics such as eating out and your opinion about how the government tackles core issues.
How do I level up?
That is simple - by answering pulses.
You can increase your earnings via experience points. Those experience points are gained with Pulse completions. Each level requires a certain amount of experience points to reach the next one and increase your payout per pulse you complete.
The more you interact and give your honest opinion, the more money you will earn and the higher your level will be.
How do I cash out?
You can cash out your earnings once you have $20 in rewards. Cashing out is simple and requires a Paypal account where we will send the cash for you to do what you need to.
We don't hold any of your rewards back; you're entitled to every penny for your opinions and thoughts.
Grab a hot drink and take a break.
OnePulse is not just a tool you can use to make money. We strive to bring you relevant news and content from around the world, so there is always something for you to get stuck into.
Learn about the recent ongoings in government or even events from further afield. The bite-size approach to being THAT person in the know at all times.
Join us on Social Media.
Facebook - @OnePulseApp 
Instagram - @OnePulseApp 
TikTok - @OnePulseApp 
Privacy policy - http://www.onepulse.com/privacy-policy/ 
For support or to share feedback, please use info@onepulse.com

SAME DAY FLOWER DELIVERY
— Order flowers today and have them delivered today, tomorrow or on any date you choose.
— Free delivery within 3 hours, day and night, anywhere in the UK.
— Pick an exact delivery date and time slot at checkout.
— Flower delivery in London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Liverpool, Leeds, Bristol and hundreds of other towns.

— We work with top-ranked suppliers, so every bouquet is fresh.
— Roses, peonies, tulips, lilies, hydrangeas, letterbox flowers, dried and seasonal blooms.

— Choose the bouquet, the occasion and the recipient.
— Add a personal note on a gift card, or keep the gift anonymous.
— Leave special requests in the comments — our floral designers read every one.
— Add chocolates, balloons, vases, teddy bears and other gifts to your order.
FLOWERS FOR EVERY OCCASION
Birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, weddings, graduations, new babies, thank-yous, apologies, or a Tuesday that needed brightening. Send flowers to someone you love, or treat yourself.

Draw Your Game is back with a more modern, more magical version, endless possibilities: Draw Your Game Infinite! 
An incredible game where your drawings come to life! Turn your drawings into exciting interactive games, the ultimate platfor
bluejetty:00121208:ios.description:
Draw Your Game is back with a more modern, more magical version, endless possibilities: Draw Your Game Infinite! 
An incredible game where your drawings come to life! Turn your drawings into exciting interactive games, the ultimate platform for creators and players.
WHY YOU WILL LOVE DRAW YOUR GAME INFINITE: 
 • You can turn your drawings into video games in few seconds!
 • Play an infinite number of games.
 • Share your games with your friends and the world.
 • Collect items to decorate your games.
 • Customize your hero, Mimo.
 • Unlock powers to beat challenging levels.
 • DRAW : 
In creator mode, draw, on one or more sheets of paper, your own video game level using the four predefined colors:
 • Black: draw static elements (walk or climb on it)
 • Red: draw enemies (don’t touch them, they’ll kill your hero)
 • Green: draw bouncing elements (no need to jump. Sound fun, right?)
 • Blue: draw gravity-enabled elements (push it, but be careful if you walk on it, you might fall!)
A villainous red alien here, a bouncing green flower on the path, or a blue cat blocking the way that your hero must push to advance and finish the game, anything is possible. In short, an infinite number of possibilities. You really are the creator!
Don’t worry too much about this part of the process. If you change your mind about the color or its effects, you can edit anything later in the game!
 • SNAP : 
Take a photo of your game with your phone and/or tablet using the app or import drawings from your gallery. Wait a few seconds and watch your creation turn into a video game!
 • EDIT : 
Discover this new feature: Edit your game!
This mode allows you to move objects you have drawn without having to redraw them on paper.
Change the behavior of the elements you have drawn: objects move from right to left and/or from top to bottom, swing, attack your hero—choose the actions!
Add decorative elements from our content library, or create your own library of personal content.
Many other features will be coming to help you create your own perfect video game.
 • PLAY, SHARE & EXPLORE : 
In player mode, there are many games to play! Your creations, the games of your friends, games from players around the world, and also, the games of Draw Your Game Infinite's creators through exclusive seasonal campaigns!
Help Mimo navigate through all possible levels, and explore creations from around the world.
 • INFINITE PASS
More possibilities to create your video games and personalize your hero Mimo with the Infinite Pass! More features, more items, more powers = many ways to create the best video game ever!
With the Infinite Pass, you have the opportunity to share your levels with the world and make them famous!
Here are some tips from our artists: 
 • Use fairly wide felt-tip pens.
 • Choose vivid colors.
 • Take pictures under good lighting.
About us : 
We're always happy to see your creations. Share it with us on Twitter (@DrawYourGame), Facebook (Draw Your Game), TikTok (@drawyourgameinfinite)
Need help or support? Contact us at support@draw-your-game.com
"Draw Your Game Infinite" subscription "Infinite Pass".

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase

bluejetty:00061787:ios.description:
Turbo Fax turns your iPhone into a powerful fax machine for documents, IDs, forms and other text. Scan you documents with ease or import PDFs from multiple other sources and fax them with added cover page anywhere. Get notified when your fax is delivered.

• Easy cover page feature

bluejetty:00040302:android.description:
When life starts being chaotic, it’s CLEANING time. Ana did exactly that! She was in an endless loop of misfortune. First, she lost her job and couldn’t find a new one, and then her boyfriend left her. Everything seemed without hope for our girl Ana, nothing was clear to her, but the secret of happiness is low expectations. Fate brought a cleaning service advertisement right in front of her, she decided to go for it. Beth, an owner of the cleaning service, is in desperate need of help just like Ana.
It was an INSTANT MATCH, these two girls can help each other and make their lives crystal clean again! Together as CLEANING QUEENS, our girls can clean up anything.Pick up your broom with them and let the game begin! 🧹
Gameplay
-PICK AND MOVE for a start! Throw away garbage and move objects from the floor, make it clean.
-DRAG AND DROP - Misplaced things needs to be found and placed in their right spot in the home. Let’s keep it neat!
-FIX all the necessary MESS!
-SPRAY all stain spots until it becomes crystal clean house.
- SCRUB with powerful BRUSH and give it a fresh, clean look.
-VACUUM from floor to ceiling, clean the spider web!
-RENOVATE the house and bring it to its former glory.
-PARTICIPATE in the events to earn prizes in game!
-COMPLETE achievements to earn even MORE prizes in game!
-PLAY every day, and the DAILY REWARD is yours!
Game features:
- Graphics only gets prettier when you and the girls wipe off the dust!
- Easy game to play, easier to clean! 
- Cleaning service led by Beth has a lot of satisfied customers, you should find a way to keep it like that! All you need is to make people happy with the service and clean up their mess with the help of the girls.
- Have fun while cleaning houses but yet use only a finger.
- Help our girls RENOVATE their cleaning service house and bring it to perfection. After all, the house needs to represent the cleaning service. Run a FULL HOUSE MAKEOVER and make the house and service crystal clean again.
- In this home cleaning game, you won't decorate and clean only inside but outside the house too! DOUBLE YOUR CLEANING ability and creativity! Join our girls in this cleaning adventure game!
- Amazing events are waiting for

Download now and begin your journey to reunite the two feuding sides torn apart by darkness!

bluejetty:00126526:ios.description:
Tap into the world’s most preferred legal research service wherever you go! The Westlaw app – available for iPad and iPhone – is the most awarded legal research app as voted by industry professionals and recognized by The National Law Journal, New York Law Journal, the Best of the Midwest, and more. With the Westlaw mobile app, you can extend the power and collaboration capabilities of Westlaw so research begun in one place can be continued on your mobile device – anytime, anywhere.
“The Westlaw app is very well-designed and easy to use, making it simple to get legal research done when you are in court or otherwise out of the office. In fact, the app is so nice that I will often use it even when I am in my office, doing my legal research on the iPad while my brief is open on my computer.” – Jeff Richardson, iPhone J.D. in ABA Journal
Access the same research features you rely on such as WestSearch, KeyCite, Search Filters, Folders, History, Notes, and Highlighting, which have all been redesigned for the iPad and iPhone. In addition to core research functionality, the Westlaw app offers the ability to save documents while online and offline to research folders, and deliver documents via email, print, or download.
Westlaw Edge users also have exclusive access to additional, premium features such as KeyCite Overruling Risk, WestSearch Plus, and more, which are automatically included based on your subscription. 
*Please note that a Thomson Reuters Westlaw account is required to access this app.
For questions, comments, or support regarding the app, please contact a Reference Attorney by phone at 1-800-REF-ATTY (1-800-733-2889). Law students can call 1-800-850-WEST (1-800-850-9378).

This is definitely a winner!" - By devaah on the App Store
BECOME AN AMAZING DESIGNER
Our mission is to make it easier and more fun to create your own seed bead designs. Why? Because being creative makes you happier and healthier.
FAQ
Is the full version a one-time purchase?
Yes. There are no subscriptions. You can create and export as many patterns as you like with the one-time purchase.

Yes. You can unlock the full version on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (M1 chip or later) with just one purchase.

Yes. Family Sharing is enabled.
Can I sell my patterns?
Yes. You can also add your store details to your PDF exports.

Yes. The app is only for creating patterns.
Where is my data stored?
Your data is stored on your device. All processing is done locally on your device. Your data is never transmitted to third parties.

An application that will help you answer any c
bluejetty:00138575:ios.description:
The most complete and simple Theological Dictionary of the New Testament available to you with a large number of definitions and theological terms explained and ordered for easy understanding.
An application that will help you answer any concept in your study about theology.
Theological Dictionary Bible is a very practical tool for those who wish to consult any term related to this as well as for new curious minds who want to get started in the vocabulary of the Bible.
Each term included in this dictionary includes a broad definition of the word to help you know its meaning.
Theology is the critical study of the nature of the divine. It is taught as an academic discipline, typically in universities, seminaries and schools of divinity.
Learn in an easy and enjoyable way without losing yourself in a multitude of definitions.
We put everything to you with just one click, just enter your menu ordered by letter and enter the one you want. Once there you will find an interesting list with all your words and definitions which you can share through your favorite social networks just by touching the screen and selecting the desired text.
Enjoy the theology without complications and in a pleasant and direct way.
Theological Dictionary Bible includes questions and answers related to this doctrine to expand your knowledge and better understand theology
-What is theology?
-What is systematic theology?
-What is Christian theology?
-What is a Christian worldview?
-What is Calvinism, and is it biblical?
-What is Reformed Theology?
-What is evangelical theology?
-What is Arminianism, and is it biblical?
-What is antinomianism?
-What is the Abrahamic Covenant?
-What is the Mosaic covenant?
-What is the Davidic covenant?
-What is the New Covenant?
-What was the Old Covenant?
-and more…
This tool also includes a complete online Bible to consult when you want.
Theology tries to understand and deepen the truths revealed in the light of reason illuminated by faith.
Theological Dictionary Bible Offline Features :
• This app works offline – you do not need an internet connection. Perfect for your trips or when no data connection is available.
• Thousands of Theological Words and Terms
• A learning tool
Learn new words and terms with this practical Theological Dictionary and expand your knowledge and vocabulary.
Theological Dictionary Bible includes a lot of interesting information about the theology that will make you see the Christian world from a global perspective.
Download now Theological Dictionary Bible and broaden your knowledge about this doctrine, you will have all the theological information you need.

bluejetty:00178060:ios.description:
Make stunning book covers that capture the spirit of your story.
NovelArt is a powerful book cover editor to help writers on a budget make stunning book covers.
It's incredibly easy to learn: describe your vision for a cover using text, a reference photo, or a hand-drawn sketch.
Then it magically transforms into a professional cover.
You can iterate until you feel it perfectly represents your narrative.
You can also use our canvas editor to add beautiful typography and crop to various industry-standard dimensions.
What are you waiting for? Download NovelArt and start making stunning book covers!
Our Goal
NovelArt's mission is to fuel the success of independent writers. We understand that in today's competitive market, a compelling cover is often what stands between obscurity and discovery. Your writing deserves to shine—without requiring you to become a design expert overnight. NovelArt bridges that gap by putting professional-quality design tools in your hands through an intuitive app that respects your creative vision.
Features
• Powerful AI cover art generator
• Transform hand-drawn sketches into polished covers.
• Simple yet powerful editor
• Add Text, Image, Shape layers
• Rich variety of high quality fonts
• Import images from Camera Roll
• Remove background from images
• Change layer order
• Easy layer duplication
• Resize canvas to match popular export sizes (1:1, 1:1.2, 1:1.4, 1:1.5, 1:1.6 2:3)
• Resize canvas to custom ratios
• Export as PNG photo or PDF document
• Duplicate covers for iteration and experimentation
More
• Make beautiful cover designs in minutes
• Export in 2:3 for Wattpad; export in 1:1.6 for Kindle; export in 1:1 for Audible (audio books)
• Private: your covers are accessible only by you
• Covers compatible for print books
NovelArt Pro Subscription:
The app is free to use, but additional functionality requires a subscription to NovelArt Pro. Please see in-app for details.
NovelArt AI Credits:
Generating AI cover art requires 1 Credit per generation. You can buy Credits within the app.
Privacy Policy: https://www.saturdaytechnologies.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.saturdaytechnologies.com/terms

bluejetty:00093257:ios.description:
Clickotine® is a cutting edge digital therapeutics™ solution designed by scientists and doctors to help you quit smoking. Our program is based on published science, and is personalized via our proprietary Clickometrics™ adaptive data science platform. Through the powerful combination of science and technology, we provide support people need to quit smoking and create healthier lives. Download now if you are a member of the Clickotine® program.
FEATURES
· Guided and personalized curriculum that prepares you to quit, and helps you stay quit
· Scientifically backed strategies to help you overcome cravings, withdrawal, and slips
· We help you make, and stick with, a customized quit plan -- all while monitoring your improvement over time
· Support groups to keep you encouraged and accountable with real life support form your friends, family, and community
· Ability to earn actual dollars from your employer, health insurer and/or your social network
· Access to a live professional quit coach and our customer service team whenever you need it
· Adaptive personalized messages tailored to your user profile and behavior
· Controlled, mindful breathing exercises to help you overcome cravings
· Digital diversions including games and activities to earn points and badges that you can exchange for rewards
· Clickometrics™ technology personalizes your solution for what will work best for you
ABOUT CLICK THERAPEUTICS
Click Therapeutics, Inc. engineers, validates, and commercializes Digital Therapeutics™ solutions to benefit people with unmet medical needs through cognitive and neurobehavioral modification. Click Therapeutics™ digital interventions enable change within individuals, and can be used independently or in conjunction with biomedical treatments. The Clickometrics™ adaptive data science platform continuously personalizes user experience to drive cognitive and behavioral outcomes. As the leader in Digital Therapeutics™ solutions, Click Therapeutics is building the brains behind digital health.

bluejetty:00175670:ios.name: Hinge Dating App: Match & Date
bluejetty:00175670:ios.summary:
HINGE, DESIGNED TO BE DELETED
Hinge is the dating app for people who want to get off of dating apps. With profiles that show your personality through text, photos, video, and voice, you have unique conversations that lead to great dates.
bluejetty:00175670:ios.description:
HINGE, DESIGNED TO BE DELETED
Hinge is the dating app for people who want to get off of dating apps. With profiles that show your personality through text, photos, video, and voice, you have unique conversations that lead to great dates. 
HOW WE GET YOU OFF HINGE
When it comes to online dating, people are so busy matching that they’re not actually connecting, in person, where it counts. Hinge is on a mission to change that. So we built an app that’s designed to be deleted. Here’s how:
* We quickly learn your type. You’ll only be introduced to the best people for you.
* We give you a sense of someone’s personality. You’ll get to know potential dates through their unique answers to prompts, as well as information like religion, height, politics, dating intentions, relationship type, and much more.
* We make it easy to start a conversation. Every match begins by someone liking or commenting on a specific part of your profile. Our latest feature, Convo Starters, offers personalized ideas inspired from someone’s Prompt answers and photos to help you spark engaging conversations from the start. 
* We want you to feel confident about meeting people in person. Selfie Verification makes it easier for daters on Hinge to ensure that they are who they say they are.
* We ask how your dates are going. After exchanging phone numbers with a Match, we’ll follow up to hear how your date went so we can make better recommendations in the future.
The app is free to use. Members looking to see everyone who likes them or send unlimited likes can upgrade to Hinge+. To access additional features, including enhanced recommendations and priority likes, we offer HingeX.
PRESS
"It's the go-to dating app for many people looking for love." - The Daily Mail
“Hinge’s CEO says a good dating app relies on vulnerability, not algorithms.” - Washington Post
"Hinge is the first dating app to actually measure real-world success" - TechCrunch

Payment will be charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase
Support: hello@hinge.co
Terms of Service: https://hinge.co/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hinge.co/privacy.html
All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.

bluejetty:00126314:ios.description:
Save the Pirate - the tricky and relaxing new puzzle game! Only the smartest will be able to solve these brain teaser tests in order to save the pirate Captain Elba in this thinking game journey. What will you do? How do you open the handcuffs and Save the Pirate?? Or maybe you’ll agree with a security guard ?? Choose the fate of a pirate, but be careful, one wrong answer, and you are a bait for sharks! But do not be afraid, you can always start the game anew.
In Save the Pirate, only YOU decide the fate of the hero. Travel to different locations and participate in countless adventures, you only need to do one thing: save the pirate. Dungeon, beaches, sinking ships ... think through all the stories to see what happens next!
Why Save the pirate?
1. Interesting puzzles
The world of your hero is changing, and at every step he is waiting for a new adventure. Can you complete the game to the end and Save the pirate ??
2. Do not know how to pass the time? Save the Pirate is what you need!
Have fun and relax, helping the hero pass all the trials of fate. Free game for the whole family!
3. New adventures
New adventures appear daily in Save the Pirate! Can you get through everything?
4. Is this the game from advertising?
Yes this is true.
Can you help Save the pirate Captain Elba? What if you need to save someone else?
About Premium subscription
Premium subscription is charged weekly to your iTunes Account after your 3 days trial ends. Subscription will then auto-renew every week unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. To stop auto-renewal, visit Account Settings in iTunes after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00014361:ios.description:
Why Procare?
For more than 30 years, Procare Solutions has been helping early childhood educators simplify operations and create meaningful connections with families, so they can focus on what matters most – the children in their care.
Leverage professional communications with the easy-to-use child care mobile app and the opportunity for real-time updates from the classroom to enhance the parent and staff experience.
· Share child care activities and daily reports
· Streamline two-way family communications
· Share photos and videos
· Record and share student milestones
· Send and view news and events via easy-to-create newsletters
Procare includes:
CONTACTLESS SIGN IN/OUT : Parents can sign in-out students contactless using QR code or Curbside GeoLocation.
STUDENT ATTENDANCE: Replace paper sheets with digital SIGN IN-OUT. Record student attendance, absences (add notes) and transfer to different rooms. Generate BEST industry standard reporting from our website to satisfy childcare LICENSING needs. (Also has OFFLINE MODE to run without network)
PARENT KIOSK: Parents can drop off and pick up children easily (optional use of a 4-digit pin). Record SIGNATURES and capture answers with DROP-OFF form. Charge payments based on their HOURLY attendance and collect LATE FEE.
STAFF TIMECARD: Staff can CHECK-IN from the app using 4-digit pin. Build REPORTS of their timecard from website for PAYROLL.
TRACK RATIOS: Always be licensing-compliant. Track ratios in real time from the app for all your rooms.
PHOTOS and VIDEOS: Send any number of photos and videos, and tag students with one click on our child care app. Unlimited storage and sent to parents with one tap.
LEARNING: Record custom student activities and attach development skills like fine motor, social behavior, language and more.
DAILY SHEETS: Send daily activities for infants/toddlers and record Diapers, Bottles, Naps, Meals and Bathroom visits. Reports are sent to parents automatically.
BILLING: Create and send invoice to parents easily. Manage all billing transactions, payments, refunds and credits from the app.
INCIDENTS: Record all information related to any student incidents, send the report to parents and get their signature.
CALENDAR: Share upcoming events with parents easily for any day and month.
FAMILY COMMUNICATION: You can send a message, text or email to parents or guardians instantly. Have their phone number and call if needed.
MANAGE CENTER: Keep your entire student roster and family database in your fingertips.
REPORTS: Detailed reports for everything you do is available from website for student attendance, staff timecard, billing and entire roster.
INTEGRATIONS: Procare integrates seamlessly with all major SIS (student database) systems, QuickBooks (accounting systems), payroll systems and much more.
Complete child care management and daycare software features, e.g., student / family information, immunizations, reporting and more.

bluejetty:00159838:ios.description:
Our app your reliable solution for managing and tracking Bluetooth devices! 
Device Scanning: Easily find all available Bluetooth devices around you. Bluetooth finder: Tracking app quickly scans the space and provides a list of all detected devices.
View the quality of communication: Evaluate the quality of communication with each of the found devices. We use an intuitive scale from bad to perfect so that you can quickly understand how stable the connection is.
Distance Measurement: Find out how far away your devices are. Bluetooth finder: Tracking app shows the distance to each device, which helps you easily find them in space.
Device Management: With Bluetooth finder: Tracking app, you can easily interact with your devices:
Find the device again if it is out of sight.
Add a device to My Devices for quick access in the future.
Change the name of the device for convenience.
Remove the device from the list if it is no longer needed.
Transfer to My Devices: Save the found devices for the future! Just move them to the "My Devices" section and access them at any time.
Device History: All found devices are automatically included in the history, which allows you to track which devices were discovered earlier and when.
Download Our app and simplify the management of your Bluetooth devices! Be sure that you can always find what you need.
This application contains auto-renewable subscriptions: 
1 week - $4.99

Sparrow was born with a mission to empower the underserved and overlooked by removing the financial barriers that arise from less than perfect credit. We have designed a revolutionary credit card, meticulously crafted to help guide our customers on a journey to financial freedom. 
Introducing the Sparrow Rewards Mastercard, an unparalleled credit card with a range of unique features: 
- Experience the convenience of a virtual card, granting you immediate and continuous access to your credit line
- Earn 1% cashback on all your on-time payments, rewarding you for responsible financial behavior
- Stay informed with real-time notifications, keeping you updated on all your card activity
- Explore the Climb to Prime app feature where you can gain access to credit line increases, keep an eye on your credit score, and learn the rules of the credit-scoring game
In addition to these remarkable benefits, the Sparrow app provides a seamless user experience, allowing you to effortlessly make payments, freeze and replace your card, update personal information, reset your PIN, and easily manage recurring subscription charges.
Plus, Sparrow reports your account performance to all 3 major credit bureaus, guaranteeing that your creditworthiness is recognized and rewarded, opening doors to better financial opportunities.
Sparrow Financial, Inc. is a financial technology company, not a bank. Sparrow’s bank partners are Evolve Bank & Trust, Focus Bank, and The First National Bank of Lacon. The bank issuing your card will be identified on the back of your credit card and in your Cardholder Agreement, which governs the use of your account. Sparrow cards are issued pursuant to a license from Mastercard International Incorporated.

bluejetty:00174473:ios.description:
Stream your matches live with a TV-style scoreboard, straight from your phone. Now with Highlights and Instant Replay.
NEW: HIGHLIGHTS & INSTANT REPLAY
• Save Highlight: one tap saves the last 5, 10, 15 or 20 seconds of your stream on your phone. The stream keeps running.
• Instant Replay: show the moment again on your live stream. Viewers see it without sound, and it switches back to live automatically. You can stop it at any time.
• Match recap: when you stop the stream, pick and trim your Highlights and create one Full HD video with the scoreboard in the picture.
• Share the video from your phone or save it, then post it on YouTube or Facebook.
• Saved Highlights: your clips grouped by match, and your recap videos in one place.
LIVE STREAM WITH A SCOREBOARD
• Stream to a Facebook profile or page, YouTube, Twitch, or other platforms via RTMP.
• Scoreboards for 24 sports: football, basketball, volleyball, tennis, padel, ice hockey, handball, baseball, cricket and more. For any other sport, pick one running score or a column for every set.
• Update the score by tapping the screen, or keep the score on another phone with Remote Scoring.
• Timer, periods, sets and games that follow your sport.
• Team names, player names, team colors and team logos.
• Sponsor logos and a full-screen break graphic for timeouts and halftime.
• Save the full match on your phone while you stream, or record without streaming.
• Zoom and Full HD video.
FREE AND PRO
Free: unlimited streams to Facebook and YouTube, score, timer and sets, team and player names, and recording to your phone.
SportCam PRO adds Highlights with Instant Replay and match recaps, team logos, Remote Scoring, sponsor logos and break graphics, scoreboard styles, RTMP and no SportCam watermark. New accounts can try PRO free for 1 week.
RANKEDIN TOURNAMENTS
Playing a tournament on Rankedin? Stream its matches with live scoring.
Good to know: the first time you go live on YouTube, YouTube can take up to 24 hours to turn on live streaming for your channel.
Questions? Write to hello@sportcam.app.
