Kichler Connects
Digitally control your landscape lighting from your smartphone or tablet in minutes with the Kichler Connects ™ app. Designed to work with our Kichler® Smart Control Timer, this app allows you to utilize one of our preset lighting schedules, or create custom schedules of your own. Preset schedules can align with your location, dusk-to-dawn, and adjust to daylight savings time– allowing you to be in control of the beauty of your outdoors.
Easy to use and install, the Kichler Connects App: 
- Connects to your Smart Control Timer via Wi-Fi or Bluetooth 
- Create customizable or select easy preset on/off schedules
- Select cloud and location-based control, including astronomical scheduling, to align with the daylight savings hours and the changing seasons
- Voice control via smart home devices for whole-home integration 
- Easily share and control among family members
- For use with low-voltage landscape lighting transformers (compatible with most styles) 
- On-board memory to control your lights even if your Wi-Fi connection is interrupted
- Can be set up by installers or homeowners quickly– just plug your timer into your transformer and set-up the app.

bluejetty:00136634:ios.description:
Welcome to Fishing Tour - the ultimate sport game that brings together the thrill of fishing, the excitement of clash, and the expertise of an angler! Dive into the immersive world of Fishing Tour and embark on a riveting fishing adventure. 
Whether you're a professional angler or a novice fisherman, our game offers an unique experience that will keep you hooked!Unravel the mysteries of the fishing world, encounter legendary fish, and discover hidden treasures that await daring anglers like yourself. Stunning graphics and realistic water physics add to the immersive gameplay, making you feel like you're truly in a fishing competition. Cast your line into a variety of stunning and challenging fishing spots, all around the world, each full of with a diverse array of fish species. Feel the adrenaline rush as you clash with these magnificent creatures in epic battles, testing your skills and finesse as an angler.
 Explore the serene beauty of crystal-clear lakes, venture into untamed wilderness, and conquer the mighty ocean as you uncover new fishing locations with unique challenges and fish species. Join the fishermen from all over the world and compete with them on the incredible sceneries from the Caribbean Sea, many lakes and rivers of Sweden to the sunny shores of Florida, the world of Fishing Tour is yours to discover. With a wide selection of fishing gear and equipment at your disposal, customize your fishing rod, bait, and tackle to suit your unique style of angling. Upgrade your gear to improve your chances of catching the elusive big fish, and rise through the ranks to become the top angler in the Fishing Tour community. 
Compete against friends and fellow players in thrilling real-time fishing tournaments, where strategic decision-making and quick reflexes can make all the difference. Showcase your angling skills and claim the title of the Fishing Tour champion! Unravel the mysteries of the fishing world, encounter legendary fish, and discover hidden treasures that await daring anglers like yourself. Relax and unwind as you soak in the serene beauty of the virtual fishing spots, creating the perfect ambiance for an enjoyable gaming experience. Are you ready to embark on the Fishing Tour of a lifetime?
 Cast your line, reel in the big fish, and prove your angler skills to become the ultimate fishing champion. Download Fishing Tour now and let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00139211:ios.description:
UltraNotes is a powerful note-taking app and writing app that supports handwriting with Apple Pencil, typing with a keyboard, and annotating PDFs.
Handwritten Notes
• Create notes with covers and paper templates. Built-in 19 covers and 17 templates. And you could also import your own covers and templates.

• Adjust the thickness and color of the pen tip
• Draw perfect shapes and lines.
• Layers (Pro): separate content into layers, show or hide them anytime.
• Lasso: Convert handwriting to text, Take screenshot, Change color of handwriting.
• Scribble to erase handwriting.
• Write with scribble tool by using Apple Pencil, and it will convert to text instantly.
• Squeeze Apple Pencil Pro to show contextual palette.
• Add text box, stickers and images to make your note more beautiful.
• Export note to PDF and image
Text Notes
• Set headings to make TOC(Table of Contents).
• Format text with bold, italics, strikethrough, underline
• Highlight text with colors
• Bullet List, Numbered List and To-Do List.
• Set your own font, font size, line spacing, paragraph spacing, and more
• Attach files and images on note.
• Templates: Resume, Essay, Shopping List, To-Do List, Weekly Planner etc.
• Export note to PDF, RTF, HTML, Markdown and Plain TXT
Annotation
• Mark up PDFs.
• Sign documents
Search
• Search text and handwritting in notes and PDFs.

bluejetty:00066216:ios.summary: Patrol the city streets in the ultimate realistic police game! Build and upgrade your cop car then prepare your police equipment! Head out to the streets and pull over drivers or get into chases with the help of additional police backup. Ge
bluejetty:00066216:ios.description:
Patrol the city streets in the ultimate realistic police game! Build and upgrade your cop car then prepare your police equipment! Head out to the streets and pull over drivers or get into chases with the help of additional police backup. Get out on foot and raid headquarters of tough crime bosses, low-level thugs or small-time crooks in the latest FPS police car driving simulator game.
As a police officer on duty, your job is to patrol the streets and uphold the law! Take down criminals and protect innocent civilians at all costs. Take on the role as the latest police officer recruit and go on high-risk missions to pursue and arrest criminals. It’s police vs robbers in all-new action driving gameplay! Call and respond to save the city and uphold your duty as a police officer.
Take on a wide variety of missions as you work your way up the ranks from a rookie to a seasoned officer. With every mission you complete, you'll earn rewards and experience points that will allow you to upgrade and unlock new vehicles and weapons to aid in your fight against crime.
Fulfil your police duty with a range of missions:
- Saving people in hostage situations
- Engaging in police vs robbers car chases
- Infiltrating and busting crime hideouts
- Protecting and escorting V.I.P vehicles
- Catching and arresting gang members
- Using evasive driving skills to stop fleeing robbers
- Pilot helicopters and drones for additional air support
Unlock, upgrade and equip a whole arsenal of police gear full of amazing police weapons. Take on the criminal robbers with Desert Eagles, M16, hand grenades, mini-guns and a whole load more! Complete police missions to rise up the ranks and build up your own collection of police cars, from a wide selection of city cars, offroad 4x4 trucks, SUVs and fast cop car interceptors.
Dive right into non-stop police action of the cop car driving. Take on the cop duty missions any time with callouts through the police radio, blast the police sirens and get over to the scene of the crime to carry out real cop action. Not your style of police work? Decline the radio call, head out and explore the city and surrounding world on foot or ride along in your police patrol vehicle. Do whatever it takes to be one of the best police officers!
But that's not all!! This police simulator has enough to keep you in the action for hours on end, including:
- A massive city environment with surrounding open world to explore!
- Realistic police car driving simulator
- High-quality police vehicles and weapons
- Realistic driving and FPS gameplay physics
- Unlimited cop duty missions to play!
- Incredible vehicle damage - see every bump and scratch with each hit!
- Unlimited mission objectives. Non-stop action!
- Hidden secrets and objectives throughout the world!
- Easy to play car driving controls. Use touch, steering wheel or tilt controls!
Get ready to experience a realistic simulation of police work with the ability to upgrade and unlock new vehicles and weapons to take on bigger jobs as you work your way up the police academy ranks!
Dive right into the action and put on your police uniform as you get behind the wheel of your very own powerful police car. Head out onto the streets and start your patrol - respond to emergency calls, start police pursuits of suspects and take down criminals on foot as you work to keep the city safe.
With a wide variety of police missions you'll never get bored! High-speed car chases to intense shootouts, use all of your driving skills as a police officer to take down criminals fast. Work your way up the police ranks to take on bigger and more challenging missions!
So what are you waiting for?! If you've got what it takes, join the force and become the best police officer we've seen on duty!
Note: Some cosmetic vehicle & weapon skins require a Special Ops membership, paid subscription required.

bluejetty:00042093:ios.description:
Your pregnancy and birth matter and God wants to meet you there. 
Made for This Birth is here to support and encourage you as you prepare for a happy, healthy, and yes, even holy pregnancy and birth with God. We believe that you are designed intentionally and beautifully to grow and birth your baby and He wants to be part of the experience. Birth can be one of the most amazing and spiritually transformative experiences of a woman's life and Made for This Birth can help you prepare your body, mind, heart, and soul for just that.
The Made for This Birth Album contains over THREE HOURS of Catholic meditations, prayer, affirmations, Scripture, and relaxation practice for birth. We'll help you overcome fear, heal disordered beliefs, and prepare you for a joyful and empowering birth with God at the center. Playlists are customizable and can even include your own Apple Library tracks! Tracks were written and are led by the author of Made for This: The Catholic Mom's Guide to Birth, childbirth educator and doula, and mother of seven, Mary Haseltine.
Our Weekly Pregnancy Guide walks you through a more intentional and TRULY holistic pregnancy and birth from the very beginning - Body, Mind, Heart, and Soul. Each week you’ll be offered a unique glimpse of what your baby is up to, digestible but impactful information and reflections about your pregnancy, prenatal care, birth, and postpartum time, beautiful and compelling questions to reflect on, take to prayer, and even journal through, and a custom prayer specific to that week to help you orient all your decisions and experiences toward God's plan for YOU. Unlike secular sources, we’ll see you and your baby through the lens of God’s intentional design, in a way that honors you as a complete woman and your baby as a unique human being.
The Made for This customizable contraction timer allows you to time contractions while also offering sacred images, Scriptures, saint quotes, intentions, and even your own uploaded images to provide encouragement and inspiration as you labor!
THE MADE FOR THIS APP IS THE ONLY APP TO FEATURE;
    • Over three hours of original audio tracks with:
        Scriptures and Encouragement from the Saints
        -Prayers and Affirmations for Pregnancy and Birth
        -The Rosary with custom meditations designed for pregnancy and birth
        -A Litany to Mothers
        -The Divine Mercy Chaplet
    • Custom Built Pregnancy and Birth Playlists where you can add your own music!
    • Weekly Pregnancy Tracker from a Christian perspective with information, prayer, journaling prompts, and an integrated, holistic approach to your pregnancy unlike any other pregnancy tracker available
    • CUSTOMIZABLE FAITH-BASED contraction timer
    • Access to encouraging birth stories written by Christian mothers just like you
    • Printable resources and affirmations
    • Daily Encouragement on your phone home screen
    • The Made for This Birth Directory connecting you with like-minded birth workers in your area
    • Prayers and novenas for your pregnancy and birth with optional daily reminders
    • Dozens of educational articles for your faith-filled pregnancy and birth
    • And more!
Our Terms of Service can be found at https://www.madeforthisbirth.net/app-terms-of-service

Calls are flooding in and all that stands between life and death are your choices. Be alert. There may be something more on the line.
Join Today!
State-run emergency dispatch systems are overwhelmed. Privatized, crowdsourced dispatch response is the new wave in emergency services, with JoinDispatch leading the pack thanks to their Rapid Response Server.
Join our amazing team of Citizen Responders today to begin your first shift from your phone or JoinDispatch Home Terminal! Your Manager will work closely with you to ensure you're on track to earn stars - and to save lives, of course!
JoinDispatch is a text-based adventure game by Kyle McCullough, written by Kyle McCullough & Suki-Rose Simakis. Original Music by Morgan Z Whirledge.
NOTE TO NEW RESPONDERS:
Some recent employees have reported strange caller interactions and evidence of attempted hacks into the JoinDispatch OS. Though no one is quite certain why this is occurring, we can assure you - everything's fine and secure.
Features:
-Strive to achieve a coveted 5-Star rating.
-Earn skills that will help you meet your goals and unlock new opportunities and characters.
-Protect and Conserve: use your resources wisely, they are highly limited.
-Rewind Time Itself: Only the JoinDispatch system offers you our patented rewind function, allowing you to undo that last mistake.
-Simplified decisions and seamless navigation will have you clicking your way to great success.
-Your choices will carve a new path through your shift each time you play.

bluejetty:00186185:ios.description:
With hundreds of spoken and phonetically written words and expressions, this phrasebook is designed to do exactly what the name says—make speaking Russian easy for you. 
Perfect for those traveling to Russian-speaking countries, this phrasebook covers essential phrases on topics such as meeting people, eating out, transportation, sightseeing, shopping and many more. Or use the built-in translator for those special, one-off situations.
Written specifically for English-speakers, this phrasebook leaves no room for mispronunciation. Each phrase includes a translation to Russian, an easy-to-read phonetic translation and an audio recording of a native Russian speaker—all contained in a well structured, user-friendly interface.
Practice before you go with flashcards. Mark your most used phrases as favorites.
Whether you choose to browse phrases by category, or use the search facility to instantly find what you’re looking for, SpeakEasy Russian is an efficient lifeline when you know what to say but don’t know how. 
FEATURES: 
• Over 1,200 phrases with both Russian language and phonetic translations. Some content requires in-app purchase.
• Audio clips recorded by a native speaker to help you perfect your pronunciation.
• Flashcards with English on one side and Russian on the other side, that you can use to study and test yourself.
• Built-in translator to translate those one-off phrases you need. Unlimited use requires in-app purchase.
• Slow-play feature that plays audio at a slow speed to assist learning.
• Search facility to instantly find the phrase you’re looking for.
• Favorites feature to provide fast access to your favorite phrases.
• Supports dark mode and light mode.
• Dynamic type (large font) support.
• Support for US English, UK English and Canadian English spelling.
• No internet connection required. The app will work no matter where you are.
INCLUDES PHRASES SUCH AS: 
• Where is the bathroom (toilet)? 
• Do you speak English? 
• Do you speak Russian? 
• I don’t speak Russian 
• I speak English 
• Speak more slowly, please? 
• How do you say this in Russian? 
• Is there someone who speaks English? 
• I need a translator 
• Are you married? 
• Let’s go to a restaurant 
• Do you understand me? 
• Call a doctor! 
• I’ve run out of medication 
• I need the consulate 
• How do I get to the … ? 
• How much does a ticket cost? 
• When is the next museum tour? 
• Please call a taxi 
• How much does it cost? 
• Where is luggage check-in? 
• Can I see the menu? 
• It was delicious! 
• Are you sure this is correct? 
• Do you accept credit cards? 
• Where can I buy … 
• How much does this cost? 
• Can I try this on? 
• I need a hotel … 
• I have a reservation 
• I have lost the room key 
• The room is too cold 
• What is the exchange rate? 
• What time is it? 
• You are very pretty 
• You are very handsome 
• What is your telephone number? 
• Are you busy this evening? 
• I will miss you
----------------

bluejetty:00171165:ios.description:
With one free download you can create your verified, reusable digital ID that opens up seamless, private identity proofing experiences in travel. Your digital ID is in your hands and it’s the fastest and most private way to prove who you are, every time.
How it works:
1. Enroll your document. Add your verified passport once and access it easily in the app when you’re ready. 
2. Select your service. Curaçao Express Pass for a seamless journey through immigration.
3. Control your data. Use the handy log to keep track of how you used the app and revoke access to your digital identity at any time.
– Save time. Create enjoyable, personalized journeys with our streamlined, touchless services. No fumbling for physical IDs. No worries about lost, stolen, or fake IDs. No creepy collection and use of identity data.
– Gain peace-of-mind. This app fights fraud and eliminates vulnerable data silos using our end-to-end, decentralized technology. Your digital identity is verified against trusted data sources and your data is encrypted on your device and in transit.
– Coming soon! We will continue to add new services, functionalities and features while always maintaining our user-controlled, consent-based approach. We’re committed to ensuring you share personal information only on your terms. Airside, an Entrust Company, cannot- and will never attempt to access or sell information collected and transmitted on this app.
– Featured in Condé Nast Traveler for expediting airport security with a “whole process [that] takes approximately five seconds”
– The Washington Post noted that, “Airside is more straightforward and does a better job of spelling out who your selfie and ID will be shared with early on.”
– Selected by The World Economic Forum as Technology Pioneer
– Recognized as Top Solution by the UN World Tourism Organization
From the team that brought you Mobile Passport, we invite you to join the millions of people that already trust Airside to keep their information safe with strong encryption technology built with innovative, decentralized architecture.
The Airside Digital Identity App is compatible on iPhones with iOS 17 or later.
Don’t have an iPhone with iOS 17 or later? Go to your System Preferences, then click Software Update to check for updates.

bluejetty:00070526:ios.name: CutStory: Split & Cut Video
bluejetty:00070526:ios.summary:
CutStory is a video editor, video splitter and automatic subtitle maker for vertical video.
Record video right in the app or import your own. Edit on a multitrack timeline, create captions from speech, edit with AI, and turn one long video
bluejetty:00070526:ios.description:
CutStory is a video editor, video splitter and automatic subtitle maker for vertical video.
Record video right in the app or import your own. Edit on a multitrack timeline, create captions from speech, edit with AI, and turn one long video into a series of clips for Reels, Stories, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Telegram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and other social media.
SPLIT A LONG VIDEO
Choose a social network or set your own duration — CutStory splits the video into parts of the right length and saves every clip as a separate file.
21 ready presets. With Quick Cut you can cut a video straight from the Photos app through the Share menu, without even opening CutStory.
AUTO CAPTIONS AND SUBTITLES
The AI caption generator creates subtitles from speech in a few taps. Show captions word by word or line by line, edit the text and timing, change the recognition language, font, color, outline, background and animation.
EDIT VIDEO WITH AI
No menu hunting — tell CutStory by voice or in chat what you want: "add music to the whole video", "add transitions", "cut this video into one-minute clips", "make it ready for TikTok". The AI assistant understands 113 editing commands and runs them on your timeline.
A FULL VIDEO EDITOR
• Multitrack timeline: video, photos, music, voiceover, text, stickers and subtitles
• Cut out weak moments, trim, split, merge, duplicate, replace, freeze frame
• Video over video, extract audio and several audio tracks
• Slow motion, speed up video, rotate, flip, zoom, crop and loop
• 90 transitions, 185 color filters and video effects
• Text and sticker animation, your own fonts and saved styles
• Frame sizes and safe zones for every social network
• Backgrounds: color, gradient, image or blur — fit any video with no crop
• Slideshow maker, PhotoGrid layouts, photo and video collage maker
• Autosaved projects, undo and redo
TEMPLATES
Use ready-made templates for reels and stories: drop in your clips and photos, then change the music, text, subtitles, stickers and the edit itself. Your own project can be saved as a template too.
SHOOTING IN CUTSTORY
Multicam records live from the back and front camera at the same time: show what is happening and your reaction in one video.
MusicCam lets you pick a track and film in sync with the music.
The teleprompter shows your script over the camera, so you can read and keep your eyes near the lens.
Shoot up to 4K, 24/30/60 FPS, SDR or HDR.
MUSIC, LOGOS AND GRAPHICS
Add music from the catalog or your own audio files, record a voiceover and set the volume of each track. Use text, GIF, stickers, your own logo or watermark, AI backgrounds and AI stickers.
EXPORT
Save video in 720p, 1080p or 4K, 24/30/60 FPS, SDR or HDR. Export the movie as one file, or every part of the split as a separate clip.
WHO CUTSTORY IS FOR
• Content creators and vloggers — reels, stories and shorts
• Podcasters — cutting long episodes into short video clips
• Experts, teachers and coaches — talking-head videos with a teleprompter and captions
• Realtors and reviewers — filming on a dual camera to show the place and your reaction at once
• Dancers and anyone filming to music — recording straight to the track with MusicCam
• Small businesses — product videos with a logo, text and brand style
• Anyone working with photos — slide show, PhotoGrid and video collage
From filming to posting: video editing, splitting and automatic captions in one app.
19 interface languages. iPhone and iPad. iOS 15 and later.
CUTSTORY PRO
CutStory is free to download. CutStory Pro unlocks premium features and removes the watermark. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after the purchase is confirmed. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage it in App Store settings.
Terms of Use: https://highglossy.com/legal/cutstory/terms-of-use/en
Privacy Policy: https://highglossy.com/legal/cutstory/privacy-policy/en
Instagram: @CutStoryApp

bluejetty:00077241:ios.name: Exile: Wasteland Survival RPG
bluejetty:00077241:ios.summary:
Exile is an addictive survival RPG in a wild wasteland where your main goal is to stay alive. Wilderness of the desert spares no one. In this primitive open world, only the strongest survive.
The story tells of how the Great Ancient Civili
bluejetty:00077241:ios.description:
Exile is an addictive survival RPG in a wild wasteland where your main goal is to stay alive. Wilderness of the desert spares no one. In this primitive open world, only the strongest survive.
The story tells of how the Great Ancient Civilization, which reached the peak of its development & could not stay on it. This action adventure games includes not only a survival simulator, but also an exciting multiplayer RPG open world. Global warming turn the whole world into a wasteland entailed the irreparable loss of the former great heritage of the Ancients. You are one of the few who were able to survive the natural disaster. The world has rolled back from an advanced civilization to a primitive era, where the preservation of a bonfire comes first in the rules of survival games. In this role-playing game online you will be able to play the role of Conan the warrior, who will have to craft, build and fight so that the next day does not become the last on this earth.
• CRAFT AND BUILD TO SURVIVE
Base building is one of the important parts of the open world survival games. The survivor needs craft skills, to build a base that will withstand the adversity of dangerous enemies & animals. Craft weapons and armor to hack and slash enemies in the wasteland and defend your base.
• CREATE YOUR OWN SURVIVOR
In this survival RPG you can create your own Conan warrior. The role-playing game mode will allow you to customize your survivor down to the smallest detail, starting from hair color and finishing choices of magic ancient patterns on the body. Give your desert warrior a rare name & start your action adventure RPG in the cruel fantasy open world.
• EXPLORE WASTELAND LOCATIONS
The wasteland is fraught with many dangers. Desert survival simulator will confront the survivor with terrible enemies: formidable tribal giants, terrify scorpions, predatory hyenas & terrify tigers. There is always a choice, either to hack and slash down enemies to the last, or to escape, the main goal is to survive and delay the last day on earth as far as possible.
• RULES OF SURVIVAL GAMES
Exile is a survival simulator close to reality, where a warrior can be killed not only by enemies, but also by hunger, thirst or natural disasters. But if you adhere to the basic rules of survival, then your Conan warrior will be able to survive for a long time in the open world RPG of the wilderness. Always keep an eye on the bonfire; in a primitive world you cannot survive without it. Improve your crafting skills, base building and battles, they will help you in the action adventure games online.
Exile is a wasteland survival RPG with an open world and multiplayer. A realistic survival simulator that will immerse you in the desert adventure of the primitive fantasy world.
Contact email: help@pgstudio.io
Follow our Facebook page to share your experience in survival games: https://www.facebook.com/exilesurvival

bluejetty:00027261:ios.description:
Track every workout, every set, and every meal in one app. Fitness Buddy has helped over 10 million people train at home and in the gym since 2012.
Build your own routine from 2,400+ exercises, or follow a ready-made program. Log your sets, watch your strength go up, and keep your calories on target.
Tailored Workout Plans Just for You
Choose from over 20+ workout programs, including strength training, cardio, HIIT, and flexibility routines. With 2400+ workouts covering full-body, core, arms, legs, and more, you’ll find a plan for every fitness level. Perfect for gym enthusiasts and at-home workouts!
Easy-to-Follow Workout Guides
Get step-by-step workout instructions, HD videos, and helpful tips to improve your exercise form and stay motivated. Whether you’re new to fitness or a seasoned gym-goer, our guides make it easy to start and progress.
Unlimited Exercise Options
Explore over 2400+ exercises with variations in strength, cardio, HIIT, and flexibility training. Easily filter by equipment, body part, or difficulty to build your custom workout routine. From bodyweight exercises to dumbbells and machines, Fitness Buddy covers it all!
Stay on Track with Health & Weight Loss Goals
Track your progress, calories burned, and weight changes with our easy-to-use fitness tracker. Set goals, monitor your health, and stay motivated. Whether you're aiming for weight loss, muscle gain, or general fitness, Fitness Buddy keeps you on track every step of the way.
Customized Nutrition & Meal Plans for Healthy Eating
Access personalized meal plans to support your fitness journey! Choose from keto, paleo, fasting, and vegetarian diets with calorie and nutrient tracking for each recipe. Easily log and monitor your meals for a balanced, healthy diet that fuels your workouts.
Stay Motivated & Accountable
Connect Fitness Buddy with Apple Health to sync your progress, schedule reminders, and monitor your health metrics. Build lasting fitness habits and stay motivated with personalized insights and fitness calendars to track every workout.
Why Choose Fitness Buddy?
Comprehensive Workout Library – 2400+ exercises for home and gym workouts.
Goal-Focused Plans – Tailored workouts for weight loss, strength, and more.
Easy Nutrition Tracking – Personalized meal plans for every health goal.
Progress Tracking & Motivation – Visual insights to track your health improvements.
Transform your health and fitness journey with Fitness Buddy – the only app you need to achieve your weight loss, muscle gain, or fitness goals. 
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
We offer auto-renewing subscriptions with the following specifications:
• Subscriptions are 1 month or 12 months long.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

Light Meter goes beyond photography — it's a must-have tool for plant care, workspace optimization, and any situation where light makes a difference.

bluejetty:00174903:ios.name: Pocket Earth PRO
bluejetty:00174903:ios.summary: • Detailed worldwide maps and travel guides • Topographic contour maps for the outdoors • Works completely offline even with GPS • Great when abroad or in the wilderness, NO data roaming charges • Online routing with offline Voice Guidance
bluejetty:00174903:ios.description:
• Detailed worldwide maps and travel guides • Topographic contour maps for the outdoors • Works completely offline even with GPS • Great when abroad or in the wilderness, NO data roaming charges • Online routing with offline Voice Guidance and much more!
« Reviews »
“I love this technology” – Natali Morris, Tech Reporter, NBC’s Today Show 
Editor's Pick Best Offline Map App – thedigitaltrekker.com
“The best travel app in the world… Don’t leave home without it!” – bonvoyageurs.com
“Very impressive app with unmatched features.” – toptenreviews.com
« Maps »
• Beautiful Retina quality maps at a fraction of the size! The fastest and most beautiful offline maps on the App Store!
• Detailed and interactive worldwide maps! More than 100,000 places & completely free!
• Access your maps online and offline! Saves on data roaming costs!
• Personalize the maps to show the info you want!
• Online Routing with voice guided turn by turn directions. Save your multi-stop itineraries for offline navigation!
• Online street address search and contacts integration!
• Did we mention everything is offline? Works anywhere- cities, small towns, even in the middle of nowhere. Never any roaming charges. We dare you to try it!
« For the Traveler »
• Find out about thousands of interesting places - hotels, restaurants, bars, tourist sites, even get metro and public transit info!
• Our super wide area Nearby search is also super fast!
• Have all the travel info you need with more than 25,000 detailed Wikivoyage Travel Guides and more than 1 million Wikipedia articles in 7 languages! All offline of course!
• Customizable Pins and favorites groups! Add notes and mark and share favorite spots!
• Share maps links and your current location (SMS, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email, etc)!
« For the Adventurer »
• An in-app purchase option offers topographic maps. Get high performance, high accuracy 10m / 50ft contour display world-wide. The ONLY offline app that lets you download large areas, even entire countries! Contours are displayed on our existing maps for all Activities.
• Hiking and Cycling maps! Great for geocaching and getting off the track!
• GPS track recording lets you see what route you took! Great for hikes, cycling and off road! Never get lost again!
• Import/Export support for GPX and CSV files! Share with friends using PE Archives.
• Displays and lets you search for map coordinates (including DD, DDM, DMS, MGRS, UTM/UPS, GeoHash, and what3words)!
• Numerous GPS settings for your preferred configuration including compass and heading arrow or rotation, look ahead mode, accuracy and recording settings. 
...and much more - so try it out!
« How's it Work? » 
 Just select the cities, regions, or even whole countries you want to download, and it will be available for offline use, complete with information on thousands of POIs (Points of Interest), travel guides and Wikipedia articles.
 To do this we utilize community driven open data from a number of amazing projects. We use some magik to compress and package it in a format optimized for mobile devices. Pocket Earth then renders its beautiful vector maps on your device using our OpenGL ES based MagikMap technology.
To learn more about Pocket Earth or the community driven open data sources that we use, please visit our website.
Don’t forget this:
 1. Using the GPS features of this app can significantly affect battery life. Only leave GPS enabled when you need to use it. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. Pocket Earth only uses GPS in the background for route navigation and gps track recording features. 
 2. This app uses data from the amazing community driven open mapping project called openstreetmap.org! Coverage detail may vary by region, please visit our website to check the map detail for your regions of interest.
 3. Does not currently support all asian texts on the map (Chinese, Japanese, etc).

bluejetty:00139983:ios.description:
Millions people play sudoku. Train your brain, keep your mind sharp!
Sudoku Puzzle Game is a welcomed and addictive Brain Sudoku puzzle game on Store. You can download Sudoku free app for your Phone and Pad. You get 10000+ challenging Sudoku puzzles everyday to train your brain. Brain Sudoku for beginners and advanced players! 
Each Sudoku has only one true solution. Classic Sudoku the puzzle game for your brain, logical thinking, memory, and A GOOD TIME KILLER!
Classic Sudoku is a logic-based number puzzle game and the goal is to place 1 to 9 digit numbers into each grid cell so that each number can only appear once in each row, each column and each mini-grid. With our Sudoku puzzle app, you can not only enjoy sudoku games anytime anywhere, but also learn Sudoku techniques from it. 
Key Features
Sudoku puzzles come in 6 difficulty levels - beginner Sudoku,easy Sudoku, medium Sudoku, hard Sudoku , expert Sudoku and master Sudoku! Perfect for Sudoku beginners and advanced players!
Pencil Mode - Turn on/ off pencil mode as you like.
Highlight Duplicates - to avoid repeating numbers in a row, column and block.
Intelligent Hints - guide you through the numbers when you get stuck
Themes - Choose the theme that makes it easier for your eyes.
Long press to fill quickly
On this Brain Sudoku free app, you are also able to
Turn on/ off sound effects
Turn on/ off Highlight identical numbers
Auto remove notes from all columns, rows and blocks once the number is placed
Unlimited undo & redo
Auto-save - Pause the game and resume the game without losing any progress
You may also find the following Brain Sudoku features useful
Use dark mode to protect your eyes
Turn on/ off timer when you play the sudoku puzzle
Good gameplay
Intuitive interface
Easy tools, easy control
Clear layout
Our free Sudoku puzzle app has intuitive interface, easy control, clear layout and well balanced difficulty levels for beginners and advanced players. It’s not only a good time killer but also helps you think, makes you more logical and have better memory. 
When you first open our Sudoku app, you see a guide tour teaching you how to play Sudoku and when you open the puzzle game app for the 100th time, you can see yourself a Sudoku master and a great Sudoku solver. You’d be able to play any web sudoku fast. Come to our Kingdom of Sudoku and keep your mind sharp.
This is the sodoku app for sodoku lovers. If you like to play soduku game, you should download the suduku game app. We offer 6 difficulty levels. Download now and play sudoko everyday.

bluejetty:00019024:ios.description:
Daily themed crossword puzzles for Fun and Cognitive Exercises
Daily POP Crossword Puzzles is your go-to crossword app for engaging brain games! Daily crossword puzzles free of charge. From pop-culture to celebrity crossword puzzles – our app is free to download, and free to play! Put your pop culture knowledge to the test with two new crossword puzzles every day.
Crossword puzzle constructors and #1 crossword puzzle magazine publisher, Dell Magazines and Penny Press helped create our pop culture-themed puzzles.
Daily POP Crossword puzzles provide you with new challenges and celebrity trivia for free, such as our variety puzzles and daily brain games.
Daily POP Crossword Puzzles provides:
• Daily crossword variety puzzles
• Brain games
• Word crossword games for all skill levels
• Puzzles that are fun, pop-culture-themed to test your knowledge
• Crossword with friends
DAILY POP CROSSWORDS FEATURES:
FREE POP-CULTURE-THEMED CROSSWORD PUZZLE GAMES
• Brain games & daily crossword puzzle free - with themes spanning TV, movies, celebrity trivia, music, sports, and more.
• Word crosswords designed for single-session play, with a perfect balance of relaxation and cognitive exercise.
• Puzzles that challenge you or casual word games, find something for your mood.
• Collect in-app achievements to earn free coins as you complete pop star-themed puzzles.
ENHANCE YOUR MIND WITH LOGIC & BRAIN GAMES
• Brain games and logic games that challenge your memory and problem-solving skills.
• Variety puzzles come with hints and tools to help you solve even the toughest puzzles.
• Stuck? Show errors or reveal letters and words at any time to learn as you go in our daily themed crossword puzzles.
FLEXIBLE AND USER-FRIENDLY CROSSWORD PUZZLE APP
• Adjust settings to make your experience unique—play at your own pace or aim for speed.
• Use Smart Step navigation to breeze through the puzzle grid effortlessly.
• Access a growing archive of variety puzzles, including bonus sets and daily themed crossword puzzles.
STAY ENGAGED WITH DAILY THEMED CROSSWORD PUZZLES
• Puzzle themes include celebrities, movies, TV shows, sports, and books.
• Explore fresh challenges daily and revisit your favorites anytime.
• There’s something for every skill level, from casual word puzzles to advanced daily crossword puzzles.
Puzzles and variety crossword games in Daily POP Crosswords offer the perfect mix of fun and brain exercise. Daily crossword puzzles free your mind from stress while sharpening your memory and logic skills. Our free crossword puzzles are even more fun with a pop culture twist! Enjoy celebrity crosswords and puzzles about TV, music, movies, sports, games, books, and more with Daily POP Crosswords. Download now!
Email us at help@puzzlenation.com if you have any issues with the app. Happy Solving!

SPECIAL FEATURES
- AUGMENTED REALITY - AR
- STOP CARRYING BOOK GUIDES!!!
- 100% OFFLINE TRAVEL GUIDE

- INTERACTIVE POINTS OF INTERES
bluejetty:00179862:ios.description:
SPECIAL FEATURES
- AUGMENTED REALITY - AR
- STOP CARRYING BOOK GUIDES!!!
- 100% OFFLINE TRAVEL GUIDE
- OFFLINE METRO MAP
- ZOOMABLE 100% REGIONAL OFFLINE MAPS: Paris & Versailles
- PICS GALLERY
- GPS CAPABLE
- INTERACTIVE POINTS OF INTEREST on the maps showing public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals, museums, theatres, and many others.
- DAILY BASED ITINERARIES
- BUDGET BASED HOTELS & RESTAURANTS
- WHERE, WHAT & HOW TO SHOP
- NIGHTLIFE ACTIVITIES
- CITY TIPS, MOVING AROUND, COMMUTING
- SAFETY TIPS
------------------------------------------
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!!
With this Travel Guide you have a full city guide in your iPhone & iPod Touch.
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!!
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. Slide through the tutorial for more tips. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standed.
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc...
Unlike other guides, this Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region.
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Eiffel Tower, Trocadéro, Arc de Triomphe, Champs Elysées, Place de la Concorde, Hôtel de Ville, Les Invalides, Notre Dame Cathedral, Latin Quarter, Pantheon, Sainte Chapelle, Musée d'Orsay, Jardin de Luxembourg, Place de la Bastille, Pont Alexandre III, Versailles, among others.
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.
This app contains IAPs for you to enjoy and discover the best out of your visit.

bluejetty:00039538:ios.description:
هل تودّين أن تكوني امرأةً عصريّةً تجذبين الأنظار نحوك باستمرار؟  هل أهملت نفسك مؤخراً نتيجة ضيق الوقت ومشاغل الحياة؟  هل ترغبين في تغيير نمط حياتك وكسر روتينها المملّ وأنت مرتاحة في منزلك أو عملك؟ 
 تطبيق همسة سيكون جسر عبورك إلى حياتك الجديدة. نعم إنها حياتك المليئة بالجمال والتألق والصحة الجسدية والنفسية.  سوف نغير كل المفاهيم التي تحدّ من انطلاقك نحو عالمك المفضّل ونضعك أمام واقعٍ جميلٍ يعكس أنوثتك! 
خبراء في عالم الموضة، أخصائيو تجميل ومكياج، مدرّبو لياقة بارعون، مستشارو حياة معتمدون، علماء فلك لفتح الفال، وأخصائيو تغذية رائعون والمزيد ينتظرك ضمن تطبيقنا.  هل مازلت متردّدة؟ كل ما تحتاجين إليه هو تحميل تطبيق همسة، وستكونين أمام عالمك الجميل بلمسة.
***خدمات فريدة ومميزة***
يقدّم لك تطبيق همسة خدمات عديدة لن تجدي لها مثيلاً في أي تطبيق آخر:
- موضة وستايل مع أبرز مصممي العالم العربي
- الفال بالكارطة المغربية لكشف خبايا الماضي والحاضر
- نصائح لعلاقتك العاطفية مع الشريك
- قراءة فنجان القهوة لمعرفة الطالع
- برنامج غذائي لحياة صحية
- أخصائيو تجميل ومكياج للعناية بجمالك وبشرتك
- مدرب رياضي لمتابعة نشاطك
- نصائح للحياة ومشاكلها
إذا كنت تبحثين عن الصحة، التألق والجمال، والترفيه فأنت في المكان الصحيح!

bluejetty:00045516:ios.name: Cross Cribbage
bluejetty:00045516:ios.summary:
Cribbage meets strategy board game.
Cross Cribbage transforms classic cribbage into a fresh, tactical experience played on a 5x5 grid. Instead of scoring traditional pegging hands, players take turns placing cards to build cribbage “hands”
bluejetty:00045516:ios.description:
Cribbage meets strategy board game.
Cross Cribbage transforms classic cribbage into a fresh, tactical experience played on a 5x5 grid. Instead of scoring traditional pegging hands, players take turns placing cards to build cribbage “hands” across rows and columns. One player scores the rows, the other scores the columns.
Every placement matters. You’re building your own scoring opportunities while blocking your opponent’s best plays. It feels familiar, yet completely new—a blend of cribbage, strategy, and puzzle-solving.
How It Works
• Each turn, you place a card from your hand onto an empty space
• The board fills into 25 cards total, forming cribbage hands in all rows and columns
• One player controls scoring for all horizontal hands, the other for all vertical hands
• If a player is the dealer for the round, they also score the shaded diagonal crib hand
• Standard cribbage scoring applies: 15s, pairs, runs, and flushes
• When the board is full, all hands are scored
What Makes It Unique
• Strategic card placement – every move affects multiple hands
• Think ahead on offense and defense
• A blend of cribbage, spatial strategy, and light puzzle play
• Quick to learn, endlessly replayable
Game Modes
• Play Online – Invite a friend or play someone new
• Local Pass & Play – Share a device with someone nearby
• Single Player – Challenge the computer with multiple difficulty levels
Features
• Beautiful wood-themed board and classic playing cards
• Smart scoring visuals and hand breakdowns
• Interactive tutorial to learn how to play
• Works great on phones and tablets
Win Conditions
The game ends when a player reaches 121 points—or if both exceed 121 in the same round, the higher score wins.
Cross Cribbage is easy to learn if you already know cribbage, and a fun way to discover cribbage if you’ve never played before. Perfect for fans of cribbage, card strategy games, puzzles, or cerebral two-player challenges.
Download now and play cribbage like you’ve never played it before!

O Grupo SK é uma empresa moderna, tecnologicamente avançada, com profissionais graduados e preparados para atender com competência, transparência, seriedade e qualidade na gestão de prestação de serviço. 
Tudo isso para dar mais transparênc
bluejetty:00155500:ios.description:
O Grupo SK é uma empresa moderna, tecnologicamente avançada, com profissionais graduados e preparados para atender com competência, transparência, seriedade e qualidade na gestão de prestação de serviço. 
Tudo isso para dar mais transparência e eficiência à gestão de condomínios. 
Automatize as rotinas do condomínio como: 
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Todas as mensagens geram notificação pelo aplicativo e por e-mail, bem como sua entrega e leitura são disponibilizadas no painel da administração. 
Para se cadastrar como morador no aplicativo, é preciso que o seu condomínio já esteja cadastrado em nossa base. 
Se tiver dúvidas entre em contato conosco!

bluejetty:00024402:ios.description:
Welcome to Podcast Maker: Home Studio, a useful app for anyone who strives to become a Podcast Creator. 
With Podcast Maker, you now can use the built-in sound importing, recording, and numerous sound editing tools to make podcast from anywhere, at anytime and export the outputs to any cloud platforms! Let your vioce be heard!
OUR BUILT-IN FEATURES:
1. Voice recorder - recording your stories with a single tap.
2. Edit your audio files with various premium tools: split, trim, equalizer, echo, reverb and noise cancelling
3. Add background music, sound effects and breaks music from our audio library, or you can choose to upload your own audio files.
4. Arrange your episode segments easily just by hold and drag each segment from the segment list screen.
5. Export your segments/episodes to any cloud platforms
And many more features are on the way! They'll soon be onboard, please be patient with us and enjoy this pocket studio.
As for Subscription Service:
• Subscribed user has unlimited access to premium features, no ads and unlimited number of episodes to create/export.
• Unsubscribed user can only use free features.
• User can subscribe for one week (USD $2.99), one month (USD $5.99), auto-renewing subscription, or purchase for a lifetime access($19.99). 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/terms-of-use/
You are welcome to contact us at support@smartwidgetlabs.com

bluejetty:00145069:ios.description:
We've been looking for the perfect solution for a preschooler learning just like you have. Try the app we got!
Binky Preschool Academy is ready to open its doors to your child 3-5 years old and present 300+ educational games.
APPROVED BY EXPERTS
We’ve worked through all the tasks and levels with educational experts and psychologists experts to come up with best exercises.
Binky Preschool Academy uses preschool curriculum standards in its program.
Our young students have comprehensive knowledge, deep understanding and a set of skills that will help them excel in their further life.
INDIVIDUAL LEARNING PROGRAM
Every child is unique. Binky Preschool Academy creates an individual learning program according to age, gender, interests of your child. This program is aimed at developing cognitive abilities, emotional intelligence, social skills, improving attention, memory, imagination, communication skills, expanding the worldview.
MORE THAN 300+ ACTIVITIES:
Jigsaw Puzzles, Animals, Colors, Shapes, Drawing, Nursery Rhymes, Counting games, Math games, Alphabet games, Sorting Games, Music Instruments, Memory gyms, Books, Flashcards Games, Cartoons, Sorting Games,Coloring draw by number, Phonics games,Tracing games, Glow-coloring games,Emotions game, Video Lessons
MAIN POINTS
– Easy to follow progress for parents. The child could navigate app on his/her own.
– Step–by–step learning path. All tasks are arranged in a logical order.
– No ads. At all.
– No in–app purchases.
– Includes all the subjects a toddler and preschool needs.
– Can be used on both iPad and iPhone
– 100% safe for kids
– Greate for use while traveling or waiting for appointment.
– Useful for homeschoolers
We are sure that your child will spend a great time coloring, counting and solving hundreds of our puzzles. 
Playing is the best way for learning. No matter your purpose: accelerating early learning, additional knowledge or making the best use of play time — Binky Preschool Academy suits them all. 
TRY FIRST

bluejetty:00024127:ios.name: Get Closer・Question Games
bluejetty:00024127:ios.summary: Get Closer is an easy-to-play conversational game that cultivates relationships by engaging friends, family members, couples, colleagues, or even those who have just met in entertaining and meaningful discussions around love, life, and ever
bluejetty:00024127:ios.description:
Get Closer is an easy-to-play conversational game that cultivates relationships by engaging friends, family members, couples, colleagues, or even those who have just met in entertaining and meaningful discussions around love, life, and everything in between.
Do you feel like you could spend more time with your family? Are you looking for new ways to improve relationships with your partner? Do you want to bond with your team members or employees? Get Closer is the answer. With over 400 prompts based on positive psychology, this game will add an extra positive element to your dinner, celebration, team building exercise, or get-together with friends.
In a world where disconnectedness, loneliness, and limited meaningful social interaction is an exponentially increasing problem, humans are searching for new—and fun—ways to connect with each other. The Get Closer game helps you engage in deep conversations that go beyond small talks and chit-chats and build strong relationships between colleagues, family generations, and loved ones.
HOW TO PLAY
1. Find someone you would like to get to know better. Create a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere so everyone gets the chance to participate.
2. There are three levels of cards: Close, Closer, and Closest. Choose which level of closeness you’re comfortable with based on how good you know each other.
3. Take turns reading and answering the questions. Remember: Trust and openness are key to this game. Ask follow-up questions if you feel it’ll help the other person open up more.
4. Once you have finished, take some time together and reflect on the answers.
5. Try more questions from the same level. Go up a level. Even go down a level. There’s no wrong way to play as long as you’re getting closer.
GET CLOSER APP FEATURES
- There are 5 curated editions of prompts: General, Family, Couples (recommended for players aged 18+), Team, and prompts for table talk. 
- Beautifully designed game experience: The Get Closer App has been designed to capture the physical experience of Get Closer card game. Getting around the app is a breeze and selecting questions is simple.
- Questions are separated into three levels: Close, Closer, Closest. Each progressive level poses questions that become more personal, challenging players to share and strengthen their bond.
- Compatible with iPhone and iPad
PREMIUM FEATURES
- Unlock access to all 400 questions to go even deeper in your conversations and relationships.

apple-macos:1278539369.name: State Statute & Federal Law
apple-macos:1278539369.description:
Statutes for New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Colorado, Florida, California and many more states, plus the full US Code, on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
The exact text of the law, not a summary of it. Built for the moment you need to read the actual statute: on a shoulder, in a courthouse hallway, in a basement with no signal.
WHY PROFESSIONALS USE IT
• Complete records. Full statute text, not headnotes and not excerpts.
• Updated at the source. Titles refresh as each state publishes new data. The app tracks state legislature sites directly, so amendments reach you without you going looking for them.
• Fast search, by heading or across the full text of a title.
• Tap a cited section to read it in a pop-up without losing your place.
• The list and the law, side by side on iPad, Mac and an unfolded iPhone Duo.
• Works offline. Once a title is downloaded it works with no connection, no signal and no cell data. Nothing loads from the web when you search.
• Favorites and bookmarks for the sections you return to daily.
• Your own notes on any section, with optional iCloud backup.
• Favorites can sync and restore through iCloud across your devices.
• Dark mode throughout.
BUILT FOR
Police and law enforcement · Attorneys and public defenders · Paralegals and legal assistants · Investigators · Court staff · Corrections and probation · Code enforcement · Law students
MOST-USED TITLES
New Jersey Title 2C (Criminal Justice) and Title 39 (Motor Vehicles). Pennsylvania Title 18 (Crimes) and Title 75 (Vehicle Code). New York Penal Law and Vehicle & Traffic Law. Colorado Title 18 (Criminal Code) and Title 42 (Vehicles and Traffic). Title 18 of the US Code (Crimes and Criminal Procedure). Florida Title XLVI (Crimes). California Penal Code and Vehicle Code. Connecticut Title 53a (Penal Code) and Title 14 (Motor Vehicles). Virginia Title 18.2 (Crimes). Plus criminal procedure, civil practice, tax, insurance and education codes across every state in the library.
STATES AND JURISDICTIONS INCLUDED
Alabama · Alaska · Arizona · California · Colorado · Connecticut · Delaware · District of Columbia · Florida · Hawaii · Idaho · Illinois · Indiana · Iowa · Kansas · Kentucky · Louisiana · Maine · Maryland · Massachusetts · Michigan · Minnesota · Missouri · Montana · Nebraska · Nevada · New Hampshire · New Jersey · New Mexico · New York · North Carolina · North Dakota · Ohio · Oklahoma · Oregon · Pennsylvania · Rhode Island · South Carolina · South Dakota · Texas · Utah · Vermont · Virginia · Washington · West Virginia · Wisconsin · Wyoming · United States Code
Colorado is included as an officially sanctioned publication using the official text of the Colorado Revised Statutes.
HOW IT WORKS
Buy only the titles you need, or a complete set for a state. Free titles are available so you can see the format before you buy. More states are added on an ongoing basis.

apple-macos:6751048813.description:
IPTV One: TV & Movie Player
Complete IPTV player for Live TV & VOD. Import M3U/M3U8, sign in with Xtream Codes or Stalker Portal, play local video files, browse EPG, cast to TV, download for offline viewing, 4K/HDR, multi-language subtitles (incl. external via OpenSubtitles), and seamless cross-device sync with one account.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
• One account for all your devices
• Sync favorites and favorite groups
• Sync recently watched items
• Sync custom channel groups
• Sync hidden videos and groups
• Resume playback exactly where you left off
CONTENT MANAGEMENT
• Import via M3U/M3U8 URL, Xtream Codes API, or Stalker Portal
• Play local video files directly from your device
• Automatic organization: Live TV, Movies, Series
• Create custom groups and manage favorites
• Hide unwanted content for a cleaner interface
• Add multiple providers and switch easily
PLAYBACK & CONTROLS
• Record what you're watching on live TV
• Playback speeds from 0.5× to 2×
• Quick skips (±10s / ±30s)
• Gesture controls for effortless navigation
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP) for multitasking
• Portrait and landscape playback
VIEWING EXPERIENCE
• 4K, HDR, and Dolby Vision (when supported)

CONVENIENCE

PREMIUM FEATURES

IMPORTANT / LEGAL
IPTV One does not provide any content or playlists. The app is a media player for sources you supply, similar to a web browser. Only stream content you have rights to. Using unauthorized sources may lead to action by rights holders. IPTV One does not endorse illegal IPTV subscriptions.
